items.e: **Rabbi Ḥizkiya opened... 1. Rabbi Ḥizkiya opened** his discourse with the following exposition: **It is stated: “Like a lily among the thorns” [Song of Songs 2:2].** [Rabbi Ḥizkiya] asks **“what is this lily?”** and he answers, “**this is the Assembly of Israel,”** which is Malkhut . For **there is** one type of **lily and there is** another type of **lily. Just as the lily that is among the thorns has** both the colors **red and white, so too the Assembly of Israel has both judgment and mercy. Just as the lily has thirteen petals, so too the Assembly of Israel has the thirteen measures of mercy that surround it on all of its sides. So too, Elohim that appears** in the verse **here** i.e.: “In the beginning Elohim created” [Genesis 1:1], **from the moment** [ Elohim ] **was mentioned, it generated thirteen words to surround and protect the Assembly of Israel**. They are: et , hashamayim , ve’et , ha’aretz , ve-ha’aretz , hayta , tohu , vavohu , ve’ḥoshekh , al , penei , tehom , ve-ru’aḥ [“the heavens and the earth. The earth was emptiness and disorder, and darkness was upon the face of the deep and the spirit,” Genesis 1:1–2]. That is, up to [the words] Elohim meraḥefet [“God hovered,” Genesis 1:2].

Explanation: There are ten sefirot – Keter ; Ḥokhma ; Bina ; Ḥesed ; Gevura ; Tiferet ; Netzaḥ ; Hod ; Yesod ; and Malkhut . But in essence they are only five: Keter , Ḥokhma , Bina , Tiferet and Malkhut , as the sefira of Tiferet incorporates six sefirot – ḤGT NHY [ Ḥesed , Gevura , Tiferet , Netzaḥ , Hod , Yesod ]. Keter is also called Arikh Anpin [“Long Face”], while Ḥokhma and Bina are called Abba Ve-imma [“Father and Mother”], and Tiferet and Malkhut are called Ze’er Anpin [“Small Face”] and Nukba [“female”] (for an explanation of the ten sefirot , see “Introduction to the Wisdom of the Kabbalah” ( Petiḥa leḤokhmat HaKabbala ), section 5).

Know that the mystical secret of the seven days of creation is the secret of the two partzufim : Ze’er Anpin and Nukba of the world of Atzilut , and they contain seven sefirot : Ḥesed , Gevura , Tiferet , Netzaḥ , Hod , Yesod and Malkhut , as stated above. It is explained in these verses from the act of creation how Abba Ve-imma , which are Ḥokhma and Bina , emanated them, from the start of their coming into being until the completion of their maturation, which transpires over six thousand years. This idea is progressively clarified here in the Zohar on Bereshit .

Rabbi Ḥizkiya began his explanation of the [ partzuf of] Nukba of Ze’er Anpin in order to clarify the order of its emanation from [the partzuf of] Imma , that is Bina , which is called by the name Elohim . This is why he began by explaining the concept of the lily, which is the Nukba of Ze’er Anpin . Since the Nukba of Ze’er Anpin , at the completion of its development, is called the Assembly of Israel – as stated below – he says, “what is this lily; it is the Assembly of Israel.”

This lily has two states: A state of immaturity, which is her initial formation, at which point she has only one sefira , Keter , within which the light [of the level] of nefesh is enclothed, and her nine lower sefirot have fallen from Atzilut to the world of Beria ; and a state of maturity, at which point her lower nine sefirot have ascended from the world of Beria to the world of Atzilut , and she is fashioned with them into a whole partzuf of ten sefirot . She then ascends together with her husband, Ze’er Anpin , to an equal height with [the partzufim of] Abba Ve-imma of Atzilut and [ Ze’er Anpin and Nukba ] enclothe [ Abba Ve-imma ]. Then << Ze’er Anpin is called by the name "Israel," whose [Hebrew] letters spell out li rosh [“to me a head”], while Nukba is called by the name "Assembly of Israel," because she assembles inside herself all of the lights of her husband, Israel, which she then passes on to the lower realms.

The state of immaturity is called “a lily among the thorns” because the [ Nukba 's] nine lower sefirot were emptied of the light of Atzilut and were left like thorns. The state of maturity is simply called “a lily,” or “the Assembly of Israel.” This is the meaning of the comment: **“For there is one type of lily and there is another type of lily.”**

Now, the reddish hue indicates that external forces have a hold there, through which the kelippot can absorb. This occurs during the state of immaturity, when [ Nukba 's] nine lower sefirot are in Beria . [ Nukba ] also has a whitish hue, that is, in the vessel of her Keter , where external forces have no hold. Accordingly, [the Zohar ] states: **“Just as the lily that is among the thorns has red and white, so too the Assembly of Israel has judgment and mercy.”** This teaches that even in [ Nukba 's] mature state, when she is called the Assembly of Israel, although she then ascends and enclothes Bina in her mature state, as explained above, she nevertheless retains the attribute of judgment. For [ Nukba ] requires the mystical partition that is forged within her for the purpose of fusion through collision, and the judgment in the partition strikes the supernal light and returns it backward. This process raises the ten sefirot of returning light, which is called “the light of judgment,” and [this returning light] draws into itself ten sefirot of direct light, referred to as "the light of mercy" (see the “Introduction to the Wisdom of the Kabbalah” ( Petiḥa leḤokhmat HaKabbala ), section 14). Accordingly, the Assembly of Israel also contains judgment and mercy, corresponding to the red and white colors of a lily among thorns.

This is the mystical secret of the pool made by King Solomon [see I Kings 7:23–26], which stood upon twelve oxen. For these, [ Nukba 's] nine lower sefirot , which fell into Beria as stated, were rectified there through the secret of the twelve oxen. The point of the Keter that remained in Atzilut is the secret of the pool which was positioned above them, and their incorporation together is called the **thirteen petals** of the lily. The idea of this division of [ Nukba 's] ten sefirot into thirteen will be explained below in Marot HaSulam .

The brains of Nukba in her mature state, which contain some of the illumination of Ḥokhma , emanate from the thirteen names that are called “the thirteen attributes of mercy.” This is the meaning of the phrase**: “so too the Assembly of Israel has thirteen measures of mercy.”** The main idea that Rabbi Ḥizkiya seeks to convey in this comparison of a lily between the thorns and the Assembly of Israel, is to teach us that everything which is present in the mature state of Nukba must correspondingly exist, in a preparatory, preliminary form, already at her initial formation, that is, in her state of immaturity. This is why [Rabbi Ḥizkiya] states that parallel to the whiteness and redness of the immature state, judgment and mercy emerge in [ Nukba ] in the mature state; and parallel to the thirteen petals of the immature state, the thirteen measures of mercy emerge in her in their mature state. He cites this here in order to teach us how the verses before us elucidate these two orders of the state of immaturity and maturity, which are found in the Atzilut of Nukba , as he proceeds to explain: **“So too, the word Elohim , Lord, that appears here…”**

**“So too, the name Elohim ** that appears here **generates thirteen words.”** This teaches that the Elohim in this verse, “In the beginning Elohim created,” which is the mystical meaning of Bina that emanates the Nukba of Ze’er Anpin , generates these thirteen words: et , hashamayim , ve’et , ha’aretz , ve-ha’aretz , hayta , tohu , vavohu , ve’ḥoshekh , al , penei , tehom , ve-ru’aḥ , that is, up to the second [instance of the word] Elohim . These thirteen words allude to those thirteen petals of the lily among the thorns, in the mystical secret of the pool that stands above twelve oxen, as explained above. These [thirteen entities] are the preparations for the Assembly of Israel, to receive the thirteen measures of mercy. This is why [the Zohar ] states **“surrounding and protecting the Assembly of Israel,”** because the thirteen attributes of mercy, which form the completed brains of Nukba , are seen as surrounding her and illuminating her from all sides, all the way around. Through them [ Nukba ] is guarded from contact with external forces, for as long as she lacks the mature brains with the illumination of Ḥokhma from the thirteen measures, external forces can suckle from her.

**2. Afterward,** the name Elohim **appears once more**, that is, Elohim meraḥefet "[the spirit] of God hovered…” **Why is it mentioned again? To generate the five hard leaves that surround the lily. These five leaves are called salvations, and they are five gates. It is stated with regard to this secret: “I will raise the cup of salvation.” This is the cup of blessing, which must rest on five fingers, no more, just as the lily rests on five hard leaves, which correspond to the five fingers. This lily is the cup of blessing. There are five words from the second name Elohim to the third name Elohim,** and they are: meraḥefet , al , penei , hamayim , va’yomer (“hovered over the surface of the water. And said,”). These correspond to the five aforementioned leaves. **From this point onward,** when [the verse] states, “And God said: Let there be light,” this refers to **the light that was created and hidden away, and which is included in that covenant, as it entered the lily and seeded it. This is what is called the “tree that makes fruit, and its seed is within it”** [Genesis 1:11], **and that seed is actually in the sign of the covenant.**

Explanation: **“Five forceful leaves” –** This refers to the five restraints ( gevurot ) of the Nukba , which are the ten sefirot of the returning light that the Nukba raises up by means of the fusion through collision with the supernal light and is called the "light of judgment." The ten sefirot of the direct light are called five givings ( ḥassadim ), ḤGT NH ( Ḥesed , Gevura , Tiferet , Netzaḥ and Hod ), and these are enclothed in the five restraints of the returning light ḤGT NH. These five leaves are forceful, [representing] the forces of judgment that are in the partition, which prevents the supernal light from enclothing from the partition downward.

This is why they are now called only **“five forceful leaves,”** since [the partition] is, as yet, unfit for fusion upon it. At the time of maturity, when the partition enters into fusion [through collision] with the supernal light, they are called five restraints, as was explained previously.

These five forceful leaves constitute the mystical meaning of the five words that appear from the second Elohim to the third Elohim : meraḥefet , al , penei , hamayim , va’yomer . This is why [Rabbi Ḥizkiya] asks **“why is it mentioned again,”** which implies that there is a new action here. He answers that it is in order to extract these five forceful leaves from the Nukba , which are the preparation for a fusion through collision during the phase of maturity.

The reason these ten sefirot of the returning light are called five restraints, which are Ḥesed , Gevura , Tiferet , Netzaḥ , and Hod , and they are not called Keter , Ḥokhma , Bina , Tiferet , and Malkhut , is because they draw forth only the light of giving ( ḥassadim ). Therefore Keter , Ḥokhma and Bina descend from their status and are called Ḥesed , Gevura , and Tiferet , while Tiferet and Malkhut are called Netzaḥ and Hod .

This is why [the Zohar ] states **“five gates…the cup of salvation”** which is at the time of maturity, when the five forceful leaves become five restraints. At that point they are considered five gates, which are open gates to receive the five givings ( ḥassadim ) of the direct light. This is also the reason they are called “salvations.” Then the Nukba is called **“the cup of salvation,”** or **“the cup of blessing,”** since through the qualities [of the gates], the Nukba becomes a vessel that holds the blessing, which is those five givings ( ḥassadim ) mentioned previously.

Now, the number of sefirot have two aspects; either they are ten in number, which are essentially five levels, as stated above, or thirteen in number, like the thirteen attributes of mercy. The difference between them is that the number ten is indicative of the sefira of Ze’er Anpin and Nukba , in which there is only light of giving ( ḥassadim ). The number thirteen indicates the brains of the illumination of Ḥokhma , which is received into Ze’er Anpin and Nukba . This issue is clarified in Marot HaSulam , below.

[Rabbi Ḥizkiya] then states that **“the cup of blessing,”** which is representative of the five givings ( ḥassadim ) being drawn into the five restraints, as stated, **“must rest on five fingers,”** i.e., only in the number ten, which are Ḥesed , Gevura , Tiferet , Netzaḥ , and Hod , as stated, and **“no more,”** that is, to the exclusion of the number thirteen. The reason [why it is only ten] is that the Nukba is fit to receive Ḥokhma from the mystical meaning of the thirteen only through the enclothing of Ḥokhma in the light of giving ( ḥassadim ). Therefore, it is first necessary to draw forth a blessing, which is five givings ( ḥassadim ) by means of specifically five fingers, which are the five restraints, and subsequently [the Nukba ] can also receive from the thirteen.

The implication here is that [the five fingers] refers to the five fingers of the left hand, which [represent] five restraints, since the five fingers of the right hand constitute the mystical meaning of five givings ( ḥassadim ). Accordingly, the cup of blessing must be raised with both hands, i.e., with the five fingers of the left hand as well, in order to allude to the aforementioned intention of the five restraints. Afterward, however, at the start of the blessing, only the five fingers of the right hand should remain on the cup, as one should not awaken the grip of the Sitra Aḥara , which suckles from the left.

This is why [Rabbi Ḥizkiya] said, **“from this point onward, the light [etc.].”** This means to say that the third Elohim in the verse, “Let there be light etc.” comes to emanate the aspect of maturity of Nukba , which is five givings ( ḥassadim ) and the thirteen attributes of mercy, as the five givings constitute the mystical meaning of the five mentions of “light” in the passage, which are: “Let there be light,” “and there was light,” “that the light was good,” “between the light,” and “the light, day.” The thirteen attributes of mercy are alluded to in the verse: “And there was evening and there was morning, one [ eḥad ] day,” since eḥad is the mystical meaning of thirteen and it also has a numerical value of thirteen. These five lights constitute the mystical meaning of the statement of the Sages: “Through the light that the Holy One, blessed be He, created on the first day, Adam could observe from one end of the world to the other. But when the Holy One, Blessed be He, looked upon the generation of the Flood and the generation of the Dispersion and saw their corrupt ways, He arose and concealed it from them.” This is why [Rabbi Ḥizkiya] says **“which was created and hidden away.”**

This is why [Rabbi Ḥizkiya] said, **“and was included in that covenant, which entered the lily.”** Meaning, these five givings ( ḥassadim ) were first incorporated in the Yesod of Ze’er Anpin , and did not come directly from Bina , which is called Elohim , to the Nukba . The covenant is the Yesod of Ze’er Anpin , which **entered the lily** and gave them to [the Nukba ]. The reason will be explained presently.

Now, these five givings ( ḥassadim ) that emerge upon the five restraints ( gevurot ), as stated, are called “seed.” Also, you should know that the main power of the judgments and restraints in the partition, through the power of which [the partition] collides with the supernal light and rebuffs it [as returning light], is found only in the coronet of Yesod of Ze’er Anpin , which it drew from Mazal ve-Nakeh in the dikna , whereas the Nukba receives from it only an illumination and a branch. Therefore, the main fusion through collision on the partition, which raises the five restraints that extend and enclothe the five givings ( ḥassadim ), the five aforementioned lights, is performed in the Yesod of Ze’er Anpin , and it is [ Ze'er Anpin ] which gives those [lights] to the Nukba . For this reason, [Rabbi Ḥizkiya] specifies that **“that seed,”** which refers to five givings ( ḥassadim ) and five restraints **“exists in the actual sign of the covenant.”** For it is in the sign of the covenant, which is the coronet ( ateret ) of Yesod of Ze’er Anpin , that the full actuality of the restraints that draw forth five givings ( ḥassadim ), which is called “seed,” is found. However, the [level of] Yesod of the Nukba receives only a reflection of the restraints [of Yesod of Ze'er Anpin ], and therefore the Yesod of the Nukba is called only by the name "reflection of the covenant."
**3. And just like the reflection of the covenant was sown in forty-two fusions from that seed, so was the engraved and explicit name seeded with the forty-two letters of the act of creation.**

Explanation: The mystical meaning of the forty-two lettered name [of God] is simple Havaya , and a “filled” Havaya , and a “filled” of a “filled” Havaya , which contain forty-two letters. This will be explained in Marot HaSulam . That seed which is present in the sign of the covenant, which is five givings ( ḥassadim ) and five restraints ( gevurot ), as stated previously, is drawn from the forty-two-letter name [of God].

This the meaning of **“just like the reflection of the covenant,”** which is the Nukba , **“was sown in forty-two fusions from that seed, so was the engraved and explicit name sown in the forty-two letters of the act of creation.”** The explanation: one can discern two aspects in the Nukba : The first is the construction of her partzuf , built by the Bina , which is explained here in the act of the creation. The second is her fusion with Ze’er Anpin , which is called “the secret of the unification.” This is why [the Zohar ] says, **“just like the reflection of the covenant,”** which is the Yesod of Nukba , **“was sown in forty-two fusions from that seed,”** of the sign of the covenant, as this phenomenon is through “the secret of the unification,” i.e., in the mystical meaning of the fusion. Through this you can extrapolate to the order of the emanation of the construction of the Nukba by means of Bina , called “the act of creation,” that it was also in the mystical meaning of the name of forty-two.

As you know, there are two phases in the construction of the Nukba , phases of immaturity and maturity. Now, the immaturity is called “engraved,” which means engravement of a receptacle for the lights of the phase of maturity, as everything that is received by the Nukba at the time of maturity requires preparation and qualification during the phase of immaturity (as stated in section 1, above, in the paragraph beginning “The brains"). [The immature phase] is therefore called “engraved.” [The Nukba 's] phase of maturity is called “explicit,” because everything that was embedded during the phase of immaturity is clarified and becomes known at the time of maturity. This is [Rabbi Ḥizkiya's] meaning when he states: **“So was seeded the engraved and explicit name”** – the Nukba is called “name,” and “engraved” is her immaturity, while “explicit” is her maturity. They too were sown and constructed through the forty-two letters, like the forty-two fusions in “the secret of the unification” in the sign of the covenant. This is why [the Zohar ] says, **“in the forty-two letters of the act of creation”** is the forty-two letters which appear here from Bereshit [“In the beginning”] until the letter bet of va-vohu [“and void,” Genesis 2:2].

**4. “In the beginning. Rabbi Shimon etc.” “In the beginning.” Rabbi Shimon began** [his discourse with the following exposition]: **“The sprouts appeared on the earth**; [the time of singing has come, and the voice of the turtledove is heard in our land” [Song of Songs 2:12]]**. “The flowers” – this** is **the act of creation – “appeared on the earth.” When?** It is **on the third day, as it is stated: “And the earth brought forth”** [Genesis 1:12] **then they appeared on the earth. “The time of singing [ zamir ] has come” – this** is **the fourth day, when there was the pruning [ zamir ] of tyrants,** as this is why it is written on [that day]: “Let there be **lights”** [“ me’orot ”; Genesis 1:14], **without a vav **, which implies a curse [ me’ora ]**. “And the voice of the turtledove” – this** is **the fifth day,** regarding which **it is stated: “Let the waters swarm** with swarms of living creatures, and let fowl fly above the earth in the open firmament of heaven” [Genesis 1:20]**, to produce offspring. “Is heard” – this** is **the sixth day,** regarding which **it is stated: “Let us make man”** [Genesis 1:26], **who in the future will make “doing” precede “hearing,” as it is written here “let us make man,” and it is written there: “We will do and we will hear”** [“ na’aseh ve-nishma ”; Exodus 24:7]. **“In our land” – this** is **the day of Shabbat, which is like the land of the living**, the World-to-Come**.**

The explanation of this: **“The sprouts – this** is **the act of creation.”** That is, the six days of creation, which are the six extremities, Ḥesed , Gevura , Tiferet , Netzaḥ , Hod , and Yesod , of Ze’er Anpin , from which the ten sefirot of the partzuf of Nukba of Ze’er Anpin are constructed. For the Nukba has nothing of its own and its entire construction is from that which Ze’er Anpin gives it. [Rabbi Shimon] proceeds to explain here how the Nukba was gradually constructed from the six extremities of Ze’er Anpin . He states: **“appeared on the earth – when? On the third day,”** for the Nukba is called “earth,” and he says that the sprouts, which are the sefirot of Ze’er Anpin , were received and appeared in the Nukba , which is called “earth,” on the third day of the act of creation. Now, [the past tense of] “appeared” implies that [the sprouts] once appeared in that fashion and now they appear differently. This is why [Rabbi Shimon] asks, “when was this?” and he answers that it was on the third day, which is Tiferet . The meaning is that [the Nukba ] was initially emanated in the mystical meaning of “the two great lights” [Genesis 1:16], at which stage [the Nukba ] was equivalent to Tiferet of Ze’er Anpin . Thus, she was emanated on the third day, together with Tiferet of Ze’er Anpin , which is called the third day of the act of creation. He then states: **“it is like [**the phrase] **'they appeared on the earth,'”** i.e., since this state [of equivalency] would not remain in the Nukba , as [Rabbi Shimon] explains below, the verse therefore says **“appeared on the earth,”** meaning [the past tense], that they appeared once in that form, after which **“the time of pruning has come.”**

**“This is the fourth day, when there was the pruning of tyrants”** – for on the fourth day the moon, which is the Nukba of Ze’er Anpin , was diminished, as the Sages said that the moon complained, saying that it is impossible for two kings to use a single crown, and the Holy One, Blessed be He, said to her: “Go and diminish yourself” [ Ḥullin 60b]. [ Nukba ] then descended into a point under the Yesod of Ze’er Anpin , and her lower nine [ sefirot ] fell into Beria , such that [ Nukba ] was left with nothing in Atzilut other than the point of her Keter , while she was positioned under the Yesod . From here onward, she is gradually constructed by Netzaḥ and Hod of Ze’er Anpin , as Rabbi Shimon proceeds to explain. This is called **“the pruning of tyrants,”** because the diminishing becomes a preparation and a receptacle for receiving the brains of ḥaya , as these brains cut off all of the kelippot that hold onto the Nukba . Zamir [“pruning”] is an expression of cutting off, while **“tyrants”** are the externalities and the kelippot that surround the rose.

He then states: **“And the voice of the turtledove – this is the fifth day.”** The turtledove is Netzaḥ of Ze’er Anpin , while “the voice of the turtledove” is Hod of Ze’er Anpin , and that is the fifth day of the act of creation. Since Nukba receives from the Hod which is incorporated in Netzaḥ of Ze’er Anpin , this reception is therefore called “the voice of the turtledove.”

[Rabbi Shimon] proceeds: **“Is heard – this is the sixth day.”** In other words, the voice of the turtledove is received into the Nukba only by means of the sixth day, which is Yesod of Ze’er Anpin that incorporates Netzaḥ and Hod together and gives them to Nukba . Accordingly, [Rabbi Shimon] states that it is heard by the Nukba only on the sixth day. This is the rule: The Nukba receives only from the middle line of Ze’er Anpin , which is Da'at , Tiferet , and Yesod [together], or [individually] from either Da'at , Tiferet , or Yesod .

**“As it is written, ‘Let us make man,” who in the future will precede ‘doing’ to ‘hearing.’”** “Hearing” is the mystical meaning of Bina , as seeing and hearing are Ḥokhma and Bina , while “doing” is the mystical meaning of Malkhut . It is known, with regard to the mystical meaning of the second constriction, that the lower heh ascended to the apertures of the eyes, in order for [ Malkhut ] to participate with the attribute of mercy which is the supernal Bina . Thus, the father removed the mother outside, while the father himself was established like a male and female. For the eyes are the mystical meaning of the father, and by virtue of the ascent of the lower heh to him, the fusion through collision of the head was at the lower heh , which is called the apertures of the eyes. As a consequence, the mother, which is Bina , left the head for the body. This is the mystical meaning of the fact that in Arikh Anpin there is only Keter and Ḥokhma in its head, while Bina emerged to the body.

The result is that “doing,” which is the lower heh , Malkhut , precedes “hearing,” which is Bina . This is the mystical meaning of the statement in the Tikkunim [69]: “‘I am sleeping’ [ yeshena , Song of Songs 5:2] is certainly second [ sheniyah ] to Ḥokhma ”; see there. For the father is established with a Nukba which is called “I [ ani ],” and the Nukba became like the father, the second sefira after Keter . [The Tikkunim ] expounds that yeshenah [sleeping] has the same letters as sheniyah [second], and “I am [ ani ] sleeping” is like “I am [ ani ] second”; see there.

On account of the ascent of the Malkhut to the apertures of the eyes, she became greatly tempered there, and she subsequently became fit to ascend and enclothe the Abba and Imma Ila'in , and to receive the brains, which are the brains of ḥaya , like the [the partzuf ] of the supernal mother. This is the mystical meaning of the moon in its fullness. Therefore, at the giving of the Torah, Israel said “we will do” before “we will hear,” and [thus] they made “doing” precede “hearing.” They thereby merited to receive the Torah [see Shabbat 89b]. The “doing,” which is Malkhut , ascended and enclothed the Abba and Imma Ila'in , and the mystical meaning of the Jubilee was revealed, which is the fiftieth gate.

This is the meaning of the statement here that the hearing was therefore on the sixth day, as it was on that [day] that this rectification was performed, to make “doing” precede “hearing,” as at the Giving of the Torah. Consequently, the Malkhut on the [first] Shabbat of Creation became like “the land of the living,” which is the mystical meaning of the [ partzuf of the] supernal mother, as [Rabbi Shimon] proceeds to explain. This topic is extremely profound; see the Marot HaSulam here, where we elaborate on this matter.

**“In our land – this is the day of Shabbat, which is like the land of the living.”** The supernal mother is called “the land of the living.” By means of that which was bestowed on the sixth day, the Nukba ascended on the Shabbat of Bereshit , [the seventh day of Creation] up to the supernal mother, and the Nukba also became like the land of the living. For this is the rule – if a lower entity ascends to a higher one, it becomes exactly like it.

**5. An alternative explanation: The flowers, these are etc. An alternative explanation: “The flowers”** [Song of Songs 2:12] – **these are the Patriarchs, who entered into thought and entered into the World-to-Come,** which is Bina , **and were concealed there. From there, they emerged in concealment and were hidden in the true prophets. Joseph was born, and they were hidden in him. Joseph entered the Holy Land and established them there, and then they “appeared on the earth” and were revealed there. When are** they **seen? When the rainbow is seen in the world. For when the rainbow is seen in the world, then they are revealed. And at that hour, “the time of pruning has come,”** that is, **the time to chop off the wicked from the world. Why were they spared? Because “the flowers appeared on the earth.” Had they not appeared already, they would not have remained in the world, and the world would not have survived.**

Explanation: Here [Rabbi Shimon] explains the verse cited above, with regard to the attainment of the brains of ḥaya of Ze’er Anpin itself. He says that the flowers surround Ḥesed , Gevura , and Tiferet of Ze’er Anpin , which are called the Patriarchs. For the Netzaḥ , Hod , and Yesod of Ze’er Anpin are called “sons,” and they are two partzufim that are split apart on the chest of Ze’er Anpin , since Ḥesed , Gevura , and Tiferet are called the large [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba , while Netzaḥ , Hod , and Yesod are called the small [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba . [Rabbi Shimon] is therefore precise in telling us that [he is discussing] the large [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba , which is why he says **“Patriarchs.”** They are called “flowers,” which means sprouts, because they progressively grow, like sprouts. Their level was initially like Netzaḥ , Hod , and Yesod , and subsequently they became [of the level of] Ḥesed , Gevura , and Tiferet , through the drawing in [of light in infancy], after which, in the first maturity, they became [the level of] Ḥokhma , Bina , and Da'at of neshama , and then, in the second maturity, they became Ḥokhma , Bina , and Da'at of ḥaya .

He then states: **“Entered in thought and entered into the World-to-Come.”** This is referring to the gestation of Ze’er Anpin , since at the time of its gestation it ascends to Abba and Imma (father and mother), which is called “thought” and “the World-to-Come”; the father is called “thought” and the mother is called “the World-to-Come.” The beginning of the construction of Ze’er Anpin in “three within three” occurs there, meaning that that Ḥesed , Gevura , and Tiferet are enclothed within Netzaḥ , Hod , and Yesod . This is the mystical meaning of [the statement]: “The sprouts were like antenna of grasshoppers” – they were uprooted from there, planted elsewhere, and grew. The plantings are the Patriarchs, as stated, who, at their root, are Ḥesed , Gevura , and Tiferet . Through their ascent for purposes of gestation into Ḥokhma and Bina , that is, when they are planted elsewhere, these [aspects of Ze'er Anpin ] obtained there the tempered Malkhut , which is fit for brains at the time of maturity. They thereby grew slowly through gestation, and subsequently through infancy, and then through the first maturity, and finally through the second maturity, as [Rabbi Shimon] proceeds to explain. The meaning of **“from there, they emerged in concealment”** is that after Ḥesed , Gevura , and Tiferet receive all the brains of gestation, they are born and emerge from Abba and Imma to their place below, **“and emerge in concealment,”** since even after their emergence from Abba and Imma to their place they still remained in concealment, that is, in diminished light.

[Rabbi Shimon] continues: **“And were hidden in the true prophets.”** In other words, through the attainment of the brains of infancy, the designated light is drawn to the sefirot of Netzaḥ , Hod , and Yesod of Ze’er Anpin , which are called **“the true prophets.** Then the Ḥesed , Gevura , and Tiferet spread forth from the Netzaḥ , Hod , and Yesod , and Ze'er Anpin attained the six extremities. And yet, [the six extremities] remain hidden, as they are still concealed from the [the first three sefirot , which are the] brains of the head, and they have only [the lights of] nefesh and ruaḥ alone. This is why [Rabbi Shimon] stated **“and were hidden within the true prophets.”** The true prophets are Netzaḥ and Hod , [the vessels] that were attained through infancy, but [the Patriarchs] were hidden in them and their light was still concealed and not revealed. Know that there is always an inverse relation between vessels and lights. This is because in the case of the lights, the light of Ḥesed , Gevura , and Tiferet , which is ruaḥ , is attained through infancy, whereas in the case of the vessels, the vessels of Netzaḥ and Hod are attained through infancy, and the light of nefesh that was in Ḥesed , Gevura , and Tiferet , descends in them. Similarly, with regard to the brains of maturity, in relation to the lights, it is considered that the lights of Ḥokhma , Bina , and Da'at have been attained, whereas in relation to the vessels, it is considered that the vessel of Yesod of maturity has been attained, as stated below.

This [preceding statement] is what [Rabbi Shimon] meant when he said: **“Joseph was born, and they were hidden in him.”** After the completion of the brains of infancy, Ze’er Anpin ascends for a second gestation for the brains of the first maturity. Through these brains, [ Ze'er Anpin 's infancy,] Ḥesed , Gevura , and Tiferet become Ḥokhma , Bina , and Da'at , [forming] the head [of Ze'er Anpin ], and the Netzaḥ , Hod , and Yesod that [ Ze'er Anpin ] acquired through infancy become Ḥesed , Gevura , and Tiferet for [the Ze'er Anpin ]. New [vessels of] Netzaḥ , Hod , and Yesod are born, which are called “ Netzaḥ , Hod , and Yesod of the brains of maturity.” Those [ sefirot of] Netzaḥ , Hod , and Yesod are called Joseph, who is the Yesod of maturity, which incorporates Netzaḥ and Hod of maturity. This is the meaning of **“Joseph was born,”** i.e., the Yesod of maturity.

[Rabbi Shimon] says **“and they were hidden in him”** to teach us that Ḥesed , Gevura , and Tiferet still do not have the complete lights of maturity and they remain in concealment [from the complete lights]. This is because in the first maturity Ze'er Anpin obtains only the brains of neshama , which are still considered the back in relation to Ze’er Anpin . He therefore says that **“they were hidden in him,”** i.e., they remained in concealment.

[Rabbi Shimon] continues: **“Joseph entered the Holy Land and established them.”** After the brains of the first maturity, Ze’er Anpin begins to receive the brains of the second maturity, which are the brains of ḥaya . The Nukba is subsequently excised from Ze'er Anpin and is constructed as a whole partzuf with the brains of ḥaya . Then, the Nukba is called **“the Holy Land,”** because the brains of ḥaya are called “holy.” [Rabbi Shimon] thus said that Joseph, who is the Yesod of the maturity of Ze’er Anpin , **“entered the Holy Land,”** which is the Nukba ,**[**when it is] face-to-face with Ze’er Anpin , at an equal level. **“And established them there”** means specifically in the "Holy Land," since the brains of ḥaya , which is the mystical meaning of Ḥokhma , are drawn out only at the time of fusion, when [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba are in the mystical [state of] of oneness. The [brains of ḥaya ] remain only in the domain of the Nukba , since [the Nukba ] is the cause of the drawing down of [these lights] during the time of copulation. That is why [Rabbi Shimon] states “**and established them there,”** i.e., in her home. The reason [why these lights remain only with Nukba ] is that the quality of Ze’er Anpin with respect to the Nukba is like the quality of the Abba and Imma Ila'in with respect to Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna . Consequently, the brains of ḥaya , the light of Ḥokhma , is revealed only in Nukba , which is considered Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna [in relation to Ze'er Anpin ]. This is the meaning of the ensuing statement, **“and then they appeared on the earth and were revealed there.”** In other words, they are now revealed in the proper quality of maturity, but until now they were considered hidden and concealed.

[The Zohar ] continues: **“When are they seen** etc.” One should not ask: But he already explained this earlier, that they are revealed when Joseph ascends to the Holy Land, that is, at the time of the copulation, and he also informed us that the place of the manifestation is in the Nukba , and if so, why does he again ask, **“when are they seen”**? The explanation is that even at the time of the copulation there are two aspects, as there is the incorporation of the left in the right, i.e., in the mystical meaning of the five givings ( ḥassadim ) in the male, and there is the incorporation of the right in the left, in the mystical meaning of the five restraints in the Nukba . He therefore asks when they are seen, whether in the mystical meaning of the incorporation of the right in the left, or in the mystical meaning of the incorporation of the left in the right.

He answers: **“When the rainbow is seen in the world.** The **“rainbow”** is Yesod of Ze’er Anpin ; **“in the world”** means the Nukba , which is the incorporation of the right in the left at the time of the fusion, in the mystical meaning of “I have set My bow in the cloud etc.” [Genesis 9:13]. He is saying that the higher brains are drawn only from that aspect, and this is the meaning of **“then they are revealed,”** i.e., only from the incorporation of the right in the left.

[Rabbi Shimon] continues: **“And at that hour, the time of pruning has come, the time to chop off the wicked from the world.”** When the wicked multiply in the world, on whose account the kelippot and the Sitra Aḥara have gained a strong footing, as occurred in the time of the generation of the flood – on account of which every living thing was wiped out – at that stage, the inhabitants of the world have no remedy other than through the revelation of the aforementioned supernal brains, which are the brains of ḥaya , as [Rabbi Shimon] proceeds to explain. The clause **“why were they spared – because the flowers appeared”** means the following: Why are people spared destruction, as occurred in the days of the flood? It is because **“**the flowers appeared on the earth.” [This refers to how] the revelation of the brains of ḥaya remove the kelippot from the earth, which is Malkhut , and [the kelippot ] no longer have a hold upon it. This is the mystical meaning of the verse: “And I will look upon it, that I may remember the everlasting covenant” [Genesis 9:16].

[Rabbi Shimon] continues: **“Had they not appeared, they would not have remained in the world** etc.” There is a great secret here. For the Nukba was initially constructed in the mystical meaning of the two great lights, at which time the Nukba had an equal level to Ze’er Anpin . However, [ Nukba ] stands at the back of Ze’er Anpin , which is why the moon complained that two kings cannot use a single crown. Therefore, these brains [attained by Ze'er Anpin and Nukba in that state] are considered the brains of the back, and they are accordingly called the brains of the six extremities of Nukba , which are the brains of her immaturity, i.e., [the brains of] her initial formation. At that time, [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba are considered “small faces,” and they are called “children,” “youths,” and “youngsters.” However, once Nukba has been completed with these brains [of the back], she returns for a second gestation to the Abba and Imma Ila'in , and then [the Nukba ] is built as a major structure, with the brains of the face-to-face with Ze’er Anpin , and then they are called the “large faces.” It is known that there is no change or loss in the spiritual, and [thus] those [previously attained] brains of the back, the small face, remain in [ Nukba ] even at the time of the brains of maturity. Furthermore, the cause of the drawing down of the aforementioned brains of ḥaya lies primarily in the vessels of the brains of the back in the mystical meaning of the small face. And this is the meaning of: **“Had they not appeared already, they would not have remained in the world.”** That is, had those flowers [representing the brains of the back] not appeared in the Nukba already at the time of her immaturity, i.e., in the construction of her back, the brains of ḥaya would not have remained in [the Nukba ] during the time of maturity either, since she would have had no vessels in which to receive them.

**6. “And who sustains the world etc.” And who** is that who **sustains the world and causes the Patriarchs to be revealed?** It is **the sound of children engaged in the Torah, and on account of these children of the world, the world is saved. Corresponding to them,** it is stated: **“We will make you circlets of gold”** [Song of Songs 1:11] **– these are children, lads, and youngsters, as it is stated: “And you shall make two cherubim of gold”** [Exodus 25:18].

Explanation: The **“children of the world”** are the brains of the back that were mentioned just above, which are called the “small face.” Likewise, the **“children of the world,”** as well as the **“children, lads, and youngsters”** [refers to the brains of the back]. The aspect of their fusion in this state is called **“the sound of children engaged in the Torah.”** This is the mystical meaning of the **“circlets of gold,”** and the mystical meaning of the **“two cherubim,”** which are the “small face,” without which these brains of ḥaya , which are drawn through the mystical meaning of the incorporation of right in left, would not be received in the Nukba whatsoever. All of this was explained just previously. This is why [Rabbi Shimon] states: **“Who is that who sustains the world,”** i.e., at the time of increase of the kelippot , which have the power to destroy the world as in the days of the flood. There is no remedy [for this destruction] except by drawing the brains of ḥaya in the mystical meaning of the rainbow in the cloud, as stated, since through this, **“the world is saved.”** And who is that who sustains and saves the world at that time, **“and causes the Patriarchs to be revealed,”** causing the manifestation of Ḥesed , Gevura , and Tiferet in the mystical meaning of the brains of the head, when Ḥesed , Gevura , and Tiferet become Ḥokhma , Bina , and Da'at of ḥaya ? [Rabbi Shimon] says that the cause of all this is **“the sound of children engaged in the Torah,”** that is, the brains of the back, which is the mystical meaning of the sound of the children and the circlets of gold.

**7. “In the beginning. Rabbi Elazar etc.” “In the beginning.” Rabbi Elazar began** [his discourse with the following exposition]: **“Lift up your eyes on high and see: who [ mi ] has created these”** [Isaiah 40:26]. **“Lift up your eyes on high” –** he asks: **To which place?** He answers: **To the place where all eyes turn. And what is that?** [It is] **the opening of the eyes**, which is Malkhut of the head of Arikh Anpin **. There you will know that this hidden ancient one, to whom the question applies, “has created these.” And who is** [the one who created these]**? He is the one called Mi ** [“Who”?]**,** which is the seven lower [ sefirot ] of Bina , **that which is called, “from the edge of the heavens above,” and all lies in its demesnes. And since the** [concept of] **question refers to this** [aspect of the sefirot of Bina ]**, and this is concealed, it is called Mi **, the language of questioning**. For above this** [level]**, there are no questions. This edge of the heavens**, where the question is found, **is called Mi .**

Explanation: **“Rabbi Elazar began” –** his purpose is to clarify the interpretation of the creation of heaven and earth that appears in the Biblical account of Bereshit . For heaven and earth are the totality of the seven days of creation, which are the Ze’er [ Anpin ] and Nukba of Atzilut . If so, why is it written “ bara [“created”], which is Beria rather than Atzilut ; it should have said he’etzil (emanated). He then says: **“And what is that? The opening of the eyes.”** The Malkhut of the head of Arikh Anpin of Atzilut is called **“the opening of the eyes,”** as the sefira of Ḥokhma from the ten sefirot of the head is called “eyes.” As is known, there are only Keter and Ḥokhma in the head of Arikh Anpin , and therefore its Malkhut is called “the opening of the eyes,” since with its opening the brains of Ḥokhma flow from the head of Arikh Anpin to all the partzufim of Atzilut . This is why [Rabbi Elazar] states **“to the place where all eyes turn,”** as the brains of Ḥokhma are called “eyes,” and there are no brains of Ḥokhma in all of the partzufim of Atzilut , except by opening the Malkhut of the head of Arikh Anpin .

**“There you will know” –** i.e., at the opening of the eyes, which is the Malkhut of the head of Arikh Anpin . There you will know this secret, how the Bina created the [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba , as the word bara means lebar [“outside of”] the level of Atzilut . Since Bina herself emerged to outside of the level of the head of Arikh Anpin , and thereby became considered Beria , in relation to the head of Arikh Anpin , it must be [the case] that she created the [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba as well. The [ partzuf ] of Ze’er Anpin became Yetzira , because what emerges from Beria is called Yetzira , and the Nukba became Asiya , since whatever emerges from Yetzira is called Asiya . However, they must not be compared to the actual Beria , Yetzira , and Asiya , which are below the diaphragm of Atzilut , because these [ partzufim of] Bina and [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba are positioned above the diaphragm in the world of Atzilut . Rather, it refers to [them as Beria relative] only to the head of Arikh Anpin . Therefore, there are two kinds of Beria , Yetzira , and Asiya : The first is a Beria , Yetzira , and Asiya of separation, which were separated from all of Atzilut through the diaphragm, which is the floor of the world of Atzilut that is positioned over [those lower worlds] from above. The second is Beria , Yetzira , and Asiya of the world of Atzilut itself, which are the Bina , Ze’er Anpin , and Nukba . These [ partzufim ] are only outside of the head of Arikh Anpin , and they are still Atzilut , except that the diaphragm inside the intestine of Arikh Anpin , at the place of its chest, is positioned over them from above. For this reason, these [ partzufim ] are separated from the head of Arikh Anpin and are considered a body without a head. That is, the [lower partzufim of Atzilut ] lack the brains of Ḥokhma , which is called a head, with respect to the world of Atzilut . This is because the world of Atzilut is usually considered Ḥokhma of all four worlds: Atzilut , Beria , Yetzira , and Asiya , and therefore that which lacks Ḥokhma there is regarded as a body without a head.

The meaning of **“that this hidden ancient one** etc. **has created these”** is as follows: The Bina that emerged from the head of Arikh Anpin from the force of the Nukba that ascended to Ḥokhma of Arikh Anpin , where [the Nukba ] formed an endpoint of the head of Arikh Anpin – as this is why [ Bina ] emerged to Beria and the body of Arikh Anpin , as stated – [this Bina ] is therefore divided into two aspects: The first three [ sefirot ] on their own, and the lower seven [ sefirot ] on their own. The reason is that it is not in the nature of the Bina , in her source of the ten sefirot of the direct light, to receive Ḥokhma at all, but only the light of giving, in the mystical meaning of the verse “because He delights in Ḥesed ” [“mercy”; Micah 7:18] – and not [the light of] Ḥokhma (see Petiḥa leḤokhmat HaKabbala , section 5). Therefore, the emergence [of Bina ] to the body does not impair [ Bina ] at all, since even when [ Bina ] is in the head of Arikh Anpin , [ Bina ] does not receive [the light of] Ḥokhma from there. Thus, [ Bina ] is not lessened at all on account of her position below the Malkhut of the head of Arikh Anpin , and now too [ Bina ] is fully considered a head, and it is as though she never emerged from the head of Arikh Anpin . The first three sefirot of Bina are established in the mystical meaning of Abba and Imma Ila'in , who enclothe Arikh Anpin from the mouth to the chest. The second aspect [of Bina ], which is the lower seven [ sefirot ] of Bina , are from the incorporation of [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba in Bina , which are the roots of [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba that are in Bina . These [lower seven sefirot ] therefore require the illumination of [the light of] Ḥokhma for the [lower partzufim of Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba , and consequently these [lower seven sefirot of Bina ] were impaired by their positioning in the body of Arikh Anpin , for they became devoid of [the light of] Ḥokhma , and these [lower seven] are considered Beria and six extremities without a head. It is with regard to them that it is stated that "the father removed the mother outside," i.e., outside of the head of Arikh Anpin . These [lower seven] are called Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna , and they enclothe Arikh Anpin from the chest to the navel, while their sons, [the partzufim of Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba , enclothe from the navel and below, of Arikh Anpin , until the end of the world of Atzilut . This is the mystical meaning of the diaphragm that is inside the intestine of Arikh Anpin , which is positioned at his chest. For [this diaphragm] is the force of the Malkhut of the head of Arikh Anpin , which ejects the lower seven [ sefirot ] of Bina outside of the head and disrupts them from receiving [the light of] Ḥokhma . For although this partition is positioned at the mouth of the head of Arikh Anpin , nevertheless it does not effect [change] there in any way, since the Abba and Imma Ila'in are positioned there [below the mouth], and they are the first three [ sefirot ] of Bina , which are still considered the head of Arikh Anpin , for the reason stated above. Accordingly, it is only at the place of the chest, i.e., above the lower seven of Bina , that the power of the partition has impact, removing the lower seven of Bina that are underneath it, to outside of the head of Arikh Anpin . Remember this.

Therefore, the first three [ sefirot ] of Bina are called **“this hidden ancient one,”** as the head of Arikh Anpin is called “the holy ancient one.” Since the first three [ sefirot ] of Bina are considered as though they are still positioned at the head of Arikh Anpin , despite being [positioned] below the mouth of Arikh Anpin , these [first three sefirot ] are therefore also called ancient, like the head of Arikh Anpin . However, on account of their position in the body of Arikh Anpin , they are called “hidden ancient one.”

This is why [Rabbi Elazar] states **“that this hidden ancient one, to whom the question applies, has created these,”** i.e., only the lower seven [ sefirot ] of this hidden ancient one, which are called Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna , **“to whom the question applies,”** that is, to receive the [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba within them by raising the feminine waters. This is because the “question” refers to the ascent of the feminine waters, as in the phrase “we ask for rain” [ Ta’anit 1:1]. He is saying that only the lower seven [ sefirot ] of this hidden ancient one, which are called Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna , are ready for the question, i.e., to receive the feminine waters in order to draw forth the light of Ḥokhma , since [these lower seven sefirot of Bina ] are devoid of [the light of] Ḥokhma . Before that [these lower seven sefirot ] are considered Beria , and therefore [ Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna ] **“created these,”** which are the [ Ze’er Anpin and Nukba , known as “these.” [ Ze’er Anpin and Nukba ] were also created, in their strengths, devoid of a head, like [ Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna ]. For the word bara indicates the lack of a head with respect to Atzilut . This is why [Rabbi Elazar] states: **“And who is this? It is the one called Mi ** [Who]**.** The lower seven [ sefirot ] of Bina , which are ready for a question [of feminine waters], are called Mi , and the word bara refers to them, as stated, since they themselves became Beria , on account of the diaphragm of the chest of Arikh Anpin , which separates [the lower seven sefirot of Bina ] from the illumination of the head of Arikh Anpin , as stated. This is why [Rabbi Elazar] says: **“From the edge of the heavens above, and who is in possession of everything.”** The lower seven of Bina , which are called Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna , and are called Mi , are considered **“from the edge of the heavens above,”** since the heavens are Ze’er Anpin , and he receives only from Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna , which is called ** Mi **. Therefore, Mi is called **“from the edge of the heavens above, and all lies in its demesnes,”** as the heaven and earth, which are [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba , and similarly the lower three worlds of Beria , Yetzira , and Asiya , all receive from this Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna , which is called Mi . Consequently, “all lies in its demesnes.”

This is why [Rabbi Elazar] says: **“Above this there are no questions, and this edge of the heavens is called Mi .”** In other words, above, i.e., the first three [ sefirot ] of Bina , which are the [ partzuf ] of Abba and Imma Ila'in , **“there are no questions,”** as these [first three] do not receive the feminine waters for drawing forth [the light of] Ḥokhma , since the [first three] are only the light of giving and they do not lack Ḥokhma , and therefore they are not called Mi . The [first three] are also not considered the **“edge of the heavens,”** because they are not at the behest of the request of [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba [through feminine waters] for the illumination of [the light of] Ḥokhma . It is only the lower seven [ sefirot ], which are Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna , which are established to [receive] the question – i.e., to receive the feminine waters from the [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba , and to ascend to the head of Arikh Anpin to receive the illumination of Ḥokhma on their behalf – that are therefore regarded as “the edge of the heavens above,” because the Ze’er Anpin , which is called “heaven,” receives from them.

**8. “And there is another one, below etc.” And there is another one, below, which is called Ma ** [“What?”]**. What is the difference between this one and that one?** He answers: **[Regarding] the first, hidden one, called Mi , a question applies to it. [Regarding the second], since the person questioned and investigated, to examine and know from one level to another until the end of all levels,** which is Malkhut , **once he has arrived there,** that is ** Ma ,** meaning: **“What did you know?” “What did you observe?” “What did you investigate?” Yet, everything is as concealed as before.** Mefashpesh means “investigate,” as ḥeker [“searched out”; Job 8:8] is translated into Aramaic as pishpesh .

Explanation: The Nukba of Ze’er Anpin , when it is with Ze’er Anpin [in a state of] face-to-face, is also called ** Ma **, just like Ze’er Anpin . [The Nukba ] is [also] considered “the lower edge of the heavens,” since it is the end of all the levels and is the endpoint of Atzilut . It follows that Ze’er Anpin , which is called “heavens,” is positioned between the [the partzuf of] Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna , which is called “the upper edge of the heavens,” and the Nukba , which is called “the lower edge of the heavens.” [Rabbi Elazar] thus states: **“Since man questioned and investigates, to observe.” “To observe [ le-istakala ]”** is referring to the coupling of Abba and Imma , which is called the gazing [ histaklut ] of Abba and Imma at each other as a result of their ascent to the head of Arikh Anpin . At that stage, the Bina returns to receive the illumination of Ḥokhma for the [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba . The reason is that even Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna , which are the seven lower [ sefirot ] of Bina , do not need the illumination of Ḥokhma for themselves, since with respect to themselves the seven lower ones of Bina are similar to the first three [ sefirot of Bina ] and [thus] do not need to receive [the light of] Ḥokhma . Nevertheless, when the [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba ascend as feminine waters to Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna , Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna awaken for [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba ] to ascend to the head of Arikh Anpin and receive [the light of] Ḥokhma . However, even the [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba do not ascend as feminine waters to Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna , except through the ascent of feminine waters from the people of the lower levels to the [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba . The process is that the souls of people ascend as feminine waters to the [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba , and then the [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba ascend as feminine waters to Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna , and Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna ascend to Arikh Anpin and become one partzuf with Abba and Imma Ila'in . At that stage, Abba and Imma Ila'in gaze at each other and draw forth [the light of] Ḥokhma for the [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba .

Accordingly, [Rabbi Elazar] states: **“Since man questioned,”** meaning [man] raised feminine waters, **“and investigates,”** that is, [man] investigates his actions in order to raise the [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba for the coupling of [ Abba and Imma Ila'in ], i.e., **“to examine [ le-istakala ],”** in order that Abba and Imma will gaze [ yistaklu ] at each other and draw forth [the light of] Ḥokhma . **“And to know from one level to another until the end of all levels.”** For the illumination of Ḥokhma that is drawn forth through the ascent of feminine waters and fusion, as stated, is called “knowledge [ yedi’a ]” or “ Ḥokhma by means of Da'at as the [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba that ascend as feminine waters are there considered Da'at for Abba and Imma Ila'in , as [ Ze’er Anpin and Nukba ] cause their coupling. [This] fusion is called “knowledge,” as in the phrase: “And the man knew Eve his wife” [Genesis 4:1]. [Rabbi Elazar] states: **“And to know,**” i.e., to draw forth the brains [of Ḥokhma ] in the mystical meaning of the Da'at , **“from one level to another,”** from Da'at of the level of [ Abba and Imma Ila'in ] to the brains of the level of Ze’er Anpin . **“Until the end of all levels**” – from Ze’er Anpin to the Nukba , which is called “the end of all levels.” The meaning of the ascent of feminine waters (see Petiḥa leḤokhmat HaKabbala , sections 94 and 85) is that Bina is positioned back-to-back with Ḥokhma , as [ Bina ] is only the aspect of [the light of giving], and only turns to be face-to-face with Ḥokhma for the sake of [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba ; see there.

[Rabbi Elazar] says: **“Once it has arrived there, it is Ma .”** Once the brains arrive there, to the Nukba of Ze’er Anpin , the Nukba is called Ma . She is called by this [name] for the reason explained in the Zohar ( Teruma 127a): “**The lower level, which is the mystical meaning of the lower world, is called Ma , and we learned: Do not read ma but me’a , since all the upper levels are in their wholeness here.”** Thus, [ Nukba ] is necessarily called Ma , to indicate that the total wholeness of those brains comes only after the brains have arrived at the Nukba . He adds: **“What did you know; what did you observe; what did you investigate? After all, everything is as concealed as before.”** This is also explained in that passage of the Zohar in Teruma : **“Furthermore, why is she called Ma ? Even though the drawing down of the supernal [light] that was drawn is not revealed until it is completed here, as this is the place of the end of all the levels, the destination of all the drawn down [supernal light], where it stands revealed. [Yet] although it is more revealed [there] than [in] any [of the other levels], it is ready for the question [of] ‘ Ma ?’ ‘What did you see?’ ‘What did you know?’ as it is said: ‘For you saw no manner of form’** [Deuteronomy 4:15]**”**

You can see from the words of the Zohar that although the higher brains have already been drawn to [ Nukba ] through the ascent of feminine waters, and [the Nukba ] was already completed through [those brains], nevertheless, [ Nukba ] is still poised for a question, just like Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna were before the ascent of feminine waters. This is also the meaning of Rabbi Elazar’s statement here: **What did you know; what did you observe; what did you investigate? After all, everything is as concealed as before,”** i.e., similar to the words of the Zohar in Teruma , that after the ascent of feminine waters and the drawing forth of the brains, everything remains concealed within the Nukba , as it was before the ascent of feminine waters. That is, [the Nukba ] is still ready for a question, meaning the ascent of the feminine waters (as stated in the last paragraph of section 7, above).

These ideas require explanation: If [this is the case, that the light remains concealed in Nukba ], what is the utility of the lower [beings] raising feminine waters, and why were the brains drawn to [ Nukba ], if they are not revealed at all? Furthermore, it is stated there in the Zohar in Teruma , with regard to the first reason as to why the Nukba is called Ma , that it is the mystical meaning of “do not read ma but me’a ” [ Menaḥot 43b], which is the mystical meaning of one hundred blessings that the Nukba gives to the lower [levels]. Accordingly, how can it be said that the Nukba is still poised for a question, and everything is concealed as it was before?

The meaning is that there are two aspects of the brains of maturity in the Nukba , which are called “the first maturity” and “the second maturity.” In the first maturity, only Abba and Imma Ila'in ascend to the head of Arikh Anpin , not Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna . Although they become one partzuf , Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna still remained in the body of Arikh Anpin , only [ Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna ] ascended to the previous position of [ Abba and Imma Ila'in >>], i.e., it enclothes from the mouth to the chest of Arikh Anpin . Therefore, on the one hand, Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna became the aspect of the head of Arikh Anpin , since it became one partzuf with Abba and Imma Ila'in that are now positioned at the head of Arikh Anpin , and likewise [ Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna ] ascended above the diaphragm of the chest of Arikh Anpin , where the head of Arikh Anpin illuminates, in the manner that was explained earlier again, despite still being below the mouth. (see above, third paragraph of section 7) with regard to [ Abba and Imma Ila'in ] themselves, who were positioned there even before the ascent of the feminine waters. As a result, [ Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna ] transmit completed brains of the first three [ sefirot of Ze'er Anpin ] to the Ze’er Anpin , and the Ze’er Anpin to the Nukba , and the Nukba becomes the mystical meaning of one hundred blessings, as stated. For by means of these brains, the [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba are elevated and ascend to the position Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna was in before the ascent of the feminine waters, i.e., from the chest to the navel of Arikh Anpin . The Nukba is thus in the place of the Imma ("mother"), and therefore the Nukba becomes the mystical meaning of "one hundred," like the Imma , because the aspect of "one hundred" is in the Imma , while [the aspect of] "thousands" is in the Abba ("father"), and the lower [entity] that ascends to the upper entity] becomes like it, as is known.

However, on the other hand, the Nukba is only similar to Mi , which is poised for a question, i.e., precisely as Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna was before the ascent of feminine waters and the drawing forth of the brains. This is due to [ Nukba ] enclothing the place [where] Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna [was during the period] of immaturity, i.e., from the chest to the navel of Arikh Anpin . [The Nukba ] is thus positioned below the diaphragm that is within the intestine of Arikh Anpin , and the illumination of the head of Arikh Anpin stops above this diaphragm, as stated above (third paragraph of section 7; see there carefully). Consequently, from this position the Nukba did not attain the brains and head of Arikh Anpin , for which all the ascents of feminine waters occurred, and everything is as concealed as before, as it was prior to the ascent of feminine waters. However, from a different perspective, the Nukba gained the aspect of the Imma (mother), as [the Nukba ] ascended to the place of Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna , which is called Imma , and this is the mystical meaning of one hundred blessings, as stated above.

For this reason, these brains [of the first maturity] are considered only the six extremities of maturity, since [the Nukba ] cannot receive the head of maturity, as [the Nukba ] is below the diaphragm of the chest of Arikh Anpin , as stated. However, [ Nukba ] level is now equal to that of Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna when [ Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna ] is of the level of six extremities, before the ascent of feminine waters, when [ Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna ] was positioned from the chest to the navel of Arikh Anpin . This is certainly a significant maturity for the Nukba , but it is [only] the six extremities of maturity and [the Nukba ] still lacks the [lights] of the first three [ sefirot ] of maturity. The attainment of the first three of maturity is called “the second maturity of the Nukba .” This will be explained below in the section “Who created these, of Elijah.”

You can now thoroughly understand the meaning of the Zohar in Teruma cited above, with regard to the two reasons it presents as to why the Nukba is called Ma . In the first reason, [the Zohar ] explains the higher brains that the Nukba attained, which are called “one hundred blessings.” This is why [the Sages] said, “do not read ma but me’a .” This [mystical state of "one hundred blessings was attained] by means of the ascent of [the Nukba ] to the position of Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna through the strength of these [higher] brains. The second reason emphasizes that even so, since [the Nukba ] ascended only to the place of Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna of immaturity, meaning, where [ Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna ] was still poised for a question, which is from the chest to the navel of Arikh Anpin , it follows that the [attained higher] brains of Nukba are completely similar to [that partzuf of Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna ] as well, and the Nukba establishes [itself in] the state of being poised for a question. [This state] means [the Nukba has] the six extremities without the first three [ sefirot of the head]. However, the distance [of Nukba from Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna ] is admittedly very significant, because [ Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna ] is the six extremities of Abba and Imma Ila'in , i.e., the six extremities of maturity. Likewise, when it is stated in this section as well: “What did you know, and what etc. After all, everything is as concealed as before,” the phrase “as before” does not mean as the Nukba was before the ascent of feminine waters. Rather it means as Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna were before the ascent of feminine waters. However, the Nukba gained much through the ascent of feminine waters. [The Nukba ] now received the aspect of the Imma (mother), which is the mystical meaning of one hundred blessings, only they are the six extremities of maturity and [the Nukba ] thus remains [in the state of] poised for a question, like Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna [was] before the ascent of the feminine waters. Understand this well.

**9. “And with regard to this secret etc.” And with regard to this secret, it is stated: “What shall I take to testify to you? What shall I liken to you”** [Lamentations 2:13]. **For when the Temple was destroyed, a Divine Voice emerged and declared: What [ ma ] shall I take to testify to you, and what [ ma ] shall I liken to you? That is, I shall take that ma to testify to you.** For **on each and every day I testified to you from the ancient days, as it is stated: “I call heaven and earth to witness against you this day”** [Deuteronomy 4:26]**. “What shall I take to testify to you?” – in that very same manner, I crowned you with holy crowns and granted you his dominion over the world, as it is stated: “Is this the city that men called the perfection of beauty,** the joy of the whole earth?” [Lamentations 2:15]**. I called you “Jerusalem, which is built as a city that is compact together”** [Psalms 122:3]**. “What shall I liken to you” – just as you sit, so it is above, as it were**, i.e., in the Jerusalem above**. Just as now, the holy people do not enter you in holy formations, so I swear to you that I will not enter above until your armies [ akhlusekh ] enter you below. This is your comfort, since I equate you to that level,** i.e., to the Jerusalem above, which is Malkhut , **in everything. And now that you are here, “your breach is great as the sea”** [Lamentations 2:13]**. And if you say that you have no existence and healing, “who [ mi ] can heal you?”** [Lamentations 2:13], **meaning, it is that concealed, supernal level, called Mi , by which everything exists,** which is Bina , **which will heal you and raise you up.** “ Akhlusekh ” means the troops of your armies, as gedud [troop] is translated into Aramaic as ukhlasa [Job 19:12].

The explanation of these things: The destruction of the Temple occurred because Israel committed the sin of idolatry. They were unwilling to raise up feminine waters for the coupling of [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba . Instead, they wished to draw the shefa to the Sitra Aḥara , which is called “other gods.” For this reason, that coupling of [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba was broken and the one hundred blessings were lost from the Nukba , and the Temple was destroyed.

[The Zohar ] thus says: **“A voice emerged and declared: What shall I take to testify to you** etc. **on each and every day I testified to you from the ancient days.”** These [days] are the six extremities of [the state of] maturity that the Nukba receives in the mystical meaning of Ma , as stated above. They are called “ancient days,” and this is the mystical meaning of the verse: “For ask now of the days past, [which were before you, since the day that God created man upon the earth,] and from one edge of heaven to the other” [Deuteronomy 4:32]. These [days] are called by this name because they are the six extremities of [ Abba and Imma Ila'in ], since the Yisrael Saba and Tevuna is the lower seven [ sefirot ] of [ Abba and Imma Ila'in ] (section 7, third paragraph; see there). The seven days of Abba and Imma are the first ones for the seven days of [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba , **“as it is stated: I call heaven and earth to witness against you this day.”** For this verse, which is written there in that chapter [Deuteronomy 4:26], is referring to the coupling of [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba , which are called heaven and earth. The verse is warning about the preservation and maintaining of the coupling, as otherwise, the verse warns, “you shall soon utterly perish from off the land etc.” This is the mystical meaning of: “What [ ma ] shall I take to testify to you” – I warned you with regard to those one hundred blessings, to preserve and perform them, and you violated them. Therefore, [the verse] “you shall soon utterly perish from off the land etc.” was fulfilled in you.

Accordingly, the Zohar says: **“What shall I take to testify to you? – in that very same manner, I crowned you with holy crowns** etc. **as a city that is compact together.”** For these one hundred blessings that the Nukba receives from the Ze’er Anpin in the fusion of Ma , are [achieved] in [ Ze'er Anpin and Nukba 's] ascent to [the place of] Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna . There, the Ze’er Anpin becomes the aspect of Yisrael Sabba , and the Nukba becomes the aspect of Tevuna , at which point the lights [of the Nukba ] become the mystical meaning of one hundred blessings, like the lights of Tevuna , as stated. With regard to this, the verse states: **“As a city that is compact together,”** because the Nukba , which is called a city, has combined together with the Tevuna , and thus the Nukba has become the aspect of [the level of] Tevuna . [The Nukba ] receives from there the brains of Tevuna , which are called “holy crowns,” and she is subsequently called “the perfection of beauty, the joy of the whole earth,” and she receives **“his dominion over the world.”**

[The Zohar ] thus says: **“What shall I liken to you – as you sit,”** meaning, on account of Israel’s sin, which caused the Temple to be destroyed and [Israel] to be exiled from their land, they also thereby caused the withdrawal of the Nukba , as her nine lower [ sefirot ] fell to the kelippot and [the Nukba ] returned to the [state of being a] point under the Yesod . [The Zohar ] thus states: **“What [ ma ] shall I liken to you** etc.” and adds: **“who [ mi ] can heal you?”** That is, if the children of Israel repent, rectify their deeds, and raise up feminine waters to [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba , then the supernal brains will once again be drawn to the [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba , and the Nukba will again ascend to Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna , which is called ** Mi **, and then you, [the Nukba ,] will be healed.

**10. “ Mi is the edge of the heavens etc.”  Mi is the edge of the heavens above**, which is Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna ; ** Ma is the edge of the heavens below**, which is Malkhut **. This is what Jacob inherited,** who is Ze’er Anpin , **who “passes through from edge to edge”** [Exodus 26:28] **– from the first edge, which is Mi , to the last edge, which is Ma , as [ Ze'er Anpin ] is positioned in the middle**, between Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna and Malkhut **. Therefore, “who has created these** [ eleh ,” Isaiah 40:26]**.** As Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna , who are called Mi ("who"), created Ze’er Anpin and Malkhut , which are called eleh .

Explanation: It would seem that the verse should have said “from the top of heaven to the [bottom] edge of heaven.” Why does it say, “from one edge to the other edge” [Deuteronomy 4:32], implying from end to end, which does not mean anything? He therefore states: **“ Mi is the edge of the heavens above,”** i.e., Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna , which is poised for a question and which enclothes from the chest to the navel of Arikh Anpin . ** Ma ** is the Nukba before the ascent of feminine waters, which is the end of all the levels from the chest of Ze’er Anpin and below. Jacob is positioned between [ Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna and Nukba ] – he is Ze’er Anpin , who starts to enclothe from the place of the navel of Arikh Anpin until the Nukba , which means he passes from the end of Mi [the bottom of Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna ] to the end of Ma [the top of Nukba , the partzuf of Malkhut ]. For the Mi concludes at the navel of Arikh Anpin , where Jacob begins, as stated, and the Nukba , which is Ma , is positioned at his conclusion, as stated.

However, the verse is speaking [of the stage] after the drawing of the brains to [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba , as it written, at the start of the verse: “For ask now of the days past etc.” [Deuteronomy 4:32]. This is referring to the time when the [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba ascend and receive the brains of Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna , which are called “the days past,” as stated. For then, the edge of the heavens below, which is Ma , i.e., the Nukba , ascends and enclothes at the edge of the heavens above, that is, on the Mi , which is Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna , and thus they are literally both in one place. This is why the verse states “from edge to edge” [Deuteronomy 4:32], as they have both now become the aspect of one edge of heaven. For the Ze’er Anpin receives “the days past,” which are six extremities from Yisrael Sabba : Ḥesed , Gevura , Tiferet , Netzaḥ , Hod , and Yesod , while the Nukba takes Tevuna , i.e., the Malkhut of Bina , which is now at the edge of Ze’er Anpin , called “heaven.” However, with respect to the quality that precedes the brains, she is considered the head of heaven.

There is also a second explanation [of the verse]: The heavens above is Yisrael Sabba , which incorporates the six first days, which are Ḥesed , Gevura , Tiferet , Netzaḥ , Hod , and Yesod of Bina . The edge of the heavens above is the Tevuna , which is the Malkhut of Bina . The verse should thus be understood as follows: From the edge of Yisrael Sabba to the edge of Ze’er Anpin , which is called “the heavens below.”

[The Zohar ] thus states: **“Regarding who has created these.”** That is, it is in reference to these brains that the verse states **“who [ mi ] has created these,”** for ** Mi ** is Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna , which is positioned in the place of Beria of Arikh Anpin , i.e., from the chest to the navel, below the diaphragm that is inside the intestine of Arikh Anpin , since the illumination of the head of Arikh Anpin no longer reaches there (as stated above, in section 7, third paragraph; see there). This is why [that region] is considered Beria , i.e., outside [ bar ] of the head of Arikh Anpin , and therefore [ Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna ] is poised for a question. Thus, once the [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba attain the brains [of this region], by ascending and enclothing this Mi and taking its place from the chest to the navel of Arikh Anpin , their brains, too, are now only Beria of Arikh Anpin . This is the meaning of the verse: “**Who [ Mi ] has created [ bara ] these,”** i.e., the [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba took the brains of Beria from the Mi .

**11. “Rabbi Shimon said etc.” Rabbi Shimon said: Elazar my son, stop talking and you will discover the sealed, supernal secret that the people of the world do not know. Rabbi Elazar was silent. Rabbi Shimon wept and stood for a moment. Rabbi Shimon said: Elazar, what is eleh ? If you say that it is the stars and the constellations, they are always visible. They were created with Ma ,** which is Malkhut , **as it is stated: “By the word of the Lord were the heavens made”** [Psalms 33:6], i.e., the heavens were made with Malkhut , which is called “the word of the Lord**.**” And **if [the word]** eleh **was said in reference to sealed matters, it was not necessary to have written eleh [regarding the stars and constellations], as** the stars and the constellations **are revealed.**

Explanation: Rabbi Elazar revealed here only the brains of the first maturity, whereas Rabbi Shimon wanted to reveal the mystical meaning of the brains of the second maturity, which is the supernal brains of ḥaya . [Rabbi Shimon] therefore instructed [Rabbi Elazar] to stop talking and he would reveal to him the sealed, supernal secret that the people of the world do not know, as these brains were not yet revealed in the world, and Rabbi Shimon revealed them here.

[Rabbi Shimon] thus states: **“What is eleh ? If you say that it is the stars and the constellations** etc.” Rabbi Shimon asked him, what is eleh ? What novelty is the verse teaching us, when it states: “who [ Mi ] has created these” [Isaiah 40:26], which are the [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba ?
