If you say that it is the stars and the constellations, meaning, [it is] with regard to the brains of the six extremities of maturity that [ Ze’er Anpin and Nukba ] attained, and that the verse “who [ Mi ] has created these” is referring to that – since the brains of the six extremities are called “stars and constellations” – [Rabbi Shimon] raised a difficulty against this claim: What novelty is this, as **they are always visible**, i.e., they are the regular brains of [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba which can always be drawn forth, meaning even on weekdays, and these [brains] are not such a novelty that the verse “who [ Mi ] has created these” would apply to them.

Nor can it be explained that these brains are always in effect, without pause, as that is not the case, for Ze’er Anpin only routinely has six extremities without a head, and it is only through the raising of feminine waters and prayer that these brains are drawn forth. Rather, the meaning is as stated above, that they can always be drawn forth, i.e., even on weekdays, as they are in fact drawn forth every day at the time of the Morning Prayer. [Rabbi Shimon] raises a further difficulty to him: **“And with what [ Ma ] were they created?”** For these brains are not linked to Bina but to the [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba of Atzilut , which is called Ma , for [these brains] emerged from them, as it is stated: **“By the word of the Lord,”** which [refers to] Ze’er Anpin and its Nukba ; the Ze’er Anpin is called **“the Lord,”** while Nukba is called **“the word.”**

**12. “However, this secret etc.” However, this secret was revealed only on a certain day when I was on the shore of the sea, and Elijah came and said to me: Rabbi, do you know who has created these? I replied: These are the heavens and their hosts, the work of the Holy One, blessed be He, for people should look at them and bless Him, as it is stated: “When I behold Your heavens, the work of Your fingers,** [the moon and the stars…] **O Lord, our Lord, how glorious is Your name in all the earth”** [Psalms 8:4, 10].

**13. “He said to me: Rabbi etc.” [Elijah] said to me: Rabbi, there was a sealed matter before the Holy One, blessed be He, and He revealed it in the assembly above, and it is as follows: When the most sealed of all that are sealed wished to be revealed, He initially made a single dot,** which is Malkhut , **and this ascended to become a thought,** which is Bina , i.e., the Malkhut ascended and was incorporated in Bina . **He depicted all of the pictures in it; he engraved all of the engravings in it.**

The explanation: The partzuf of Atik is the first head of the world of Atzilut , and it is called “the most sealed of all that are sealed.” With regard to [ Atik ], they stated ( Idra Rabba , 174): **“Any head of a people that is not rectified first, his people are not rectified. From where do we learn this? From the Atik Yomin , since as long as it was not rectified in its rectifications, all those who need rectification were not rectified and all the worlds were destroyed.”** It is likewise taught ( Idra Zuta , 74): **“We learned: When the holy Atika , the most sealed of all that are sealed, wished to be rectified, it rectified everything as male and female** etc. Likewise: **As this Ḥokhma spread and Bina emerged from it, and they are found to be male and female**,**”** and this is the mystical meaning of the rectification of the second constriction.

This is what he is clarifying here when he says: **“When the most sealed of all that are sealed wished to be revealed, He made in the head a single dot.”** For when the holy Atika wished to be revealed to the worlds, through the force of the rectification that was rectified in the second constriction, **“he made in the head”** of Arikh Anpin , i.e., in the Ḥokhma [of Arikh Anpin ], **“a single dot.”** That is, [ Atik ] raised the Malkhut , which is called a dot, to the [place] of Arikh Anpin . There, the Nukba that raises the returning light was established, to enclothe the ten sefirot of the head of Arikh Anpin , and the head of Arikh Anpin became concluded at the sefira of the sealed Ḥokhma . And the Ḥokhma **“was found to be”** like **“male and female,”** and Bina and [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba of the head of Arikh Anpin emerged to the outside of the head, i.e., to the level of the body of Arikh Anpin . This is the mystical meaning of **“ Ḥokhma spread and Bina emerged from it,”** that is, Ḥokhma removed [ Bina ] to the body.

He then says: **“And this ascended to become a thought.”** In other words, this dot of Malkhut that ascended to Ḥokhma – and by means of which the Ḥokhma was established as male and female – it ascended on this account and became a thought, i.e., Bina , which is called a thought. The reason is simple – since [this dot] stands in a state of fusion with Ḥokhma , it receives from Ḥokhma , and that which receives from Ḥokhma is considered Bina , not Malkhut . Thus, even though [the dot] is Malkhut from its root, the aspect of a dot, on account of its ascent it has become Bina . This is the meaning of: **“And this ascended to become a thought,”** as this caused the dot to become Bina , which is called a thought.

You should know that in the Zohar the term “thought” sometimes refers to Ḥokhma and sometimes to Bina . The reason is that “thought” means the Nukba of Ḥokhma , and therefore it can be called by the name of Ḥokhma , since it is the Nukba of Ḥokhma . However, with regard to [thought's] own nature, it is Bina rather than Ḥokhma , as stated. Additionally, Bina is only called by the name "thought" when it is the head together with the Ḥokhma . Keep this in mind.

This is what is meant by **“he depicted all of the pictures in it; he engraved all of the engravings in it.”** Through this dot which ascended to become a thought, he depicted and carved all five partzufim of Atzilut , which are Arikh Anpin , Abba and Imma (father and mother), and [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba . That which it says **“depicted in it”** and **“engraved in it”** is alluding to a great matter: **“Depicted in it”** means that all the pictures, which are the five partzufim of Atzilut were emanated through it. That is, by means of the [fusion though collision] performed on the partition of this dot that ascended to become a “thought,” the level of the six extremities of the returning light and direct light in the vessels of Keter and Ḥokhma emerged in each partzuf . By contrast, **“he engraved all of the engravings in it”** refers to deficiency, that is, with the ascent of the dot to become a thought, deficiencies and engravings were formed, which are preparations for the aspect of a receptacle upon the lights in all the partzufim of Atzilut . Since this matter is the foundation of all the brains of Atzilut , it must be thoroughly clarified.

The meaning is that the ascent of the dot to the aspect of thought, which is Bina , leads to the formation of a new conclusion to the ten sefirot of each level. The dot, which is the mystical meaning of Malkhut with the partition upon it – which was positioned for a [fusion through collision] at the place of Malkhut of the ten sefirot of the head, called “mouth,” and concluded the head there – now ascended to the place of Bina of the head, which is called the apertures of the eyes, i.e., Nukba of Ḥokhma , which is Bina . The [fusion through collision] was performed on the partition [of Malkhut ], there in the place of the apertures of the eyes, concluding the head there. And the three sefirot : Bina , Ze’er Anpin , and Malkhut of the head, which are called “ear, nose, mouth,” descended below the place of the conclusion of the head, i.e., to the level of the body. In the same manner, this necessarily transpired in the ten sefirot of the body as well. The Malkhut that concludes the body of the partzuf , which previously stood at the place of the middle point – which is Malkhut of the ten sefirot of the body, called “the end of the legs” – now ascended to the place of Bina of the body, called Tiferet (since Ḥesed , Gevura , and Tiferet of the body are Keter , Ḥokhma , and Bina ), and concluded the body there at Tiferet , in the place of the chest. These three sefirot : Bina , and [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba of the body, which are called Tiferet , Netzaḥ , Hod , Yesod , and Malkhut , emerged from Atzilut and fell into the level of Beria , Yetzira , and Asiya of separation.

Thus, on account of the ascent of the dot to become a thought, each level was split into two halves, with the upper half, Keter and Ḥokhma , remaining in the level, while Bina , Ze’er Anpin and Nukba of each level were lost from [the level] and descended to the level below. This is the mystical meaning of the division of the name Elohim into [the letters] Mi Eleh . A complete level of ten sefirot of Keter , Ḥokhma , Bina , Ze’er [ Anpin ] and Nukba is called by the holy name of Elohim , which consists of five letters corresponding to the five sefirot of Keter , Ḥokhma , Bina , [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba : Alef - lamed-heh are Keter , Ḥokhma , and Bina , while yod - mem are [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba . Now, after each level has been divided into two halves, with Keter and Ḥokhma remaining, and Bina , [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba falling from it, as stated, it follows that only the two letters Mi remained in each level, while the three letters of Eleh fell from each level to the level below.

One should not ask: According to this, shouldn’t the two letters alef - lamed [ el ] have remained in the level, while the [letters] yod-heh-mem should have fallen from it to the level below? The reason is that there is a consistent inverse relationship between the vessels and the lights. This is the rule: In the case of the vessels, the higher ones come first, i.e., first comes the vessel of Keter , then the vessel of Ḥokhma ,... until lastly the vessel of Malkhut . It is the reverse in the case of the lights; with regard to them, the lower ones come first: First comes the light of Malkhut , then the light of Ze’er Anpin , then the light of Bina ,... until lastly the light of Keter . Therefore, if of the vessels there are only the two vessels of Keter and Ḥokhma , they contain only two of the lights, the light of Malkhut and the light of Ze’er Anpin , which are called the six extremities. Consequently, we can discern that only the two letters mem - yod [ Mi ] remained in the level, which are the mystical meaning of the light of Malkhut and the light of Ze’er Anpin of the name Elohim . But the three letters alef - lamed-heh [ eleh ] fell from them, and therefore each level became lacking in its first three.

This is the meaning of the statement: **“He depicted all of the pictures in it; he engraved all of the engravings in it.”** This is alluding to the division of each level into two halves through the force of the ascent of the dot to become a thought. **“He depicted all of the pictures in it,”** i.e., on the two letters mem - yod [ Mi ] that remain in the level, he depicted the picture of the direct light. **“He engraved all of the engravings in it,”** i.e., the three letters alef - lamed-heh [ eleh ], which fell from each level and became lacking in [the levels], since on account of their absence only the light of Malkhut and the light of Ze’er Anpin remained in the level, whereas the three lights of Keter , Ḥokhma , and Bina are lacking in them, since there is no light without a vessel. Thus, if the levels were to obtain once again the vessels of Bina and [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba , the [levels] would immediately obtain the first three of lights as well, for one depends on the other. Keep in mind these matters that have been clarified here, as they are the basis for the entire wisdom.

**14. “And he engraved within the lamp etc.” And he engraved within the holy, sealed lamp**, which is the Malkhut that is incorporated within Bina , **an engraving of one sealed picture, holy of holies,** which is **a deep structure that emerges from the thought**, the mystical meaning of the first three**. It is called Mi , which is the beginning of the structure. It stands and does not stand; it is deep and sealed in the name** Elohim **, and it is not yet called anything except Mi ** of Elohim , i.e., it lacks the letters alef - lamed-heh [ eleh ] of the name Elohim **. He wished to be revealed and called by this name** of Elohim , **and Hhe enclothed Himself in a precious garment that illuminates**, which is the light of giving. **[He] created these [ eleh ] and** the letters of ** eleh ascended into the name** Elohim **,** as **the letters combined with each other,** i.e., the letters mem - yod [ Mi ] with the letters alef - lamed-heh [ eleh ], **and the name Elohim was completed. As long as He did not create eleh , it did not ascend to the name Elohim . Those who sinned with the calf said about this secret: “This [ eleh ] is your god, O Israel”** [Exodus 32:4].

The explanation: By means of the ascent of feminine waters from the lower realms, a new light was drawn forth from Ab and Sag of Adam Kadmon . This light from Ab and Sag of Adam Kadmon is [from] above the aforementioned second constriction which split each level into two. Therefore, when this light is drawn forth to the head of Arikh Anpin , it once again lowers the dot from the thought, which is the place of Bina , back to her place, to the place of Malkhut of the head, as it was before the second constriction. And the three sefirot : Bina , Ze’er Anpin , and Malkhut , which fell from the head, revert to the head, for the [fusion through collision] was performed in the place of the Malkhut , which is below them. It is discerned that the name Elohim was revealed once again, since the three letters alef - lamed-heh [ eleh ] rejoined the mem - yod [ Mi ] in one level, and the name Elohim was completed in the level. And since Bina and [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba of the vessels returned [to the level], the first three of lights also returned, as stated, and Keter , Ḥokhma , Bina , [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba of lights were enclothed in the five letters of the name Elohim : The lights of Keter , Ḥokhma , and Bina , in alef - lamed-heh ; and the lights of [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba in yod - mem .

Remember this well, that the fallen alef - lamed-heh are the vessels of Bina and [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba that are missing from the level. However, when the alef - lamed-heh combine in the name Elohim , they become lights of Keter , Ḥokhma , and Bina , on account of the inverse relationship between the vessels and the lights, as stated. This is the meaning of the statement: **“And he engraved in the holy, sealed lamp,”** that is, a partition and a place for a [fusion through collision] was engraved afresh in the Malkhut of the head of Arikh Anpin , which is called “the holy, sealed lamp.” It is **“an engraving of one sealed picture, holy of holies,”** as this new engraving draws forth one picture, i.e., a height of ten sefirot , which is holy of holies, the height of the first three, which is called “holy of holies.” Because it **“emerges from the thought”** – since this dot that ascended to become a thought has once again emerged now from a thought and arrived at its true place, the place of the Malkhut of the head – the three vessels: Bina , Ze’er Anpin , and Nukba , which are eleh , have therefore now returned to the level of the head, and the name Elohim was completed there. The reason why he calls this height of the first three [ sefirot ] by the name of **“sealed picture”** will be explained below.

This is why it says: **“It is called Mi , the beginning of the structure.”** In other words, even though alef - lamed-heh have already combined with mem - yod , and the name Elohim was formed, as stated, it is still called only Mi . It is “the beginning of the structure,” the start of the construction of the name Elohim , because the structure is not yet complete, as [the Zohar ] proceeds to explain.

He thus says: **“It stands and does not stand.”** That is, on the one hand, the structure is already standing fully complete, since the place of the [fusion through collision] returned to its place at the mouth of the head,” and Bina and [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba returned to the level, and similarly the first three of lights [returned], and the name Elohim was completed. However, on the other hand, the structure of the name is still not standing, because **“it is deep and sealed in the name.”** In other words, the lights of the name Elohim are still deep and sealed, and do not illuminate in eleh , which are Bina and [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba that ascended to the place of the head. The reason is that due to their ascent to the head of Arikh Anpin , where only Ḥokhma illuminates, there is only light of Ḥokhma at this level. And since [ Ze'er Anpin and Nukba ] are the lower seven [ sefirot ], and [ sefirot of the] lower seven that ascended are unable to receive the [light of] Ḥokhma without being enclothed within the [light of giving], and there is no [light of giving] there, therefore [these lower seven] cannot receive the [light of] Ḥokhma either. Consequently, it is regarded that the name is **“deep and sealed”** and does not yet spread in the three letters alef - lamed-heh . For this reason, the structure of this level is still considered “not standing,” and alef - lamed-heh are as yet not revealed in it. This is why he says that beforehand **“it is called only Mi ,”** since the letters alef - lamed-heh are still hidden in the name Elohim , and there is only mem - yod [ Mi ] there.

[The Zohar ] continues: **“He wished to be revealed and called by name,”** since the name was already complete, because alef - lamed-heh already ascended to the head, and despite this they [still] do not illuminate at all. [The Zohar ] thus says: **“He wished to be revealed and called by this name** of Elohim , **and Hhe enclothed Himself in a precious garment that illuminates.”** This means that since the whole sealing of the name, that it cannot illuminate in eleh , is due to the lack of clothing of [the light of giving], as the lower seven [ sefirot ] cannot receive the [light of] Ḥokhma without [the light of giving], as stated, therefore there was a reversion and performing of the [fusion through collision] of immaturity, like when [the lower seven] were in the body of Arikh Anpin . This drew forth the height of [the light of giving], and the height of [the light of] Ḥokhma was enclothed in the light of giving that was drawn forth. That [light of giving] became **“a precious garment that illuminates”** for that level, such that through this enclothing [of the light of Ḥokhma ] in the [light of giving], it can illuminate the light of Ḥokhma into the lower seven, which are eleh .

[The Zohar ] therefore states: **“Hhe enclothed Himself in a precious garment that illuminates, and created these [ eleh ], and eleh ascended in the name.”** That is, by means of that precious garment, the height of [the light of giving] that was received from the [fusion through collision] of the body below the chest, which is called Beria , **“He created these [ bara eleh ],”** i.e., He bestows that light to eleh , through which **“ eleh ascended in the name.”** Since the [lower seven] have a precious garment from [the light of giving], they can also receive [the light of] Ḥokhma through [the garment]. Then alef - lamed-heh were revealed in the name Elohim , since now the Bina and [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba are illuminating in [the name] in their full, complete state, and it can be discerned that the name of Elohim is now complete and revealed. Thus [the Zohar ] states: **“The letters combined with each other,”** i.e., the letters mem - yod with the letters alef - lamed-heh , **“and the name Elohim was completed,”** since now alef - lamed-heh receive the height of Ḥokhma because they have obtained the clothing of [the light of giving], and all five letters of Elohim illuminate in their fullness. This is the meaning of the statement: **“As long as He did not create eleh , it did not ascend to the name Elohim ,”** since before the mem-yod gave them the light of giving to wear, the alef - lamed-heh could not receive anything from the mem-yod , and only the mem-yod illuminated in Elohim , as stated. [The Zohar ] then says: **“And those who sinned with the calf**… **“This [ eleh ] is your god, O Israel.”** For they damaged that precious garment that illuminates, and therefore the mem-yod separated from the alef - lamed-heh , and accordingly they said: **“This [ eleh ] is your god,”** and the shefa went out to other gods.

**15. “And as Mi combined etc.” And just as Mi combined with eleh ** and they became the name Elohim , by means of the precious garment that illuminates, which is the light of giving, **so too the name always combines** through the precious garment that illuminates**. It is through this secret that the world exists**, as this is the mystical meaning of the verse: “The world is built through giving” [ ḥesed , Psalms 89:3]**. Elijah then flew away and I did not see him. But I knew the matter from him, for I comprehended his secret and concealment. Rabbi Elazar and all the colleagues came and bowed before** [Rabbi Shimon]**. They wept and declared: “If we had come into the world only to hear that, that would have been enough for us.”**

Explanation: In the same manner that was explained that **“it did not ascend to the name Elohim ”** until the height of Ḥokhma was enclothed in the precious garment that illuminates, and then Mi combined with eleh and ascended to the name Elohim , **“so too the name always combines,”** as this is how it exists forever and ever, and it does not otherwise merit the name Elohim . **“It is through this secret that the world exists.”** The lower world as well, which is Nukba , called Ma , receives the brains through this manner of combining Mi with eleh , and it is fully completed like the upper world, as Rabbi Shimon proceeds to explain. This is in opposition to the opinion of Rabbi Elazar, who said with regard to the lower world: **“Once is has arrived there,** [it is] ** Ma ,** [meaning:] **“What [ ma ] did you know?”** etc. **After all, everything is as concealed as before”**; see there [section 8, above]. It turns out that according to [Rabbi Elazar's] opinion, the lower world was not established like the upper world. This is why [Rabbi Shimon] states: **“It is through this secret that the** [lower] **world exists”** in the same manner as the upper world. For this reason, Rabbi Shimon paused from his previous comments. Now, Elijah explained only the order of the brains and the construction of the name Elohim in the Abba and Imma . He did not clarify the order of the structure of Elohim in the Nukba , and that is what Rabbi Shimon himself explains, until the end of the teaching.

**16. “Rabbi Shimon said etc.” Rabbi Shimon said: Therefore, the heavens and their hosts were created with Ma ,** which is Malkhut , **as it is stated: “When I behold Your heavens, the work of Your fingers etc.”** (Psalms 8:4)**, and it is** earlier **written: “How [ Ma ] glorious is Your name in all the earth, whose majesty is rehearsed above the heavens”** (Psalms 8:2)**.** Thus, the heavens were created with the name Ma , which is Malkhut , and the phrase **“above the heavens”** – referring to Bina , called Mi , which is above Ze’er Anpin , termed heavens – means that **it ascends through the name** Elohim **.** That is, Ma , which is Malkhut , ascends and is incorporated in Bina , which is called Elohim , **after He created light for its light**, i.e., after He created the light of giving as a precious garment for the light of Ḥokhma in the name Mi (as stated in section 14, above)**.** Then **they were enclothed in one another and** the Malkhut **ascended through the supernal name** of Elohim , which is the name of Bina , in which Malkhut is incorporated. **Therefore** [it states]: **“In the beginning, Elohim created”** (Genesis 1:1)**, which is the supernal Elohim ,** i.e., Bina rather than Malkhut **. For Ma ,** which is Malkhut , **is not so, and was not constructed** in the mystical meaning of Mi eleh , as we have said**.**

Explanation: Since the lower world, Ma , draws forth the brains of the name Elohim in the upper world, there was therefore the ability for the heavens and their hosts to be constructed by means of Ma , since there are no offspring without these higher brains, which are the brains of ḥaya . [The Zohar ] thus says: **“Therefore,”** since also the lower world, Ma , is perpetuated through the name Elohim from the upper world, **“the heavens and their hosts were created with Ma ”** – there was strength in ** Ma ** to produce these offspring, **“the heavens and their hosts.”**

This is why the verse states: “Whose majesty [ hodekha ] is rehearsed above the heavens,” to teach us that the brains are drawn forth from the name Elohim of Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna by the combination of Mi with eleh , which are above the heavens, [which are] Ze’er Anpin . This is the meaning of the statement: **“Above the heavens** – **it ascends through the name,”** that the Hod , which is the brains, is above the heavens, [meaning] above Ze’er Anpin , which is [the region of] Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna , through which the name Elohim ascends, and that is “Who [ Mi ] has created these [ eleh ],” as stated. However, in heaven itself, which is Ze’er Anpin , there is no Mi there, only Ma , as we have said.

Now, after the height of Ḥokhma was drawn forth, due to the dot that returned and emerged from the thought, a fusion of the level of six extremities was once again performed, to draw forth the light of giving and the light of Ḥokhma was enclothed in the light of giving, and then Mi illuminated in eleh , as stated. This is the meaning of the statement: **“After He created light for its light,”** i.e., the light of giving for the light of Ḥokhma , **“they were enclothed in one another and it ascended by means of the supernal name”** – the light of Ḥokhma was enclothed in the light of giving. Consequently, the brains transitioned from Mi to [the level of] eleh. The letters combined with one another, and ascended as the name of Elohim , as stated. This [process] is **“through the supernal name,”** i.e., above the heavens, from Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna , in which there is Mi , but not in heaven, which is Ma .

He then says: **“ Ma is not so and was not constructed.”** Mi , which is Bina , did not contain any constriction at all from the time of the first constriction, since the constriction was not there, but only on the middle dot, which is Malkhut . [ Malkhut ] was restricted, so as to not receive light in itself, and [ Malkhut ] was established [with a partition] for the mystical meaning of a fusion through collision, in order to raise returning light. However, the first nine were clean of any constriction and were worthy of receiving the light of Ḥokhma . It is only in the second constriction, in order to temper the Malkhut with the attribute of mercy, [which is Bina ], the Malkhut ascended to the Abba [which is Ḥokhma ], and the Abba was established through [the presence of Malkhut ] as male and female, and Malkhut received the place of Bina . And the dot, which is Malkhut , ascended to become a thought, Bina . From that point, Bina was also restricted and was placed with a partition, to avoid receiving the light of Ḥokhma within her, in order to receive the fusion through collision and to raise returning light, as stated.

Thus, in its original [form], Bina was fit to receive Ḥokhma without any constriction. [ Bina ] only received the constriction and partition within itself to temper the Malkhut . Therefore, by raising feminine waters from the lower realms, a new light was drawn forth from Ab and Sag of Adam Kadmon , which lowers the dot [of Malkhut ] back from the place of Bina to its place, to Malkhut , as it was in the first constriction, and the dot emerges from the thought. The Bina is thereby purified from any constriction and once again receives the light of Ḥokhma , as stated above. Once the height [of the light] of Ḥokhma is enclothed in the [light of giving], Mi illuminates in eleh , and the name Elohim is revealed there. Now, this entire construction of the name Elohim is completely impossible in Ma , since the Ma is the edge of the heavens below, which is the Malkhut itself, in which there was constriction at her source, including the first constriction as well, and Malkhut is unfit to receive any illumination of Ḥokhma within her. This is the meaning of the statement: **“ Ma is not so, and was not constructed,”** since the whole construction of the name Elohim is only relevant in Mi , as a result of the return and emergence of [ Malkhut ] from the thought, and not in Ma .

**17. “But when they are drawn forth etc.” But when these letters, eleh , are drawn forth from above,** from Bina , **to below,** to Malkhut **– for the mother lends her garments to the daughter and adorns her with her ornaments –** then the name Elohim extends from Bina , which is the mother, to Malkhut , the daughter. **And when does she adorn her with her ornaments properly?** That is, **when all males appears before her, as** then **it is written** with regard to her: **“Before the Master, God”** (Exodus 23:17)**. Then** the Malkhut **is called “Master**,**”** which is in the masculine form**. As it is stated: “Behold, the ark of the covenant of the Master of all the earth”** (Joshua 3:11)**.** Thus, the verse calls the Malkhut , which is termed “the ark of the covenant,” by the name “the Master of all the earth,” which is a masculine name. This is because Malkhut received the vessels called “garments,” and the brains, which are called “ornaments,” from the mother, which is Bina . **Then** the [letter] ** heh leaves** Ma , **and is replaced by a yod **, and the Malkhut is called Mi , like the Bina . At that time, [ Malkhut ] **is adorned in male garments**, i.e., the garments of Bina , as stated, **corresponding to all the males in Israel** [see Exodus 23:17]**.**

Explanation: As was explained (section 13, above), after **“he made in the head”** of Arikh Anpin **“a single dot, and this ascended to become a thought”** – for the Ḥokhma was established through [the dot] as male and female – then **“he depicted all of the pictures in it,”** as all the levels of the five partzufim of Atzilut were depicted in it, in such a manner that there is only Keter and Ḥokhma in every level, in Arikh Anpin , Abba and Imma (father and mother), and [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba . And **“he engraved all of the engravings in it,”** that through [the dot's] force, the three sefirot : Bina , Ze’er Anpin , and Malkhut , separated from each [of their] levels [and descended] to the level below: Bina , Ze’er Anpin , and Malkhut of Arikh Anpin fell into the [level of] Abba and Imma ; Bina , Ze’er Anpin , and Malkhut of Abba and Imma fell to [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba ; and Bina , Ze’er Anpin , and Malkhut of [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba fell to Beria , Yetzira , and Asiya ; see there.

It was explained in the Sulam there that these two sefirot that remained in the level, which are Keter and Ḥokhma , are called Mi , whereas those three sefirot that were separated from every level are called the three letters alef - lamed-heh [ eleh ].

[The Zohar thus says]: **“When these letters, eleh , are drawn forth from above to below,”** that is, when the dot ascended to become a thought, as stated, and then the three letters alef - lamed-heh separated from Abba and Imma (father and mother) and fell to the level below them, [the level of Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba , as stated. It is then considered that [the letters] alef - lamed-heh of Abba and Imma , which are in [the level of Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba , were drawn from above to below and enclothed within the [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba , since alef - lamed-heh of Abba , which is Yisrael Sabba , was drawn to Ze’er Anpin This represents the male aspect of the male-female paired partzuf structure of, and alef - lamed-heh of Imma , which is Tevuna , was drawn to Nukba .

Thus [the Zohar ] states: **“The mother lends her garments to the daughter and adorns her with her ornaments,”** that is, at the time of the arrival of the brains of maturity, as clarified in the words of Rabbi Shimon above, when **“an engraving of one sealed picture, the holy of holies, a deep structure that emerges from the thought,”** is drawn forth. This means that the dot reverted, emerging from the thought to its place, to Malkhut , as the three vessels: Bina , [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba , were thereby restored to the level, and the three lights of Keter , Ḥokhma , and Bina , which are called **“holy of holies,”** were drawn forth; see there.

Know that when the vessels Bina , [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba , were returned from the body to the head of Arikh Anpin , the Abba and Imma (father and mother) that enclothe them were also drawn with them, and Abba and Imma too ascended to the head of Arikh Anpin , where Abba and Imma received those brains of the holy of holies at the head of Arikh Anpin . The reason [that Abba and Imma also ascended] is that there is a rule that a higher entity which descends to a lower level becomes like [that level], and likewise a lower entity that ascends to a higher level becomes like [that higher level]. Therefore, in the phase of immaturity, when Bina , [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba separate from the head of Arikh Anpin and fall to the body [of Arikh Anpin ] – where they are enclothed by the [ partzuf ] of Abba and Imma from the mouth [of Arikh Anpin ] and below – Bina , [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba of Arikh Anpin become the actual aspect of Abba and Imma . Consequently, in the state of maturity, when Bina , [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba of Arikh Anpin return to the level of the head, they take with them the [aspect of] Abba and Imma as well, for they have already become a single level [with Abba and Imma ] during the phase of immaturity. As a result, in the phase of maturity, Abba and Imma ascend with [ Bina , Ze'er Anpin and Nukba ] to the head of Arikh Anpin because [ Abba and Imma ] became equal to them, and they receive the same brains of the head of Arikh Anpin that are called “holy of holies.”

In the very same manner, the [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba ascend to Abba and Imma , since once Abba and Imma receive the brains of the head of Arikh Anpin , the dot emerges from the thought in them as well, to the place of Malkhut , through which their Bina , [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba are restored to their level [of origin] of Abba and Imma , as stated above with regard to Arikh Anpin . Now, at the same time that the vessels of Bina , [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba [of Abba and Imma ], ascended once again to Abba and Imma , they took with them the [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba that enclothe [the Bina , Ze'er Anpin and Nukba of Abba and Imma ] and the [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba also ascend to [the level of] Abba and Imma , and receive the brains of the holy of holies that are there.

This is the meaning of [the Zohar 's] statement: **“The mother lends her garments to the daughter and adorns her with her ornaments.”** In other words, since the three letters alef - lamed-heh of the mother were drawn to the Nukba in the phase of immaturity, as we said, it is considered that the **“mother lends her garments to the daughter.”** By means of the departure of the three vessels Bina , [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba (which are alef - lamed-heh ) from the mother and their falling into the Nukba , they become actual Nukba , because a higher entity that descends to a lower level becomes like it. It is considered that the mother lent her vessels of eleh to the daughter, which is the Nukba , since now the Nukba is using them. And yet, [the mother] also adorns [the daughter] with her ornaments, i.e., at the phase of maturity, as the three vessels Eleh , [meaning] Bina , and [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba , of the mother return to [ Ze’er Anpin ] and Nukba of the mother, and the Nukba also ascends to the mother with them, as stated. Then the Nukba receives the brains of the holy of holies that are in the mother, since a lower entity that ascends to a higher [level] becomes like it, as stated. It follows that now, since the mother lends her garments of eleh to the daughter at the phase of immaturity, she therefore adorns her with her ornaments (which are the brains) in the phase of maturity, and she is thus adorned with the ornaments of the mother.

**“And when does she adorn her with her ornaments? When it is proper.”** There are two types of ornaments from the mother to the Nukba , which are the brains of the first three [ sefirot ]: Either from the lower mother, called Tevuna , located from the chest of Arikh Anpin and below, or from the higher mother, located from the chest of Arikh Anpin and above. When the Nukba ascends to Tevuna and Tevuna adorns her with her ornaments, it is considered that these ornaments are not yet in their proper state, because then the Nukba is still poised for a question, like the Tevuna before the raising of feminine waters as stated above (section 8, 4th paragraph). Hence, [the ornaments] are not in their proper state. Rather, [it is] when the Nukba ascends to the place of the higher mother, from the chest of Arikh Anpin and above, and the higher mother adorns the Nukba with her ornaments, then her ornaments are considered proper, as [the Zohar ] proceeds to explain.

**“When all males appear before her** etc. **then she is called Master.”** [This is] when the Nukba ascends to Tevuna and receives the brains from her. At this point, the ornaments are not yet in their proper state, for [the Nukba ] is still poised for a question, meaning she still requires the raising of feminine waters in order to be fully complete, as stated. [In this stage] it is considered that the males of Israel receive from Ze’er Anpin , who ascended to Yisrael Sabba . However, when the Nukba ascends to the higher mother, she is fully completed and is no longer poised for a question, i.e., to receive feminine waters. [The Nukba ] is then considered a male, and the males in Israel receive from her.

This is the meaning of [the Zohar 's] statement: **“When all males appear before her,”** i.e., all the males in Israel appear before [ Nukba ] and receive from her, **“then she is called Master [ Adon ],”** that is, she is no longer called by the name of Adonai , which is feminine, but by the masculine name Adon . This is because she is no longer poised for a question, as the dynamic of raising feminine waters no longer applies to her, and therefore [ Nukba ] is considered a male. [The Zohar ] then states: **“Behold, the ark of the covenant of the Master of all the earth”** – the ark is called the Nukba , since the Yesod of Ze’er Anpin , which is called “covenant,” enters her. Thus, the verse calls the Nukba by the name: “Master of all the earth,” which is a male name. [The Zohar ] continues: **“Then heh leaves, and is replaced by a yod .”** In other words, the heh of Ma is removed from [ Ma ], for this heh of Ma indicates being poised for a question, as stated previously, which is: **“What did you know** etc. **After all, everything is as concealed as before”**; see there [section 8]). Thus, the heh of Ma denotes being poised for a question. [The Zohar ] is saying that this heh of Ma is removed from it, and a yod replaces the heh , and [the Nukba ] is [then] called Mi , like the mother. Then [the Nukba ] is constructed in the name Elohim , like the mother.

**18. “The other letters etc.” The other letters**, i.e., alef - lamed-heh , **are drawn forth by Israel from above**, from the Bina , **to this place**, that is, to the Malkhut that is now called by the name of Mi , like the Bina . **“These [ eleh ] things I remember”** (Psalms 42:5) means: **I hereby recall** these letters **in my mouth, and I pour out tears with the desire of my soul, in order to draw forth these letters**, alef - lamed-heh , from the Bina . **Then “I will lead them” from above**, from Bina , **“to the house of Elohim ,”** Malkhut , **so that** Malkhut **will be** called **“ Elohim ,” like** the Bina , which is called Elohim . **And with what** shall I draw them? **“With the voice of joy and praise, a multitude keeping holyday”** (Psalms 42:5). **Rabbi Elazar said: My silence built the Temple above,** which is Bina , **and it built the Temple below**, which is Malkhut **. Certainly,** it is as people say: **“If a word is worth one sela , silence is worth two”** ( Megilla 18a)**. “If a word is worth one sela ” – that which I said and noted. “Silence is worth two” – this is the silence that I maintained, which is worth twice as much, for the two worlds**, Bina and Malkhut , **were built and created together.** Had I not refrained from speaking (as stated in section 11, above), I would not have attained the union of these two worlds.

Explanation: After the heh was removed from Ma , to be replaced by a yod alongside the [letter] mem , so that it is called Mi , then Israel, by raising feminine waters draws forth different letters, i.e., alef - lamed-heh , to this place, i.e. Mi , and the Nukba ascends through the name Elohim . The nature of this drawing forth has already been explained above. Alef - lamed-heh of the higher [level] fall to the lower [level] in the phase of immaturity, and therefore [ Bina , Tiferet and Malkhut ] draw up the lower [level] in the phase of maturity. When the Bina , and Tiferet , and Malkhut of the higher [level] – which are the letters alef - lamed-heh – return to the head of the higher [level], they take the lower [level] with them as well. The lower [level] then acquires the letters alef - lamed-heh and the brains in them, since [the lower level] is together with them in the head of the upper level, as a lower [entity] that ascends to an higher [level] becomes like [that higher level] (as stated in section 17, third paragraph).

[The Zohar ] thus states: **“The other letters**, etc. **These [ eleh ] things I remember** etc. **in order to draw forth these letters.”** This is the mystical meaning of the raising of feminine waters, as Israel raises feminine waters in order to draw forth the brains of maturity by means of drawing the letters alef - lamed-heh of Imma Ila'ah to the Nukba . This is the meaning of the statement: **“These [ eleh ] things I remember,”** i.e., to draw them forth, and therefore **“I recall in my mouth, and I pour out tears with the desire of my soul.”** This is referring to prayer at the gate of tears, which is never returned empty [see Berakhot 32b]. Then, after the feminine waters have been raised, **“I will lead them from above”**; I will draw forth the letters alef - lamed-heh from above, from Abba and Imma (father and mother), to the house of Elohim , meaning, to the Nukba , which is called **“the house of Elohim .”** After the drawing forth of the letters alef - lamed-heh , the Nukba itself is called Elohim . This is the meaning of the statement: **“So that it will be called Elohim , like it,”** i.e., like the mother.

[The Zohar ] thus says: **“If a word is worth one sela , silence is worth two,”** as Rabbi Elazar’s statement raised the Nukba to the Tevuna , which is below the chest of Arikh Anpin , for then [the Nukba ] is still poised for a question, as stated, and is called “a sela .” This is the meaning of the statement: **“If a word is worth one sela .”** However, by means of Rabbi Elazar’s silence, which gave room for Rabbi Shimon to reveal the brains of ḥaya – which is through the ascent of the Nukba to the Imma Ila'ah – two worlds were built as one. The lower world, Nukba , became one with the higher world. This is the meaning of the statement: **“Silence is worth two – for the two worlds were built and created together,”** as the Nukba ascended to Imma [ Ila'ah ] and became a male, like the Imma Ila'ah .

**19. “Rabbi Shimon said etc.” Rabbi Shimon said: From here onwards,** [we have] **the completeness of the text, as it is stated: “The One who brings out by number their host”** (Isaiah 40:26)**.** For **there are two levels, each of which needs to be imprinted**, meaning demarcated**. One is that about which it is stated Ma , and one is Mi . This one**, Mi , **is the higher one, and that one**, Ma , **is the lower one. The higher** level **records and says: “The One who brings out by number their host,”** in which the definite article of **“the One who brings forth”** alludes to **the one who is known and with whom none can compare**, i.e., Mi **. Similarly, “The One who brings forth bread from the earth” –**the definite article of **“the One who brings forth”** alludes to **the one who is known, which is the lower level,** i.e. Ma , **and it is all one.** They are both within a single level, Malkhut , except that the higher one is Mi of Malkhut , whereas the lower one is Ma of Malkhut . “The One who brings out **by number”** means that the number **600,000 are** the stars **that are positioned together, and they bring forth hosts according to their kind, which have no number.**

Explanation: After Scripture hinted to us, with the phrase: “Lift up your eyes on high and see: who [ mi ] has created these [ eleh ]” (Isaiah 40:26), that we should reflect upon the structure of the Nukba in her name Elohim , in which [ Nukba ] draws from Abba and Imma Ila'in – by which the Imma Ila'ah adorns her with her ornaments, as stated – the verse fills in and completes this explanation in its continuation: “The One who brings out by number their host, He calls them all by name; by the greatness of His might, and as He is strong in power, not one is missing,” as Rabbi Shimon proceeds to explain.

He thus states: **“There are two levels, each of which needs to be imprinted.”** “Imprinted” means “demarcated,” by means of the definitive article. Two levels require demarcation in the Nukba , namely the level of Mi and the level of Ma . The brains of the first three that [ Nukba ] receives through her ascent and enclothing of the upper world – through which the Nukba becomes like the upper world itself – is called Mi , since the heh of Ma is removed from it and is replaced by a yod . The Nukba is also called Mi , like the upper world, as she adorns herself with male garments, as stated. However, at the same time, [ Nukba ’s] former level, which is Ma , is not lost from the Nukba . Rather, Ma must also be in [the Nukba ] as before. The reason is as explained above, that the level of Mi is necessary to draw forth the completeness and the aspect of holy of holies to the offspring. But the bearing sons and being fruitful and multiplying depend solely on the name Ma . Therefore, if either of those levels is missing in the Nukba , she will be unfit to propagate.

[The Zohar continues]: **“The upper one records and says: The One who brings out by number their host.”** In other words, the verse states with regard to the level of Mi that the Nukba inherits from the higher world: “The One who brings out by number their host.” The definite article of “the One who brings forth” alludes to the complete brains that [the Nukba ] receives from Abba and Imma Ila'in , which are the aspect of being ornamented in male garments, as mentioned previously, when the heh is removed and the yod enters. This is the meaning of **“The One who brings forth – the one who is known and with whom none can compare,”** as this is the ultimate stature of the brains that operate in the Nukba for 6,000 years. Thus, it is written **“The One who brings forth bread** etc. **which is the lower level, and it is all one.”** That is, the definite article of “the One who brings forth bread” also alludes to the brains of the first three, i.e., **“the one who is known,”** but they are the brains of Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna which the Nukba receives, and is known by them, and this is the level of Ma , as Rabbi Elazar explained earlier. That level must also be imprinted in the Nukba , and this is the meaning of the phrase **“and it is all one,”** i.e., both of them, Mi and Ma , are incorporated in the Nukba together, as one partzuf , this one higher and that one lower.

One should not raise a difficulty from the statement in the Zohar in Parashat Teruma (771) that the phrase “the One who brings out by number their host,” and similarly in any case where the definite article is written, is from the lower world that was more revealed, whereas here it says that it is from the upper world. The explanation is as was written above, that here too it is referring to the revealed world, which is the Nukba of Ze’er Anpin . The reason why [the Zohar here] calls it the “higher one” is because of the level of Mi [within] the Nukba , which [the Nukba ] receives only when it ascends and enclothes the higher world, which is the Imma Ila'ah . It is on this account that [the Zohar ] calls [the aspect of Mi ] the “higher" one,” and it calls the level of Ma of the revealed world the “lower one,” as was written above. As for the statement in Teruma : “Regarding all things that are from the upper, hidden world, the heh is hidden from there,” that is referring to when the revealed world does not ascend and enclothe the higher world, as then the higher world is concealed and does not illuminate to the lower realms. Therefore, [in such a context,] it is not written with the definite article [the letter heh ], as it is hidden. See there, thoroughly.

[That which the Zohar ] states: **“By the number of these 600,000, that are positioned together, and that bring forth hosts after their kind, which have no number.”** “Number [ mispar ]” denotes ultimate completeness, in the mystical meaning of the verse: “The heavens declare [ mesaprim ] the glory of God, and the firmament shows His handiwork” (Psalms 19:2). This is as stated in the Zohar ( Teruma , 185-6): “What is the meaning of ‘declare’ etc. Rather, they illuminate and sparkle in the glitter of the supernal light, and ascend in the name that is incorporated in the brilliance of the supernal completeness etc. As a result, they ascend in a complete name, and they illuminate with a complete light, and they sparkle in a complete sparkle etc.” See there, thoroughly. Thus, “number” indicates the illumination of total completeness. One can understand from here that an incomplete illumination is regarded as a non-number, as something which has no number, which indicates that it lacks the perfection that is termed “number.”

Know that these aforementioned brains of Abba and Imma Ila'in , which the Ze’er Anpin transmits to the Nukba , are the mystical meaning of the verse “the heavens declare the glory of God.” “The heavens” are the mystical meaning of Ze’er Anpin ; “the glory of God” is the Nukba of Ze’er Anpin ; and “declare” is the shefa of the brains of the Abba and Imma Ila'in . These brains are the mystical meaning of the 600,000, as the levels of Nukba are considered units, the [levels] of Ze’er Anpin are tens, those of Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna are hundreds, those of Abba and Imma Ila'in are thousands, and those of Arikh Anpin are tens of thousands. Additionally, there are two aspects in Abba and Imma Ila'in : Relative to themselves, [their levels] are regarded as thousands. Relative to the brains of Ḥokhma that [ Abba and Imma Ila'in ] receive from the head of Arikh Anpin , [the levels in Abba and Imma Ila'in ] are considered tens of thousands, like [ Arikh Anpin ]. However, [ Abba and Imma Ila'in ] are only considered the [level of] six extremities of Arikh Anpin , since [ Abba and Imma Ila'in ] enclothe from the mouth of Arikh Anpin and below. Therefore, regarding the relativity [of the levels] [ Abba and Imma Ila'in ] are only of [the level] of the six extremities of Arikh Anpin which is [itself] tens of thousands. The six extremities are sixty, [thus together] they are the mystical meaning of 600,000. Consequently, when the Nukba ascends and enclothes Abba and Imma Ila'in , [the Nukba receives a complete number, which is 600,000: “Sixty” means the six extremities, since [the Nukba ] still lacks, even then, the head of Arikh Anpin . “Ten thousand” indicates the levels of Arikh Anpin that illuminate into Abba and Imma Ila'in , i.e., into Arikh Anpin ’s six extremities, which are enclothed in Abba and Imma Ila'in . Thus, the Nukba has the number 600,000.

Thus [the Zohar ] states: **“By number – 600,000 are those that are positioned together, and they bring forth hosts after their kind, which have no number.”** It has been explained that two levels, Mi and Ma , are imprinted in the Nukba , as follows: Mi is the mystical meaning of Abba and Imma Ila'in , which enclothe in the Nukba . [The Nukba ] thereby becomes an aspect of the higher world, and in that respect [the Nukba ] then has the mystical meaning of the number 600,000. Ma in the Nukba is the mystical meaning of Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna , which enclothe in the Nukba in the aspect of “poised for the question Ma [‘what?’],” as explained previously. In this respect, the [ Nukba ] has the mystical meaning of the lower world. These two aforementioned levels, Mi and Ma , become one partzuf in her, as from [the Nukba ’s] chest and above, Abba and Imma Ila'in are enclothed in [the Nukba ], and from the chest and downward, [the Nukba ] enclothes Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna . Thus, they are one partzuf in [the Nukba ], as written above, that “it is all one.” Therefore, these two levels are discerned in the offshoots of the Nukba as well. From the perspective of the higher world, the Mi in [ Nukba ] is the mystical meaning of “the One who brings out by number their host,” i.e., **“by the number 600,000.”** From the perspective of the lower world, the Ma in her, the offshoots are regarded as having no number. This is the meaning of the statement: **“And they bring forth hosts after their kind, which have no number.”** That is, [the Nukba ] produces the various types of offshoots without a number, meaning, they do not contain those brains of a number from Abba and Imma Ila'in , but only from Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna , which are without a number.

Perhaps one might say: If so, [the Nukba ’s] offshoots are incomplete because they lack a number. In response, [Rabbi Shimon] says: **“By number – 600,000 are those that are positioned together, and they bring forth hosts** etc.” In other words, those two levels within [the Nukba ], which are a number and without a number, and Tevuna , "without a number") are both within the Nukba . exist in [the Nukba ] together, as they are combined in [the Nukba ] literally in a single level, and therefore these two levels are also found in her offshoots as one [unified level]. On the one hand, the offshoots [of the Nukba ] are considered to be of the number 600,000, while on the other hand they are without a number. As a consequence, the aspect of "without a number" is considered merely as an additional [level of] completeness, not as any kind of deficiency.

The logic [underlying this additional completeness] is that blessing and fruitfully [reproducing] and multiplying with seed are completely dependent upon the aspect of the lower world, Ma , which is considered to be without a number. This is the mystical meaning of the blessing of seed that is presented in the verse: “Look now toward heaven, and count the stars, if you able to count them; and He said to him: So shall your seed be” (Genesis 15:5). Thus, the blessing of seed comes only without a number, i.e., from the name Ma . Therefore, after all the completeness of the brains of a number that [the Nukba ] obtained from Abba and Imma Ila'in [of] Mi , [the Nukba ] has an addition to the blessing from Ma , in the mystical meaning of without a number – **“which have no number.”** She also has a blessing, and both [aspects] are incorporated in the souls and in the offshoots.

**20. “He calls them all, whether etc.” “He calls them all,” whether those sixty** ten thousands [600,000], **or all their hosts,** which have no number, **“by name.” What is “calls them all by name”? If you say that** [it means] **He calls them by their names, that is not so, for in that case it should have said,** “calls **by His name.” Rather, when this level does not ascend through the name** Elohim **, but rather is called Mi ** (as stated in section 14, above)**,** [the level] **does not birth and does not produce what is concealed** in it**, according to their kind, even though they were all concealed in it.** That is, even though the letters alef - lamed-heh have ascended, they still lack the precious garment of the [light of giving], and thus they are concealed and do not merit the name Elohim (as stated in the Sulam , section 14, above). **After He created “these”** [the letters alef - lamed-heh ] **and they ascended through His name,** i.e., they were enclothed in the precious garment of the [light of giving], at this stage eleh combines with Mi , **and** [the total construct] **is called Elohim **, as previously explained**. Then, by the strength of this name, He produced them in completeness. This is: “He calls them by name,”** meaning **by His own name He called and produced each and every kind, to exist through His completeness.** Thus, it is stated: “The One who brings out by number their host, He calls them all by name,” i.e., by the complete name of Elohim . **It is similarly written: “See, I have called by name** [Bezalel the son of Uri,” Exodus 31:2]**,** meaning **I mention My name so that Bezalel will exist in his full existence.**

Explanation: This follows the explanation in the previous section, that the great completeness of the brains – which is the mystical meaning of the name Elohim – resides upon the souls and offshoots [of the Nukba ] in both of its levels together, i.e., both on the level of "sixty ten-thousands" in [ Nukba ] and on the level of "all their hosts which have no number." The name is on both of them, as is alluded in the verse: **“He calls them all by name.”** This is the meaning of the statement: **“ Mi does not birth** etc. **When He created ‘these’** [ alef - lamed-heh ] etc. **by the strength of this name, He produced them in completeness.”** As explained in the adjacent previous section, the blessing of the seed is completely dependent on the name Ma , which has no number. The meaning of this is that the brains of [the level of] number are the illumination of Ḥokhma , which is the mystical meaning of the complete name [of Elohim ], and all of the aspects [of Nukba ] are in complete wholeness. The brains of "without number" that come specifically from the name Ma are the brains of ḥassadim (the light of giving) alone, and as explained above in Elijah’s teaching to Rabbi Shimon, the illumination of Ḥokhma is not received without the precious garment of ḥassadim (the light of giving). Without this [light of giving], even though the letters alef - lamed-heh ascend to Mi , [the Nukba ] still did not ascend through the name Elohim . This is the mystical meaning of: “Who [ Mi ] has created these [ eleh ]” – that He created light of the [light of giving] for the light of Ḥokhma , **“and they were enclothed in one another and it ascended through the supernal name.”**

This is the meaning of his statement here: **“ Mi does not birth and does not produce what is concealed in it, according to their kind, even though they were all concealed in it.”** This is as stated above, that although the dot was already **“extruded from the thought”** to the place of Malkhut , and became an engraving of one picture, the holy of holies, and Bina and Ze’er Anpin and Nukba of the vessels and the first three of the lights returned [to the level], nevertheless they all [remain] concealed. Furthermore, alef - lamed-heh remain deep and concealed in the name, because they cannot receive illumination of Ḥokhma without the [light of giving].

However, **“after He created ‘these’** [ eleh ]**,”** meaning after He further performed a [fusion through collision] upon the partition of [the level of] Ma , which is the lower world, and produced a height of brains of the [light of giving] upon [the partition], [brains] which are called **“without a number,”** [He then] gave it to eleh , all of which is the mystical meaning of “created these.” That is, He placed the garment of the [light of giving] upon the [first three lights], which is called “created.” Then, **“they ascended through His name, and it was called Elohim .”** For now that they have attained the height of the [light of giving], they can receive the illumination of Ḥokhma , which are the brains of the number 600,000. At this point, the letters combine with one another, and ascend through the name and is called Elohim . **“Then, by the strength of this name, He produced them in completeness.”** Consequently, that completeness of the name – which is the enclothing of Ḥokhma in the [light of giving] – is also upon the souls and offshoots that emerged from the name Elohim . **“This is** [the meaning of]**: He calls them by name,”** as the name [of Elohim ] is called upon the offshoots – **“by His own name He called and produced each and every kind, to exist in completeness.”** With this name, He produced the offshoots, both of the kind **“of 600,000,”** as well as of the kind **“which have no number,”** so that they would exist in the completeness of the name, i.e., that they would enclothe one in the other just as [these two aspects] are enclothed [one in the other] in the name. As for the statement, **“See, I have called by name,”** he is bringing a proof from Scripture that the phrase “calling by name” is indicative of existence and wholeness.

**21. “By the greatness of His might etc.”** He asks: **What is “by the greatness of His might”** (Isaiah 40:26)**?** He answers: **This is the head of the levels, upon which all of the desires rise and ascend through it in a concealed manner. “As He is strong in power” is the secret of the upper world,** called Mi , **which ascended in the name Elohim , as we said. “Not one of them is missing” from those 600,000 that He produced through the strength of that name. And since “not one of them is missing”** from the number 600,000, **in any place where Israel died and were punished for their sins, they were** later **counted and none of the 600,000 were missing, not even one, so that all will be in a single image,** both above and below**. Just as “not one of them is missing”** from the number 600,000 **above, so too “not one** of them **is missing”** from this number **below.**

Explanation: **“By the greatness of His might”** alludes to Keter of Abba and Imma Ila'in , which is **“the head of the levels”** of these brains, the mystical meaning of Bina of Arikh Anpin , which became Keter of Abba and Imma Ila'in , as **“all of the desires rise”** there, i.e., all of the levels receive from [this Bina of Arikh Anpin ]. And yet they **“ascend through it in a concealed manner,”** since it is the mystical meaning of “unknown air,” for the yod has not left the air [of Bina ] [ avir ; alef-vav-yod-reish ], as it is the mystical meaning of: “Because He delights in mercy” (Micah 7:18). Therefore, [this Bina ] is in a state of ultimate completeness (as stated above, in Marot HaSulam ), and this is why it is called “pure air.” He is teaching us that although the height of the [light of giving], which is called “air,” emerges upon the lower world, Ma , it is still in a state of ultimate completeness because this light draws from the first three of Bina of Arikh Anpin , which is the head of all the levels of Atzilut , i.e., Abba and Imma Ila'in , Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna , and Ze’er Anpin and Nukba . Therefore, the height of the [light of giving] within [the Nukba ] is also considered pure air, as in the first three of Bina of Arikh Anpin .

He then says: **“‘As He is strong in power,’ is the secret of the upper world,”** i.e., the aspect of Mi in Nukba , from where the number 600,000 is drawn. [The Nukba ] enclothes the upper world, which is Abba and Imma Ila'in , as stated above. This is the meaning of the statement: **“Not one of them is missing, from those 600,000 that He produced through the strength of that name,”** since from there [the Nukba ] attains the brains of the number 600,000, as stated. He adds: **“Just as not one of them is missing above, so too not one is missing below”** – since the Nukba enclothed Abba and Imma Ila'in , in the mystical meaning of **“the mother lends her garments to the daughter and adorns her with her ornaments”** (as stated), [the Nukba ] therefore became completely like Abba and Imma Ila'in . And just as the brains of Abba and Imma Ila'in are complete in the mystical meaning of the number 600,000, and “not one of them is missing,” so too the Nukba is complete in that number, and “not one of them is missing.”

**22. “ Bereshit , Rav Hamnuna etc.”  Bereshit ** [“In the beginning”]. **Rav Hamnuna Saba said: We have found** in the words Bereshit bara Elohim et [“In the beginning God created”], **an inverse order of** their **letters. First,** it writes ** bet , and then** [another] ** bet , that is, Bereshit bara , next** it writes ** alef , and then** [another] ** alef , that is, Elohim et .** He answers: **When the Holy One, blessed be He, wished to make the world, all the letters were still concealed, and two thousand years before the creation of the world the Holy One, blessed be He, was observing and playing with** the letters**.**

Explanation: [Rav Hamnuna Saba] asks two questions: (a) Why are the letters alef and bet in reverse order at the start of the Torah, with the bet coming first and only then the alef ? (b) Why are those two letters doubled, as the first two words, Bereshit bara , both start with a bet , and the next two words, Elohim et , each begins with an alef ?

He answers: **“When the Holy One, blessed be He, wished to make the world,”** i.e., when the Holy One, blessed be He, which is Bina , wished to produce Ze’er Anpin and Nukba , which are called “world,” the letters, which are the vessels of Ze’er Anpin and Nukba , were **“concealed.”** That is, they were incorporated in the first three [ sefirot of Bina of Atzilut ], which are Abba and Imma Ila'in , and the [letters] were not [yet] known. And Ḥokhma and Bina are called “two thousand years.” Before He created the world, the letters of Ze’er Anpin and Nukba were incorporated in Ḥokhma and Bina . Therefore, this incorporation of Ze’er Anpin and Nukba in Ḥokhma and Bina is described as **“two thousand years before the creation of the world the Holy One, blessed be He, was observing and playing with them.”** At that point, Ze’er Anpin and Nukba were regarded as feminine waters in the two thousand years, which are Ḥokhma and Bina , and the feminine waters always bring playfulness to the upper realm. This is why [Rav Hamnuna] said that at that time, when [ Ze’er Anpin and Nukba ] became feminine waters in Ḥokhma and Bina , **“the Holy One, blessed be He, was observing and playing with them.”**

**23. “When He wished to create etc.” When He wished to create the world, all the letters came before Him, from last to first.** The letter ** tav began to enter first. She said: “Master of the worlds! It is good for You to create the world with me, as I am the seal on Your ring,** which is ** emet ** [truth], i.e., the last letter of the word emet , **and You are called** by the name ** Emet . It is fitting for the King to begin with the letter of emet , and to create the world with me.” The Holy One, blessed be He, said to her: You are beautiful and straight, but you are unfit for the world to be created with you, since in the future you will be inscribed upon the foreheads of men of faith,** [as a sign] **that they kept the Torah from alef to tav , and upon your inscription they will die** (as is written in Shabbat 55a)**. Furthermore, you are the seal of death**, since tav is also the last letter in the word mavet [death]**. As you are such, you are unfit for the world to be created with you.” She immediately departed.**

Explanation: When He began to distil the Ze’er Anpin and Nukba , which are called “world,” in order to create them, all the letters of Ze’er Anpin and Nukba came before the Holy One, blessed be He, starting with tav , the last of all the letters, and ending with alef , the first of them all. The reason why they came from last to first, rather than in their usual alphabetical order, was because they came by the mystical meaning of feminine waters, in which they are arranged in that manner, in the mystical meaning of tav - shin - resh - kof etc. The order of aleph - bet - gimmel applies only to the mystical meaning of masculine waters, which are from above to below. By contrast, the feminine waters are always in the opposite order of the male waters, from below to above (as stated in the Zohar Ḥadash , Shir HaShirim , 284).

Now, this exposition on the letters is exceedingly profound. To clarify it a little, I will give you a brief introduction into the breadth of this exposition: The creation of the world means refinement and perpetuation in such a manner that the world can exist and complete the purpose for which it was created. It is known that “God made one thing corresponding to the other” [Ecclesiastes 7:14]. This means that corresponding to each force in holiness, the Holy One, blessed be He, made an equal force in the Sitra Aḥara corresponding to the holiness. Just as there are four worlds, Atzilut , Beria , Yetzira , and Asiya , of holiness, so too there are four worlds, Atzilut , Beria , Yetzira , and Asiya , of impurity, corresponding to them. Consequently, in the world of Asiya , one who serves God is not recognizable from one who does not serve Him, i.e., there is no [visible] distinction at all between holiness and impurity ( Etz Ḥayyim , section 3, introduction). Accordingly, it is very difficult to understand how the world can exist, for how can we differentiate good from evil, holiness from impurity?

However, there is one very important [method of] distinguishing [good and evil], which is that a foreign god is barren and does not bear fruit. Therefore, those who stumble in [following a foreign god] and walk along the path of Atzilut , Beria , Yetzira , and Asiya of impurity, their source dries up and they have no spiritual fruits for a blessing. They wither away until they are completely sealed up. The opposite is the case for those who adhere to holiness – their handiwork is blessed, as it is stated: “Like a tree planted by streams of water, that brings forth its fruit in its season, and whose leaf does not wither, and in whatever he does he shall prosper” (Psalms 1:3). This is the only [method of] distinguishing [good and evil] in the world of Asiya by which one can know if he is in holiness or, Heaven forfend, the opposite. And this is the mystical meaning of the verse: “And try Me now with this, says the Lord of hosts, if I will not open for you the windows of heaven and pour you out a blessing, that there shall be more than sufficiency” (Malachi 3:10), and it is subsequently written: “Then you shall again discern between the righteous and the wicked, between he who serves God and he who does not serve Him” (Malachi 3:18). It is clearly stated that it is impossible to differentiate at all between one who serves God and one who does not serve Him, other than through the secret of the blessing alone, and not by any other means, as this is the implication of the phrase: “And try Me now with this.”

This is the key point of this exposition of the letters – every single one of the letters, without exception, came to create the world according to the theme of the level of holiness unique to that letter. For the twenty-two letters are the particulars of all the heads of the levels in the four worlds of Atzilut , Beria , Yetzira , and Asiya . Each of the letters considered its own merit, that is, [each letter] assumed that by attaining her level, the people of the world would be able to make holiness prevail over the kelippot , in order to reach the desired state of complete rectification. But the Holy One, blessed be He, replied to each of them that corresponding to [each letter], the same force is in the kelippot as well, and therefore the people of the world will not attain any distinguishing [of good from evil] through them. Finally, the [letter] bet arrived, whose theme of her level is berakha [“blessing”], to which nothing corresponds in the kelippot at all, since a foreign god is barren and does not bear fruit, as stated. Then **“the Holy One, blessed be He, told her: I will certainly create the world with you...”** as distinguishing and discernment [of good from evil] is possible only through her, to distinguish between a servant of God and one who does not serve Him, since there is nothing corresponding to her in the Sitra Aḥara . Consequently, the world will certainly exist through her, to distinguish and enhance the holiness over the chariots of impurity, until death is swallowed up forever [see Isaiah 25:8] and they will achieve complete rectification.

One should also know the general division of the twenty-two letters into three levels, namely Bina , Ze’er Anpin , and Malkhut . There are no vessels – which are the letters – above Bina . The twenty-two letters in Bina are called “large letters,” the twenty-two letters in Ze’er Anpin are known simply as “letters,” while the twenty-two letters in Malkhut are “small letters.” In the same manner, they each subdivide into three levels: Bina , Ze’er Anpin , and Malkhut , since there are [levels of] Bina , Ze’er Anpin , and Malkhut , in the twenty-two letters of Bina , and the same applies to the twenty-two in Ze’er Anpin and also to the twenty-two in Malkhut . The twenty-two letters themselves divide into three levels, of units, tens, and hundreds. The units, from alef through tet , are the nine sefirot of Bina ; the tens, from yod to tzadi , are the nine sefirot of Ze’er Anpin , while the hundreds are from the Nukba . This is why there are only four letters, kof-resh-shin-tav , in Malkhut , since [ Malkhut ] occupies only four of the sefirot of Ze’er Anpin , from the chest of [ Ze'er Anpin ] and below, which are Netzaḥ , Hod , Yesod , and Malkhut – kof-resh are Netzaḥ and Hod ; shin-tav are Yesod , and Malkhut .

One should not raise the following difficulty: Isn’t it known that the units are in Nukba , the tens are in Ze’er Anpin , and the hundreds are in the Imma ? The explanation is that there is always an inverse relationship between the lights and the vessels. In the vessels, the higher [vessels] appear first, whereas the opposite is the case in the lights, as there the lower [lights] appear first. Thus, if there are only [the level of] units of the vessels there, from alef to yod , there is only Malkhut of the lights there. If the [level of] tens of the vessels also arrive, the light of Ze’er Anpin of lights comes as well. And if [the level of] the hundreds of the vessels, kof-resh-shin-tav are also completed, the lights of Bina appear, which are [the lights of the level of] hundreds. For this reason, the hundreds are considered Bina , the tens Ze’er Anpin , and the units Malkhut . However, with respect to the vessels themselves, the reverse is the case – the units are in the Imma , the tens in Ze’er Anpin , and the hundreds in Nukba .

[Rav Hamnuna] then says: **“ Tav began to enter first** etc.” That is, it is known that each of the letters of the alphabet has a unique level under her control. Therefore, the tav argued that she was better qualified to refine the world than all of the other letters because the truth is in her domain, and she is the seal of the King’s ring.

The meaning is as follows: It is known that the Sitra Aḥara survives only on that which the [side of] holiness illuminates for it, a very small luminescence, which is the mystical meaning of [the verse]: “Her feet go down to death” (Proverbs 5:5) and the mystical meaning of [the verse]: “And His kingdom rules over all” (Psalms 103:19). This is the mystical meaning of the leg of the kof , which extends below the line of the letters. It alludes to the very small luminescence that the Malkhut gives to the Sitra Aḥara . Accordingly, you will not find a leg extending below in any of the twenty-two letters other than the kof , as she belongs to the letters of Malkhut , for kof-resh-shin-tav are in Malkhut , as stated previously. However, the left leg of the tav initially began to extend below the line and the Holy One, blessed be He saw that the grip of the Sitra Aḥara would be too strong, and therefore the Holy One, blessed be He, stopped her and drew her leg back so that it would end on the same level as the line of holiness. This is why [the tav 's] left leg grew thicker, for the part that extended [below the line], which He drew back, was folded over itself there. For this reason, no illumination reaches from [the tav ] to the kelippot and the Sitra Aḥara . What is more, she was established as the seal of the ring, guarding the kelippot so that they would not draw near and suckle from the holiness via that path, and anyone who touches her would die. The very small luminescence that is required for the existence of the kelippot was made through the letter kof , since she is the highest letter in Malkhut and far from the kelippot and the Sitra Aḥara , and therefore there is no fear of the kelippot gripping too tightly. For this reason, she is called kof , indicating that from her comes the start of the power to the Sitra Aḥara and the kelippot , known as “wicked man,” so as to resemble the partzufim of holiness, the mystical meaning of [the verse]: “One thing corresponding to the other” (Ecclesiastes 7:14). This is like the similarity of a monkey [ kof ] to a man, and people err with regard to the [wicked men] and they lie in the name of the Holy One, blessed be He.

This was the claim of the tav : Since **“I am the seal on Your ring,”** as I am positioned at the end of every partzuf , and I do not allow the kelippot to approach and suckle from the holiness and lie in Your name, it is fitting for the world to be created with me, and all the distinguishing between the Sitra Aḥara and holiness will be through me, and all the people of the world will be assured of their destiny.

This is the meaning of the statement: **“And You are called Emet ; it is fitting for the King to begin with the letter of emet , and to create the world with me.”** In other words, since Your name is Emet [Truth], an indication that it is impossible to cleave unto You other than by obtaining the attribute of truth, it is fitting for the King to begin with the letter of emet and to create the world with me. For with my attribute, people will repel the Sitra Aḥara and the kelippot and they will cleave unto You. Then, all the people in the world will be assured of the completion of the rectification. This is as taught in the Zohar : **“The Lord is near to all who call upon Him”** (Psalms 145:18)**. To whom is He near?** [The verse] **reiterates: “To all who call upon Him in truth.” But is there anyone who calls upon Him falsely? Rabbi Abba said: Yes – this is one who calls without knowing to whom he calls. From where do we derive this? As it is stated: “To all who call upon Him in truth.” What is “in truth”? With the seal of the King’s ring, which is complete wholeness** ( Ha’azinu , 210).

The Holy One, blessed be He, replied to [the tav ] that she is unfit for the world to be created through her, since due to her strength, the judgments would be too harsh.
