Even the completely righteous – who have already been rewarded with an inscription of her seal and who have kept the Torah from alef to tav – are still punished by her harsh strength because they did not protest against the wicked, as stated in Shabbat 55a. Furthermore, [the tav ] is also the seal of death, as through her strength death was created in the world, since people are rounded up for death only because the serpent falsified her seal and caused Adam to sin with the Tree of Knowledge, as stated in the Tikkunim ( Tikkun 22). It is therefore impossible that the world would be able to exist through [the letter tav ].

**24. “ Shin entered etc.”** The letter ** shin entered before Him. She said to Him: “Master of the worlds! It is good for You to create the world with me, as Your name is called by me, Shaddai , and it is fitting to create the world with a holy name. He said to her: You are beautiful, you are good, and you are true, but since the letters of falsehood** [ sheker ] **took you to be with them, I do not wish to create the world with you. For sheker cannot exist unless the letters kof and resh take you.**

Explanation: The Nukba has two endpoints; one is called Malkhut of Malkhut , which is the tav , and the other is called Yesod of Malkhut , which is the shin . The explanation is that when [the Nukba ] is without a structure from Abba and Imma Ila'in , the tav is considered the endpoint, which is a harsh judgment, as we stated just above. And when [the Nukba ] is in the structure of a partzuf by means of Abba and Imma Ila'in , the letter shin is formed at the endpoint [of the Nukba ], with the three heads of the shin representing the illumination of Ḥesed , Gevura , and Tiferet of the Imma , which [the Nukba ] receives through Ze’er Anpin into the endpoint [of the Nukba ], in the mystical meaning of the verse: “The well, which the princes dug etc.” (Numbers 21:18). By means of this illumination [the Nukba ] becomes a vessel to receive one hundred blessings from Ze’er Anpin , in the mystical meaning of: “A woman enacts a covenant only with the one who made her into a vessel” ( Sanhedrin 22a). [The Nukba ] thereby becomes a receptacle to receive one hundred blessings from Yesod of Ze’er Anpin . This endpoint is therefore called **“the middle point of the settlement,”** since the whole settling of the world comes from it, and it is also called Yesod of Nukba .

Consequently, the letter shin is called a “letter of truth,” like the tav , and it is similarly called “the King’s seal,” like [the tav ]. The word “seal” has multiple meanings: First, it denotes the end of the partzuf , like the seal of the king, which comes at the end of a document that is written in the king’s name. Second, the seal of the king is like the king Himself, as stated in the Tikkunim ( Tikkun 22): “They fear the writing of the King’s seal as though it was the King Himself.” For this reason, the seal is called “a sign of truth,” since the whole truthfulness is thereby apparent from the seal. However, the shin has an advantage over the tav , since the shin is called by the mystical meaning of the name Shaddai , which means that He said to His world: “ Dai [enough]; spread no further” ( Ḥagiga 12a). This refers to the building of the world in terms of [its] settlement, which ended only with a shin , through which He said to His world: Enough, do not spread further into the aspect of the tav . Therefore, the end point of the shin is called the middle point of the settlement.

This was the shin ’s claim: **“It is good for You to create the world with me, as Your name is called by me, Shaddai .”** Having seen that He rejected the tav because of the harsh attribute of judgment [the tav ] contains, the shin thought to herself that the Holy One, blessed be He, would choose her attribute for the creation of the world, since she has all the merits of the tav – as she too is the King’s seal, and she is likewise a letter of truth – and she has another merit, since the name Shaddai is called by her. She was selected for the endpoint of the Nukba with respect to the settlement of the world, not the tav . Accordingly, she found the inner strength to come before the Holy One, blessed be He, [to request] that He should create the world with her attribute.

The Holy One, blessed be He, replied to her, to the shin : “Although your attribute is great, as you claim, it is for this very reason that your opposite in the kelippa is very strong. Falsehood could not exist in the world had the two letters of forgery and falsehood of the kelippot not taken you, i.e., kof and resh .” In other words, there are two sources [of lifeforce] for the Sitra Aḥara and all of the kelippot . One is a very small luminescence, which the [the side of] holiness itself shines for [the Sitra Aḥara and the kelippot ] so they can exist and not be negated, as long as they are needed in order to punish the wicked. [With respect to this source], their construction is not great because the illumination is very slight, merely enough to sustain them, as the male [aspect] of the kelippa is only six extremities without a head, while the Nukba [of the kelippa ] is only a dot without any expansion at all. As you already know [from the previous section of the Zohar ], this very small luminescence is drawn to [the Sitra Aḥara and the kelippot ] by means of the letter kof , since this is the beginning of their power to resemble the man of Beria , Yetzira , and Asiya of holiness, like a monkey [ kof ] in relation to man, which is the mystical meaning of: “God made one thing corresponding to the other” (Ecclesiastes 7:14). The second source [of lifeforce] for the Sitra Aḥara is from the corruption of the lower beings, as through their evil deeds they draw away lights of holiness to the kelippot . The first corruption occurred at the sin of the Tree of Knowledge, through which a great structure was made for [the kelippot ], with five partzufim and Atzilut , Beria , Yetzira , and Asiya , just like there is for the [side of] holiness.

This second source [of lifeforce for the Sitra Aḥara and the kelippot ] is the letter resh , which indicates that [the Sitra Aḥara and the kelippot ] ascend and attach as high as Bina of Malkhut , which is the letter dalet . As explained above, the twenty-two letters of the Malkhut are divided into Bina , Ze’er Anpin , and Malkhut : The units are Bina , the tens Ze’er Anpin , and the hundreds Malkhut . Thus, the dalet of the twenty-two letters of Malkhut is positioned at the start of the seven lower letters of Bina , since alef - bet - gimmel are the first three, and from the dalet and onwards, through tet , they are the six extremities of Bina in Malkhut .

The mystical meaning of dalet is the poverty and wretchedness that is in Malkhut in general, since Malkhut “has nothing of her own, except for what her husband,” Ze’er Anpin , “gives her,” as is known. This attribute of [ Malkhut ] is inscribed in the dalet , because when [the letter dalet ] is [written out in] full it is dalet - lamed - tav , connoting “poverty [ dalut ]” and “emptiness.” The dalet also has a protruding corner on its roof, which indicates the protrusion of [the light of giving] ( ḥassadim ) in [the letter], which the dalet takes from the gimmel that precedes it. This gimmel is from the first three [letters] of Bina [of Malkhut , [and this gimmel ] receives from its corresponding aspect in Ze’er Anpin , which itself receives from its corresponding aspect in Bina , where [the light of giving] are in great abundance. For this reason, [this letter] is called gimmel , from the phrase gommel ḥassadim [bestower of kindnesses, ḥassadim ] (see Shabbat 104a), for [the gimmel ] performs acts of kindness with the dalet , since [the dalet ] has nothing of its own, and [the gimmel ] bestows abundant giving [upon the dalet ]. This protrusion of giving is alluded to by the corner on the roof of the dalet .

However, the opposite [counterpart] of Malkhut of holiness is “a backbiter alienates friends,” which is the mystical meaning of “an arrogant pauper” [see Pesaḥim 113b] who does not want to receive from the gimmel and submit to it. Instead, [this counterpart] pretends to be master, with great pride. Due to this flaw, the corner is erased from the dalet , which is the protrusion of [the light of giving] in [the dalet ], and [the dalet ] becomes poor and destitute [ rash ], since erasing the corner from the dalet gives it the form of a resh , i.e., rash , which is the mystical meaning of: “Even in his reign he was revealed as poor [ rash ]” (Ecclesiastes 4:14). The unification of Ze’er Anpin and the Nukba of holiness is in the mystical meaning of [the letters of] eḥad [“one,” alef - ḥet - dalet ]. This is because alef - ḥet is the nine sefirot of Ze’er Anpin , which gives from the gimmel of Bina [above Ze'er Anpin ] to the gimmel of Malkhut , by which the Malkhut becomes the mystical meaning of a dalet with a protruding angle – with abundant [light of giving]. Through this, Ze’er Anpin and Nukba become “one” ( eḥad ) flesh in complete unification. Thus, when the lower beings corrupt their actions, they give power to Malkhut of the Sitra Aḥara to cling to the dalet , which is the Malkhut , in order to erase the angle that protrudes in [receiving the light of giving] and turn it into a resh . Then the eḥad becomes aḥer [“other,” alef - ḥet - resh ], and other gods cling to Ze’er Anpin and Nukba of holiness. This is the mystical meaning of: “A backbiter alienates friends” (Proverbs 16:28).

It is then considered that the letters kof - resh of the Sitra Aḥara expropriate for themselves the seal of the shin , which is the sign of “truth,” and the Yesod of Nukba , which is the receptacle of the Yesod of Ze’er Anpin , as stated previously. [The Yesod of Nukba ] now goes to another god, of the Sitra Aḥara , because out of this shin a Yesod of the Nukba of the Sitra Aḥara is built. Therefore, the Sitra Aḥara grows, with ten complete sefirot with a head, and the shin that [the Sitra Aḥara ] exploited becomes a point of destruction, because the Sitra Aḥara is built from the ruin of holiness. From here the [worlds of] Atzilut , Beria , Yetzira , and Asiya of the “wicked man” are built. It has thus been explained how the kof - resh are the two sources of the Sitra Aḥara , and therefore they are called the “letters of forgery,” since the Sitra Aḥara forged them in the above manner, in order to destroy the construction and unification of holiness, for [the Sitra Aḥara ] to be built on the ruin of the holiness, as stated. This is achieved primarily by drawing to [the Sitra Aḥara ] the shin , which is the form of Yesod of Nukba , into their portion and domain, by forging the dalet into a resh , which forges eḥad into aḥer , creating a structure for the partzufim of other gods. Thus, falsehood and forgery would not exist in such a large structure had the kof - resh of the Sitra Aḥara not expropriated the shin for themselves.

This is the meaning of the response of the Holy One, blessed be He, to the shin : **“You are beautiful, you are good, and you are true, but since the letters of falsehood** [ sheker ] **took you to be with them, I do not wish to create the world with you. For sheker will not exist unless the letters kof and resh take you.”** This is as we explained, that there would be no structure for falsehood and forgery of the Sitra Aḥara had it not expropriated the shin for itself, and therefore the world should not be created by means of the attribute [of the shin ], as its opposite is balanced against it, and the completion of the rectification is not assured through it.

**25. “From here, whoever wants etc.” From here** it is derived that **whoever wants to say a falsehood should begin with a foundation of truth, and then the falsehood will be maintained for him. For the letter shin is a letter of truth, the letter of truth through which the forefathers were united,** as the three lines in the shin allude to the three forefathers, who are Ḥesed , Gevura , and Tiferet , **while kof - resh are letters that are visible on the evil side**, because the Sitra Aḥara is cold [ kar ], without the heat of vitality, since [the Sitra Aḥara ] suckles from the Malkhut when she is a frozen sea (as stated in Bereshit I, page 47, s.v. Yama de-kafu )**. In order to survive,** [the kof-resh] **take** the letter ** shin within them, which** forms the combination ** kesher ** [“bond,” kof - shin - resh ], a term of strengthening and sustaining**. When she**, the shin , **saw that, she departed from Him.**

Explanation: As was explained previously, the illumination of Ḥesed , Gevura , and Tiferet of Bina , which are given to [ Nukba ] through Yesod of Ze’er Anpin , constructed the end point of the Nukba into a vessel and a receptacle for the one hundred blessings from Ze’er Anpin . Ḥesed , Gevura , and Tiferet are called “forefathers.” This is the meaning of the statement: **“Through which the forefathers were united,”** and it is for this reason that [the shin ] is called “a letter of truth,” as stated above; see there.

**“ Kof - resh are letters that are visible on the evil side.”** This was already explained in the adjacently preceding section, that [ kof and resh ] are the two sources of the Sitra Aḥara . Thus, the Zohar says, **“In order to survive,** [ kof and resh ] **take** the letter ** shin within them, which is kesher .”** By erasing the corner [of the roof] of the dalet of eḥad [“one”], they expropriate to within themselves the Yesod of Nukba of holiness, which is the shin , and the Yesod of Nukba of kelippa is constructed in the letter shin . They thereby have a very strong hold on holiness, which is called kesher , since a bond [ kesher ] indicates that the grasp is very strong and hard to detach.

**26. “ Tzadi entered etc.”** The letter ** tzadi entered** [and] **said before Him: “Master of the world! It is good for You to create the world with me, as the righteous [ tzaddikim ] are sealed with me, and You, who are called tzaddik , are inscribed with me, as it is stated: ‘For the Lord is righteous and He loves righteousness’** [Psalms 11:7]**, and** [thus] **it is fitting to create the world with me.” He said to her: “ tzadi , you are tzadi , and you are righteous [ tzaddik ], but you must be concealed. You do not need to be so exposed** that the creation of the world should begin with you**, so as not give the world a pretext.” What is the reason** that she has to be concealed**?** Because **she was** a letter ** nun ,** and then the ** yod of the name, which is the holy covenant, came and rode atop** the nun , **and united with her**, becoming the tzadi **. The mystical meaning of this matter is that when the Holy One, blessed be He, created Adam the first** [man]**,** who is the mystical meaning of Ze’er Anpin , **He created him with two faces**, i.e., a male face and a female face, attached to one another through their backs**. For this reason, the face of the yod is turned back** from the nun **like this** [image of the tzadi ] with the yod facing one way and the nun facing the other way, **and they are not returned** [to a state of] **face-to-face like this** [image of the tzadi ]**.** Rather, the yod **looks upward like this** [image of the] ** tzadi while** the nun **looks downward like this** [image of the] ** tzadi . The Holy One, blessed be He, said to her: “Furthermore, in the future I will saw you,”** that is, separate you from your back-to-back attachment, **and make you** connected **face-to-face. “However, you will ascend to this** [state] **in another place,”** not immediately, at the beginning of the creation of the world, as then she must be back-to-back, which indicates that her illumination is hidden. Therefore, she must not be used for the creation of the world. The letter tzadi **left His presence and departed.**

Explanation: Having seen that the tav was rejected because of the harsh attribute of judgment she contains, and the shin because of the grasp of the Sitra Aḥara within her, [the tzadi ] found the strength to suggest that she is certainly worthy for the world to be created with her, as she too has the qualities of a seal like them, and in addition there is no grasp of the Sitra Aḥara upon her. This is the meaning of the statement: **“The righteous [ tzaddikim ] are sealed with me,”** which is the seal of the sign of the holy covenant, through circumcision and peri’a [uncovering of the glans], which rebuffs all the external forces. **“And You, who are called tzaddik , are inscribed with me,”** because also the Holy One, blessed be He, which is Bina , was established in the mystical meaning of tzaddik and tzedek [justice], like the Ze’er Anpin , [and tzaddik and tzedek ] are the first three sefirot of Bina that were established Abba and Imma Ila'in , in the mystical meaning of “this trail of the father sits in that path of the mother,” and in the mystical meaning of the beloved Ketarim [crowns], which always embrace in a never ending fusion. **“As it is stated: ‘For the Lord is righteous and He loves righteousness’” –** “righteous” alludes to Yesod of the Abba [of Abba and Imma Ila'in ]; “righteousness” alludes to Yesod of the Imma [of Abba and Imma Ila'in ], which is the aspect of Netzaḥ and Hod , called the “righteousness of the Lord.” And because the righteous [one] loves righteousness, the pairing [of Abba and Imma Ila'in ] never ceases. [ Tzadi ] therefore declared: “I am fitting for the world to be created with me, and through my attribute the world will be sustained in an assured path to the completion of the rectification.”

The Zohar continues: **“He said to her, ‘ tzadi , you are tzadi , and you are righteous [ tzaddik ].’”** The letter tzadi is the Yesod of Ze’er Anpin , and when the Yesod is incorporated together with the Nukba , this [ Yesod ] is called tzaddik , since the nine sefirot of Ze’er Anpin are from yod to tzadi , and the kof is the beginning of the Nukba , as stated. And when the Nukba is attached to Yesod , the kof is attached to tzadi , and then Yesod is called tzaddik . This is why the Holy One, blessed be He, praised her [by saying] **“you are tzadi ,”** in your place in Yesod of Ze’er Anpin ; and **“you are tzadi ”** in My place, for you are inscribed in Me in a never-ending pairing, as you said. Also, **“you are righteous [ tzaddik ],”** since the Nukba is included in you as well, in the mystical meaning of the kof that follows the tzadi . But despite all of this, you are unfit for the world to be created with you, as [the Zohar ] goes on to explain.

That which [Rav Hamnuna] says: **“You must be concealed. You do not need to be so exposed** etc. **What is the reason? She was a nun .”** The meaning of this is that Yesod of Ze’er Anpin includes the Nukba with it[self], which is the kof in the mystical meaning of [the word] tzaddik , as the Holy One, blessed be He, alluded to her [in His comment]: **“You are righteous [ tzaddik ].”** When the Nukba is included in [ Ze'er Anpin ] in the form of the tzadi , [the Nukba ] is represented in [the letter shape] as the letter nun [forming the bottom of the tzadi ]. This is because the nun is the aspect of Gevura of Ze’er Anpin . The [letters of] yod , kaf , lamed are the first three [ sefirot of Ze'er Anpin ], Keter , Ḥokhma , Bina , and [the letters] mem and nun are Ḥesed and Gevura . With regard to this nun it is stated: “I am discernment [ bina ]; might [ gevura ] is mine” (Proverbs 8:14). For in [the phase of] maturity, when Ḥesed , Gevura , and Tiferet become Ḥokhma , Bina , and Da'at , as is known, this Gevura becomes Bina . In [the phase of] immaturity, when the father removes the mother outside, the Bina becomes Gevura , nun , and thus [the nun ] alludes to nefila [falling], since Bina falls from the first three [ sefirot ] to the [the level of] six extremities through the strength of the father, who removed Bina and Ze’er Anpin and Nukba to outside of the head.

[Rav Hamnuna] thus says: **“You do not need to be so exposed, so as not give the world a pretext. What is the reason? She was a nun ,** and the ** yod of the name, which is the holy covenant, came and rode atop her, and united with her.”** In other words, the Nukba that is incorporated in [the letter] tzadi is [represented by] the form of the letter nun within [ tzadi ], which is Gevura of the aspect of the fallen Bina , and the yod within [the tzadi ] is Yesod of Ze’er Anpin itself, which is the name of the holy covenant. They are positioned in the form [of the letter] as back-to-back, with their backs attached to one another and their faces exposed outwards, as the face of the yod looks outwards rather than to the side of the nun , and the face of the nun likewise looks outward and not to the side of the yod . This implies that there is a grip [for the Sitra Aḥara ] on their backs, and therefore their backs must be concealed, in the mystical meaning of the verse: “Their backs were inward” (I Kings 7:25), so that the external forces will not latch on to them. This is the meaning of the statement: **“You do not need to be so exposed, so as not give the world a pretext.”** Since there is a deficiency in your back, you must be in concealment, so as not to give the external forces a pretext to grab hold there, between the attachments. Therefore, you are unfit for the world to be created with you, since in you too, there is a place of purchase for the kelippot . Through this force of the tzadi , as the Yesod and Malkhut in her are back-to-back, Adam the first man came out back-to-back as well, in the mystical meaning of two faces, as he said: **“The secret of the matter is that when the Holy One, blessed be He, created Adam the first** [man]**, He created him with two faces.”**

[Rav Hamnuna] thus says: **“Furthermore, in the future I will saw you, and make you face-to-face. However, you will ascend to this** [state] **in another place.”** This means to say, you might suggest that it is possible for Me to create the world through you in the aspect of face-to-face, just as I will later saw you and make you face-to-face. However, that too is not a valid claim, since even when I will establish you face-to-face with the Nukba , it will not be in your place below, but only through an ascent to My place, the place of Abba and Imma Ila'in . And since [the state of] face-to-face will not be established in your place, there will be a purchase for the kelippot on your level even then, and therefore you are unfit for the world to be created with you. This is the meaning of the statement: **“Furthermore, in the future I will saw you, and make you face-to-face,”** i.e., “it is true that in the future I will saw you and make you face-to-face. Yet this will not happen in your place”: **“However, you will ascend to this** [state] **in another place,”** in the place of Abba and Imma Ila'in , since then you will ascend and enclothe Abba and Imma Ila'in , whereas in your own place this will not be established until the completion of the rectification. How, then, can I create the world with you, when there is a purchase for the external forces within you, as well.

**27. “ Peh entered etc.”** The letter ** peh entered** [and] **said before Him: “Master of the worlds! It is good for You to create the world with me, for the redemption that in the future You will perform in the world is inscribed with me, as it is** [the word] ** pedut ** [ransom; redemption]**.** In other words, the redemption is our ransom [ pedut ] from our oppressors, and since it starts with the letter peh , I am worthy of having the world created through me. **He said to her: “You are beautiful; however, concealed pesha ** [crime] **is imprinted with you, like a snake that strikes and then withdraws its head into its body.” Similarly, one who sins bends his head,** i.e., he conceals himself so as to not be seen, **and stretches out his hands** to sin**,** which is like the shape of the peh , whose head is bent inwards. He spoke **similarly** to the letter ** ayin ,** with which the word ** avon ** [iniquity] is inscribed. **Even though she said: “I contain anava ** [humility],” **the Holy One, blessed be He, said to her: “I will not create the world with you,”** [and] **she departed from before Him.**

Explanation: Purkana means redemption, and the [letter] peh said that the future redemption for the world is inscribed with her, and therefore she is worthy for the world to be created with her. The exile and redemption that occur in the world depend on the Nukba , since when the Nukba lacks the construction of the first three [ sefirot ], which are called brains, [the people of] Israel were exiled from their land, the Land of Israel. This is because the Land of Israel below is situated such that it corresponds to the Land of Israel above, which is the Nukba of Ze’er Anpin , and [when] there is separation above between Ze’er Anpin , which is called Israel, and Nukba , which is [the] land [of Ze'er Anpin ], so too Israel below are separated from their land. But when the children of Israel improve their ways, they cause Israel above to give to its Nukba , [which is] his land, and build [ Nukba ] with the brains and unite with her face-to-face. Then the children of Israel below also merit redemption and they too return to their land.

These brains of the first three [ sefirot ] of the Nukba , which Ze’er Anpin builds, come to [the Nukba ] enclothed within Netzaḥ and Hod of Ze’er Anpin . The brains of Ḥokhma of the Nukba are enclothed in Netzaḥ and the brains of Bina are enclothed in Hod , while the letters ayin and peh are Netzaḥ and Hod of Ze’er Anpin , as stated. This is the claim of the peh , which is Hod of Ze’er Anpin , that **“the redemption that in the future You will perform in the world is inscribed with me,”** as the brains of Nukba that bring redemption to the world are enclothed in me. Therefore, if you create the world with my attribute, they will undoubtedly be fit to achieve complete rectification.

Why did the peh consider herself better suited for the creation of the world than the ayin ? After all, the brains of Nukba are enclothed in the both of them, in Netzaḥ and Hod , which are ayin and peh , but mainly in Netzaḥ , which is ayin . If so, why did the peh regard herself as more worthy than the ayin ? This is the meaning of his statement: **“As it is redemption** ( pedut )**,”** since the pedut exists only in the attribute of Hod , which is peh . The meaning of pedut is that the mother first redeems the Nukba from the judgments [ dinim ], and then the Nukba is worthy of redemption. This is the mystical meaning of the verse: “Like an eagle that would rouse its nest, over its fledglings it would hover etc.” (Deuteronomy 32:11). Our Rabbis, of blessed memory, expounded: This eagle has mercy for its offspring etc. and it says: “It is better for the arrow to pierce me rather than pierce my offspring” (see Rashi on Deuteronomy 32:11).

The meaning is as follows: It was explained above that the Ma is unfit for brains except through the rectification of **“for the mother lends her garments to the daughter.”** Since the Nukba , in its origin, is constricted from receiving light, meaning, from the time of the first constriction, [the Nukba ] could not receive any brains. However, because the mother emerged outside the head of Arikh Anpin and became six extremities without a head, the letters alef - lamed-heh [ eleh ] were drawn to the Nukba , and the Nukba , too, was constructed in the name Elohim (see section 17, above, second paragraph of the commentary). The mother is called “an eagle,” who is merciful toward her offspring, Ze’er Anpin and Nukba . She therefore emerged outside and her height was halved into [a height of] six extremities without a head. [This halving is] the aspect of an arrow, the mystical meaning of her statement: “It is better for the arrow to pierce me.” She thereby redeemed the offspring from the judgments and they became fit for receiving brains in her garments of eleh , as stated. This is the mystical meaning of pedut and pidyon – the mother redeems the Nukba from its judgments, as otherwise [the Nukba ] would not be fit for the brains. This redemption [of the Nukba ] applies primarily to the left line of the Nukba , as the judgments are there, as well as to Hod of Ze’er Anpin , which is the letter peh . Consequently, the peh thought that she was more suitable than the ayin , since this redemption [ pedut ] from the mother is enclothed only in her and not in the ayin , because the judgments are on the left line, not on the right line.

[The Zohar ] continues: **“You are beautiful; however, pesha ** [crime] **is written in you in concealment.”** All of the redemptions that occur during the six thousand years are of the aspect of the six extremities of the brains of ḥaya . The first three [ sefirot ] of these brains are the mystical meaning of the Abba and Imma (father and mother) that were manifest in Nekudim , and they were hidden away and will be revealed only at the completion of the rectification, that is, after the rectification of the sin of the Tree of Knowledge. When that sin was committed by Adam the first [man], he thereby drew the supernal brains to the level of the Beria , Yetzira , and Asiya of separation, below the diaphragm, where there are no garments of the mother but [only] the constricted Malkhut , which is the mystical meaning of the diaphragm below Atzilut , where the lower five [which is the lower heh ] of the first constriction now stand, enclosing the lights of Atzilut so that they do not spread from there downward. Through this [sin of Adam], by drawing the shefa below the diaphragm of Atzilut , crime [ pesha ] was inscribed in Nukba , which is the mystical meaning of: “The snake came upon Eve and infected her with contamination” ( Shabbat 146a). This contamination will be rectified only at the completion of the rectification, as it is stated: **“He will eliminate death forever and The Lord God will wipe tears from all faces”** (Isaiah 25:8) as the lack of the brains of the inner Abba and Imma [of Nekudim ] that were concealed is called “tears.” They are the mystical meaning of the two tears that God lets drop to the Great Sea, corresponding to two eyes, the inner Ḥokhma and Bina that were hidden away and are gone. Eyes are the mystical meaning of Ḥokhma and Bina , and tears express a deficiency in them, due to the contamination that was intermingled and became a tear through the sin of the Tree of Knowledge, which caused the destruction of the two Temples (see Zohar , Bereshit I, 254). The verse is saying that these tears will be wiped away from the face of the Nukba only when death will be swallowed up forever, i.e., when the sin of the Tree of Knowledge will be fully rectified. [At that time], crime, which is death, will be rectified forever, and then the first three [ sefirot ] of the brains of ḥaya will illuminate, which are the inner Ḥokhma and Bina [of Nekudim ], and it will thus be found that the Lord God has wiped tears etc.

[Rav Hamnuna] thus says: **“You are beautiful; however, pesha ** [crime] **is written in you in concealment.”** Although you have a redemption at the hands of the mother, through which you bring redemption to the world, which is the brains of ḥaya , by means of which all redemptions arrive, nevertheless these redemptions lack completion, for [the people of Israel] were once again exiled from upon their land and the two Temples were again destroyed. This occurred because **“ pasha is written in you in concealment”** – the redemption of the mother is not yet able to wipe out the crime of the sin of the Tree of Knowledge entirely, and therefore there is still purchase for the kelippot in you, since the brains are necessarily only of the aspect of six extremities of ḥaya and they lack the aspect of the head of the brains of ḥaya . Since there is purchase for the kelippot in you, you are unfit for the world to be created with you.

[Rav Hamnuna] then says: **“Like a snake that strikes and then withdraws its head into its body.”** Since this crime is hidden, the power of the snake, which strikes the people of the world and brings death into the world, still retains its full strength and cannot be removed. It is like a snake that bites someone and immediately pulls its head into its body, as then it is impossible to kill it, since the serpent can be killed only by hitting its head. This is what he did to Adam, to sin through the Tree of Knowledge, and to his sons, that he **“bends his head and stretches out his hands.”** In other words, even the brains that are drawn through the redemption of the mother are considered a bending of the head, and only the hands, which are Ḥesed , Gevura , and Tiferet , are revealed with those brains. Thus, the hold of the serpent is still in the peh , and therefore she is unfit for the world to be created with her, for she will not fit for the completion of the rectification, as explained.

[Rav Hamnuna] says: **“Similarly ayin , avon , even though she said: I contain anava ** [humility] etc.” The Imma Ila'ah is called anava . It is known that when Netzaḥ of Ze’er Anpin , which is ayin , is enclothed with the brains in the Nukba , [the Nukba ] ascends and enclothes the Imma Ila'ah , and the mother adorns her with her ornaments, as stated. This is why [the ayin ] said “I contain anava ,” as “the mother, which is anava , is enclothed in me.” However, because of that pesha [crime], discussed above, which [these two letters] contain, concealed in these [ sefirot of] Netzaḥ and Hod , the Holy One, blessed be He, said to ayin : “I will not create the world with you.”

The reason why pesha [crime] is called avon [iniquity] here, rather than pesha , as explained in [the section about] the peh , is that the essence of the pesha is inscribed in Hod , which is peh . Hod of Ze’er Anpin is of the incorporation of Malkhut within [ Ze'er Anpin ], to which the kelippot attached [themselves] by the power of the sin of the Tree of Knowledge, as stated. However, Netzaḥ of Ze’er Anpin is the attribute of Ze’er Anpin itself, of which in truth there is no purchase for the kelippot . Rather, in the mystical meaning of: “The cabbage is damaged along with the thorn” ( Bava Kamma 92a), the kelippot also grasped hold of Netzaḥ , as is known. Therefore, this corruption is discerned in [ Netzaḥ ] with the name avon , to indicate that [ Netzaḥ ] is in fact upright, but was warped by its connection to the Hod (see Talmud Eser Sefirot , part 13, section 206, s.v. Aval , and in the Or Penimi ).

The reason why [Rav Hamnuna] does not say in the case of the letter ayin , “the letter ayin entered,” as he says with regard to all the other letters, and instead he includes it together with the peh , is because Netzaḥ and Hod are two halves of the body, and therefore both of them actually came forward as one. Nevertheless, the Zohar explains the reason for each of them separately, one after the other.

**28. “ Samekh entered etc.”** The letter ** samekh entered** [and] **said before Him: Master of the worlds! It is good for You to create the world with me, for through me there is support [ semikha ] for the fallen, as it is stated: “The Lord supports all those who fall”** (Psalms 145:14)**. He said to her: For this reason you need to be in your place, and do not budge from it,** for **if you leave your place,** in the word somekh [supports], **what will become of those fallen, since they rely on your support? She immediately departed from before Him.**

Explanation: The letter samekh is Tiferet of Ze’er Anpin , which is Bina of the body. As is known, the names of Keter , Ḥokhma , and Bina , which became [the light of giving] in Ze’er Anpin , change into Ḥesed , Gevura , and Tiferet . Now, the Bina is divided into two aspects, the first three [ sefirot ] and the lower seven [ sefirot ]. The first three in [ Bina ] become [the partzuf ] of Abba and Imma Ila'in , which enclothe from the chest of Arikh Anpin and above. [ Abba and Imma Ila'in ] are still considered [of the aspect of the] head of Arikh Anpin , even though they are positioned at the body [of Arikh Anpin ], for [ Abba and Imma Ila'in ] are [light of giving], as it is stated: “Because He desires kindness [ ḥesed ]” (end of Micah [7:18]). Since [ Abba and Imma Ila'in ] do not receive light of Ḥokhma even when they are in the head of Arikh Anpin , the emergence from the head does not diminish [ Abba and Imma Ila'in ] at all, and they are still considered [of the aspect of the] head of Arikh Anpin . [ Abba and Imma Ila'in ] are also called samekh because those first three [ sefirot ] of Bina were established as [ Abba and Imma Ila'in ], and the six sefirot Ḥokhma , Bina , Da'at , Ḥesed , Gevura , and Tiferet , spread in [ Abba and Imma Ila'in ] until the chest. However, the lower seven [ sefirot ] of Bina , which are from the incorporation of Ze’er Anpin and Nukba in Bina and are not Bina itself, are divided from the Bina and become the partzuf of Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna , which enclothe the four sefirot Tiferet , Netzaḥ , Hod , and Yesod , of [ Abba and Imma Ila'in ]. This [enclothing] is from the chest of [ Abba and Imma Ila'in ] and below. [ Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna ] require the illumination of Ḥokhma , in order to give to Ze’er Anpin and Nukba . Since [ Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna , like Abba and Imma Ila'in ,] emerged from the head of Arikh Anpin to the aspect of the body, and they lack [access to the light of] Ḥokhma , [ Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna ] are therefore impaired by this emergence, and become six extremities without a head. [ Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna ] are also called a closed mem , because they take up only four sefirot Tiferet , Netzaḥ , Hod , and Yesod , of Abba and Imma Ila'in , which they enclothe there, as stated (see Marot HaSulam , section 2, s.v. Vehu ).

Now, the division of Bina into samekh and [closed] mem was performed in Bina of Arikh Anpin , in which [ Bina ] emerged to outside of the head of Arikh Anpin and spread into the Ḥesed , Gevura , and Tiferet [of Arikh Anpin ] until the bottom third of Tiferet in [the body of Arikh Anpin ]. [These aspects of Bina ] give all the brains to Ze’er Anpin and Nukba .

However, not all phases are the same. When the lower [beings] improve their conduct and elevate feminine waters to Ze’er Anpin and Nukba , and Ze’er Anpin and Nukba [elevate feminine waters] to Abba and Imma Ila'in , then Abba and Imma Ila'in and Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna become one partzuf and ascend to Arikh Anpin . [This completed partzuf of Bina ] then bestows complete brains of the illumination of Ḥokhma from Arikh Anpin to Ze’er Anpin and from Ze’er Anpin to the Nukba , in the mystical meaning of one hundred blessings. The samekh [numerical value of 60], which is Abba and Imma Ila'in , becomes one with the mem [numerical value of 40], which is Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna , and thus together they add up to the number 100. But when the lower [beings] corrupt their actions once again, the brains depart from Ze’er Anpin and Nukba and return to the state of six extremities and a point. Abba and Imma Ila'in and Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna also divide from one another, and Abba and Imma Ila'in become samekh again, which is only the six sefirot Ḥokhma , Bina , Da'at , Ḥesed , Gevura , and Tiferet , each of which is incorporated from ten, and Yisrael Sabba and Tevuna become a closed mem once more, which is only Tiferet , Netzaḥ , Hod , and Yesod of Abba and Imma Ila'in , as stated.

When Ze’er Anpin and Nukba are in this state of immaturity of six extremities and a point, there is a fear that the kelippot may attach [themselves]. [This attachment would cause Ze’er Anpin and Nukba ] to fall from Atzilut to Beria , Yetzira , and Asiya of separation. For this reason Abba and Imma Ila'in bestow upon [ Ze’er Anpin and Nukba ] from the [brains of the] aspect of their samekh , as these lights, although they are only the light of giving ( ḥassadim ), are still considered pure air and an aspect of a head. Therefore the kelippa has no purchase on Ze’er Anpin and Nukba even during the period of immaturity, since these lights of samekh protect them. Therefore, these lights are called samekh , as they support [ somekhim ] the Ze’er Anpin and Nukba from falling from Atzilut while they are in [the state of] immaturity, in the aspect of six extremities without a head, as explained.

This is the meaning of [Rav Hamnuna's] statement: **“ Samekh entered** etc. **for through me there is support for the fallen, as it is stated: ‘The Lord supports all those who fall.’”** This is as we said, that [ samekh ] considered herself better qualified than all the previous letters, since the lights of samekh can illuminate to the Ze’er Anpin and Nukba even during their immaturity, as they are only the light of giving, and there is no purchase at all for the kelippot in these lights of giving, because the external forces flee from the lights of the first three [ sefirot ] of Bina . Consequently, [ samekh ] considered her attribute the best suited for the world to be created with her, for she can protect the inhabitants of the world even when their actions are corrupted, as stated, and then there would be no grasp for the kelippot either.

[Rav Hamnuna] continues: **“He said to her: For this reason, you need to be in your place, and do not move from it.”** In other words, since your place is to support the fallen, to protect them at the time of the corruption of the inhabitants of the world, for this reason you must be solely in this place without budging from it. If the world were created with you, and your attribute would have constant sufficient dominion, the result would be that those fallen ones, Ze’er Anpin and Nukba , would remain forever in immaturity, and the lower [beings] would not awaken to elevate the feminine waters, and all the expanded brains that are necessary for bringing the completion of rectification would not be revealed. Rather, you must remain only in your place, the place of rectification, for the times that the lower [beings] are unfit. However, when they will merit it, they will be able to draw the expanded brains from the entire level, in the mystical meaning of one hundred blessings.

[Rav Hamnuna] says: **“If you leave your place, what will become of those fallen,”** as they will always remain fallen, requiring your constant support. This is the meaning of: **“Since they rely on your support,”** i.e., they [would] rely on you alone, and the Ze’er Anpin and Nukba [would] have no wholeness to stand on their own. Therefore, you are unfit for the world to be created with your attribute.

**29. “ Nun entered etc.”** The letter ** nun entered** [and] **said before Him: Master of the world! It is good for You to create the world with me, as with me it is stated: “Awesome** [ nora ] **in praise”** (Exodus 15:11)**.** Likewise, it is written with regard to **the praise of the righteous: “Praise** [ na’ava ] **is lovely”** (Psalms 147:1). **He said her: Nun , return to your place, for because of you** the letter ** samekh returned to her place, and rely on her** support**.** That is, the nun is inscribed in the word nefila [falling], and the samekh , which is the mystical meaning of “the Lord supports all those who fall” (Psalms 145:14), returned to her place on their account, to support them. **She immediately returned to her place and departed from before Him.**

Explanation: Having seen that the letter samekh was rejected because she is used only in immaturity, i.e., solely for support, as stated, the nun thought to herself that she is certainly worthy of the creation of the world, since she possesses all the qualities of the samekh , and in addition she also serves [in the phase of] the brains of maturity. For this reason, [ nun ] does not have the deficiency on account of which the samekh was rejected. This is the meaning of the statement: **“As with me it is stated: ‘Awesome** [ nora ] **in praise.’”** The Gevura of Ze’er Anpin is called nun , because [this Gevura ] was entirely tempered with the attribute of mercy of the Bina , which is called “fifty [ nun ] gates of Bina .” On account of this Gevura , the Ze’er Anpin is called “awesome in praise,” since Imma Ila'ah is called “praise,” and because this Gevura [of Ze'er Anpin ] is drawn from Bina , [ Ze'er Anpin ] is called “awesome in praise.” This nun of Ze’er Anpin serves in Yesod of >> Ze’er Anpin >> in the phase of maturity, during the pairing [between Ze'er Anpin ] and its Nukba , at which point the Nukba is called “praise” as well, like Imma Ila'ah , on account [of Ze'er Anpin ]. Thus, the Ze’er Anpin is united as one in both the upper praise and the lower praise.

[Rav Hamnuna] thus says: **“ Nun entered** etc. **as with me it is stated: ‘Awesome** [ nora ] **in praise.’”** Because of this [fact] that I am in the aspect of Gevura and the left line of Ze’er Anpin , I draw [the light of giving] that emerge from the letter samekh , which is the upper praise. The result is that Ze’er Anpin is called “awesome in praise” on my account, as stated. Therefore, I have all the qualities of the samekh , since the [the light of giving] that is drawn by her are the first three [ sefirot of Bina ] and they repel the external forces from [having] any purchase, exactly like the quality of the samekh . In addition, I possess another quality: **“The praise of the righteous: ‘Praise** [ na’ava ] **is lovely, ’”** for I serve in the Yesod of Ze’er Anpin in [the phase of] maturity. This is as stated with regard to the letter   tzadi , where it is said that [ tzadi ] was a letter nun with the letter yod atop her; see there thoroughly. This nun is considered the praise of the righteous, since as explained there, even during the time of maturity, when the Ze’er Anpin and Nukba ascend to Abba and Imma Ila'in , this nun still serves in the Yesod of Ze’er Anpin in the form of back-to-back. However, [the nun ] draws pure air from Abba and Imma Ila'in , which are the mystical meaning of the aforementioned samekh . Then the nun is called “praise of the righteous,” since the yod , which represents “the righteous is the foundation [ Yesod ] of the world” (Proverbs 10:25), rides atop her. [The nun ] is then called “praise is lovely,” as she draws the brains of maturity to Malkhut . Thus, all the beauty of Malkhut is received from the nun in Yesod of Ze’er Anpin . This is why the nun claimed that she is worthy for the world to be created with her, since through her illumination the brains of maturity were also added, which provide Ze’er Anpin and Nukba independent existence and durability, and not only through the aspect of support, like the samekh .

**“He said her: Nun , return to your place, for because of you, samekh returned to her place.”** The Holy One, blessed be He, said to her: It is not as you consider your attribute [to be fitting for] the complete rectification, that there would be no more purchase for the kelippot . Rather, your attribute also requires support from the samekh , since you are still in a state of back-to-back, and the lights of the samekh are exposed outwards to guard you from the external forces. Thus, the letter samekh returned to her place on your account as well, to support you, and this is not yet the complete rectification, and therefore the world will not be created with you. This is the meaning of **“and rely on her,”** i.e., your attribute is also only support [and not complete independence].

**30. “ Mem entered etc.”** The letter ** mem entered** [and] **said before Him: Master of the world! It is good for You to create the world with me, as with me You are called Melekh** [King; mem-lamed-kaf ]**. He said to her: That is certainly the case, but I will not create the world with you, because the world requires a king. Return to your place, you and the lamed and the kaf , as it is unbecoming for the world to stand without a king.**

Explanation: The mem is Ḥesed of Ze’er Anpin , which receives from its corresponding aspect, from Ḥesed of Bina , which is the mystical meaning of: “The Lord commands His kindness [ ḥasdo ] by day” (Psalms 42:9), i.e., a day that goes with all the days. At the time of the attainment of brains in Ze’er Anpin , the Ḥesed , Gevura , and Tiferet [of Ze'er Anpin ] become Ḥokhma , Bina , and Da'at . Thus, the Ḥesed of Ze’er Anpin ascends and becomes Ḥokhma , and then the light of the face of the living King is revealed from the Ze’er Anpin .

This was the claim of the mem for why the world should be created with her, because **“with me You are called Melekh .”** When the light of the King’s face is revealed in the world, there will certainly be no more grasp for the external forces, and the completion of the rectification in the world will be assured.

**“I will not create the world with you, because the world requires a king.”** In other words, it is impossible to reveal this light in the world because the world needs this great light to be enclothed only in the three letters mem-lamed-kaf [ melekh ]. He thus says: **“Return to your place, you and the lamed and the kaf , as it is unbecoming for the world to stand without a king.”** That is, return to your place and join with the letters lamed and kaf , and then it will be possible for this great light to be revealed in the world. This is because **“it is unbecoming for the world to stand without a king,”** i.e., the world cannot stand and exist without enclothing in the order of the three letters mem-lamed-kaf [ melekh ].

The meaning of this is that the mem of melekh [king] is the great Ḥesed , in the mystical meaning of: “The Lord commands His kindness [ ḥasdo ] by day,” which is a day that goes with all the days, the mystical meaning of an open mem , with a wide aperture. The lamed of melekh is the mystical meaning of a tower that flies in the air [see Ḥagiga 15b], which is Bina that becomes Ḥokhma in the head of Arikh Anpin and expands to Ze’er Anpin . The final kaf of melekh is the mystical meaning of the Malkhut , which is the Nukba of Ze’er Anpin , since there is no melekh without Malkhut . Furthermore, the full maturity of those lofty brains is revealed only through the Malkhut and with her permission.

In this state, the Malkhut is regarded as illuminating toward the Ze’er Anpin in three places: a) [ Malkhut ] becomes a throne [for Ze'er Anpin ], in the mystical meaning of “the King sitting on a throne [ kise ], high and exalted” (see Isaiah 6:1). This attribute is the mystical meaning of: “He engulfed His secret place in darkness” (Psalms 18:12), and kise is an expression of kisui [covering] and concealment. This is why [the Malkhut ] is called “a bent kaf .” b) [ Malkhut ] becomes the garment [of Ze'er Anpin ]. This is because these great brains appear [and illuminate] only upon Israel, and therefore the Malkhut becomes a garment of darkness. At the time when the kingship [of Ze'er Anpin ] is revealed, this clothing of darkness is removed and is cast upon the nations that worship stars and constellations, and the light of the face of [ Ze'er Anpin ] spreads and is revealed upon Israel. With regard to that time, our Rabbis said: “The Holy One, Blessed be He, will arrange a dance of the righteous, and each and every one of them will point to God with his finger, and say: Behold, this is our God, etc.” (see Ta’anit 31a). This removing of the clothing of darkness is the mystical meaning of the plain and long final kaf . c) The Malkhut becomes a crown upon His head, in the mystical meaning of: “Emerge, daughters of Zion, and gaze at King Solomon, at the crown with which his mother crowned him on the day of his wedding, and on the day of the rejoicing of his heart” (Song of Songs 3:11). This is the mystical meaning of the kaf as Keter [crown]. The three letters mem-lamed-kaf [ melekh ] have thus been explained; understand this well.

**31. “At that time etc.” At that time, the letter kaf descended from before Him, from upon His throne of glory. She trembled and said to Him: “Master of the world, it is good for You to create the world with me, for I am your kavod ** [glory]**.” When the letter kaf descended from upon His throne of glory, two hundred thousand worlds shook and the throne shook, and all the worlds shook on the verge of falling. The Holy One, blessed be He, said to her: Kaf , kaf , what are you doing here? I will not create the world with you; return to your place as there is kelaya ** [destruction] **in you, and with you “devastating destruction”** (Daniel 9:27) **was heard. Return to your throne and stay there. At that time, she departed from His presence and returned to her place.**

Explanation: **“At that time,”** while the mem was negotiating with the Holy One, blessed be He, for the world to be created with her, with aspect of the revelation of the light of the face of the King in the world, as stated above, this caused the descent of the kaf from the throne of glory, which is the world of Beria . **“She trembled and said** etc. **for I am your kavod ** [glory]**.”** Then **“two hundred thousand worlds shook,”** which are drawn from Ḥokhma and Bina of Beria , which [includes] Keter , Ḥokhma , and Bina , of Beria , **“and the throne shook, and all the worlds”** from there and below, **“shook on the verge of falling.”**

The meaning of this is that these requests of the letters before the Holy One, blessed be He – that the world should be created with them – are like the ascent of feminine waters to receive masculine waters from the Holy One, blessed be He, at a height corresponding to the measure of the letter. [The purpose of these requests is so] that the guidance that Ze’er Anpin and Nukba give to the world, as the sources of shefa [for the world], should be at the height of masculine waters that is imparted upon that letter. Similarly, the reply of the Holy One, blessed be He, to each of the twenty-two letters of Ze’er Anpin and Nukba is the aspect of the descent of masculine waters and the emergence of a height of light for its time, according to the measure of the feminine waters that each letter raised. When the height of [each particular column of] light began to reveal its guidance in the world, the reply of the Holy One, blessed be He, to that letter was heard. [The particular letter's] inability to guide the world, on account of the purchase of the kelippa on [the particular letter's] attribute was revealed, in the mystical meaning of: “God made one thing corresponding to the other” (Ecclesiastes 7:14). At that [rejection], each letter departed and went to her place. This is the mystical meaning of the [concept of the] playing of the Holy One, blessed be He, with each of the twenty-two letters, by giving each of them room to display their guidance in accordance with His will, until they clarify of their own accord, from their own desire, which of them is worthy to be used to guide the world. This is the meaning of the statement above: **“And two thousand years before the creation of the world the Holy One, blessed be He, was observing and playing with** the letters**.”**

With this, one can understand that when the mem began to reveal her great light in the world, this caused the kaf to descend from the throne of glory. There are two aspects to the mystical meaning of the throne [ kise ]: a) It conceals the King, in the mystical meaning of: “He engulfed His secret place in darkness” (Psalms 18:12), and this is why it is called kise , an aspect of kisui [covering]. b) It reveals the glory of Malkhut in the levels, in the mystical meaning of: “And upon the throne was a likeness, like the appearance of a man” (Ezekiel 1:26). This is [achieved] by combining the three letters mem-lamed-kaf [ melekh ], as then that Malkhut that became the throne of the Melekh [King] and covered Him, in the mystical meaning of: “He engulfed His secret place in darkness,” ascends and becomes a straight kaf . This is the mystical meaning of a garment for the "king himself, " as the "king himself, " Ze’er Anpin , is revealed through [this Malkhut ], as stated. [The Malkhut ] also became a crown upon the King’s head, as stated.

However, when the mem began to reveal the light of the face of the King in the levels [of existence] without the covering [provided by] the straight kaf , the kaf descended from the throne as well, i.e., she stopped her activity of covering the king. [Like the mem, ] she also said: **“It is good for You to create the world with me, for I am your kavod [glory].”** In other words, the dynamic of revealing the king’s glory should rule her, without any covering, following along with the desire of the mem . This is why [the Zohar ] says **“at that time,”** rather than “the kaf ascended and said before Him...” as it does for all the other letters. It is because [the kaf ] did not awake of her own accord, but rather through the controlling force of the mem , for the control of the mem at that time also brought the kaf down from the throne of glory in the world of Beria , as explained.

[Rav Hamnuna] then says: **“She trembled and said** […] **it is good** etc.**”** When [the kaf ] descended from the throne, she and **“two hundred thousand worlds,”** which are the levels that are drawn from Ḥokhma and Bina in Beria , shook, and likewise **“all the worlds shook on the verge of falling.”** The meaning is that the whole link between upper and lower [levels], from the top of the [entire structure of] levels to the bottom, is through the Malkhut of the upper [level] becoming a Keter for the [level] below. The mystical meaning of the kaf is the mystical meaning of the enclothing of Malkhut of the upper [level] in the [level] below. There are three aspects to the throne: a) [The aspect of] "six steps of the throne, " which [refers to a structure of] six extremities of the lower level [of the throne], called Ḥesed , Gevura , Tiferet , Netzaḥ , Hod , and Yesod ; b) [The aspect of] "four legs of the throne, " which are the brains of Keter , Ḥokhma , Bina , and Da'at , of the lower level; c) [The aspect of] the Malkhut of the higher [level] that descends from the higher [level] to the lower one and is enclothed within [the lower level], since through this Malkhut all the lights from the higher [level] come and illuminate the lower one.

Therefore, at the time of the descent of the kaf from the throne of glory, the connection of Atzilut with the throne of glory, which is the world of Beria , was severed. This is because the kaf is the Malkhut of Atzilut that is enclothed in Keter , Ḥokhma , Bina , and Da'at , of Beria , and [the kaf ] transmits all the lights to the world of Beria , called the "throne of glory." Since the kaf descended from there [during this discussion with the mem ], the connection with Atzilut was lost and the kaf was shaken, since her power to transmit to Beria was paused. **“Two hundred thousand worlds,”** which are Ḥokhma and Bina that include Keter , Ḥokhma , Bina , and Da'at , of Beria , shook. Similarly, all the levels **“shook on the verge of falling,”** for they lost all of their vitality and shefa from the world of Atzilut .

In a similar manner, one can explain the relationship of the Holy One, blessed be He, which is Bina , with the Ze’er Anpin and Nukba of Atzilut . The Malkhut of Bina which is enclothed in Ze’er Anpin , is the kaf . Thus, this kaf is the throne of the Holy One, blessed be He, which resides over Ze’er Anpin , as the Holy One, blessed be He, is Bina , which is the [level] above Ze’er Anpin , and the Ze’er Anpin becomes a throne for Bina . Upon the descent of [the kaf ], the connection of Bina with Ze’er Anpin is severed, because the kaf is the mystical meaning of this Malkhut of the Bina becoming enclothed in Ze’er Anpin and transmitting all the lights to [ Ze'er Anpin ]. Consequently, [the kaf ] herself shook, i.e., her ability to transmit to Ze’er Anpin ceased. Additionally, **“two hundred thousand worlds shook,”** which are the brains of Ze’er Anpin , called Ḥokhma and Bina , and also called Keter , Ḥokhma , Bina , and Da'at , which are the four legs of the throne, as stated, because all the shefa [flowing to them] ceased. Likewise, **“all the worlds shook on the verge of falling,”** which are the six extremities of Ze’er Anpin , Ḥesed , Gevura , Tiferet , Netzaḥ , Hod , and Yesod , which include all the worlds below Ze'er Anpin , for they lost all the shefa of Bina . Since they were emptied from the lights of Atzilut , they shook on the verge of falling into the Beria , Yetzira , and Asiya of separation, and being destroyed.

[Rav Hamnuna] continues: **“The Holy One, blessed be He, said to her** etc. **‘devastating destruction’ was heard. Return to your chair.”** This is as stated above, that on account of the descent of the kaf from the throne of glory, the first three [ sefirot ] of Ze’er Anpin shook, and all the levels shook on the verge of falling and being destroyed. That is, **“devastating destruction was heard,”** which means complete destruction without any further revival. Therefore, you must return to the aspect of the throne, as stated.

He concludes: **“At that time, she departed from His presence,”** reemphasizing **“at that time,”** to indicate that her return to her place in the throne came together with the reply of the Holy One, blessed be He, to the mem that **“it is unbecoming for the world to stand without a king.”** In other words, the shakings that were exposed with the kaf during her descent from the throne of glory, when all the worlds shook on the verge of falling, and the reply of the Holy One, blessed be He, to the mem that **“it is unbecoming for the world to stand without a king,”** occurred simultaneously. Understand this.

**32. “ Yod entered etc.”** The letter ** yod entered** [and] **said before Him: Master of the world! It is good for You to create the world with me, as I am the beginning of the holy name, and** [thus] **it is fitting for You to create the world with me. He said to her: It is enough for you that you are engraved in Me and you are inscribed in Me, and all My desire is in you. Depart; it is unfitting for you to be uprooted from My name.**

Explanation: Since yod is the first letter of the name Havaya , which means [the yod is] the start of the revelation and the highest aspect of this holy light, she argued that the world should be created with her attribute and then the completion of the rectification would be assured.

To this, **“He said to her: It is enough for you that you are engraved in Me and you are inscribed in Me** etc.**”** As you know by now, the questions and answers of the letters represent the playing of the Holy One, blessed be He, with the letters. The question is the aspect of feminine waters while the answer is the masculine waters of the supernal light. One can thereby understand that the phrase **“it is enough for you”** is the mystical meaning of the establishment of a boundary, in the mystical meaning of His statement to her: **“It is enough for you, "** and do not expand further, as was said previously with regard to the holy name of Shaddai . Once the yod began to expand in this great and holy light, the Holy One, blessed be He, stopped her and did not let her expand until the letter tav , but only until the mystical meaning of the letter shin (as stated above, section 24, second paragraph), as He told her: “It is enough for you**;** expand no further.” This is the meaning of the statement: **“Depart; it is unfitting for you to be uprooted from My name,”** for if you expand any further, you will no longer be able to be fixed in the name Havaya .

The meaning of this is as the Sages said: I am not read as I am written, as I am written as Havaya but read as Adonai ( Pesaḥim 50a). This is because the name Havaya never changes, in the mystical meaning of the verse: “I, Havaya , do not change” (Malachi 3:6). But since, during the times of the world, there are corruptions and rectifications, [it can be seen that] there are changes. Therefore, before the completion of the rectification He is called Adonai , as a change is possible in this name, but [He is] not [called] by the name Havaya , in which there is no change, God forbid. However, after the completion of the rectification, [ Havaya ] will be read as it is written, in the mystical meaning of the verse: “And the name of the city from that day shall be: Havaya is there.” (end of Ezekiel; 48:35). This is the meaning of His statement to her: **“Depart; it is unfitting for you to be uprooted from My name,”** for if some corruption were to occur in you, you would be uprooted from My name, since there are no corruptions or rectifications in My name of Havaya , as explained. Consequently, you are unfit for the world to be created with you.

The comment: **“It is enough for you that you are engraved in Me and you are inscribed in Me, and all My desire is in you,”** indicates three levels in the yod of the name Havaya : “Engraved” in Ḥokhma of Ze’er Anpin ; “inscribed” in Ḥokhma of Abba and Imma Ila'in ; and **“all My desire is in you”** in Ḥokhma of Arikh Anpin , which is called the sealed Ḥokhma .

**33. “ Tet entered etc.”** The letter ** tet entered** [and] **said before Him: Master of the world! It is good for You to create the world with me, as with me You are called good** [ tov ] **and upright. He said to her: I will not create the world with you, for your good is sealed within you, and concealed within you. This is** [the meaning of] **that which is stated: “How great is the goodness You have in store for those who fear You”** (Psalms 31:20)**. Since** the good **is concealed within you, it has no share in this world that I wish to create, but only in the next world. Furthermore, because your goodness is concealed within you, the gates of the Sanctuary will sink. This is** [the meaning of] **that which is stated: “Her gates sank into the ground”** (Lamentations 2:9)**. In addition, ḥet is across from you, and when you join together you will be ḥet - tet ,** which means sin**. This is why those letters were not inscribed in the holy tribes. She immediately departed from His presence.**

Explanation: Tet is the inner aspect of the Yesod of Ze’er Anpin . [As discussed previously, ] tzadi is the ninth of the letters of Ze’er Anpin , and [representing Yesod , that] fuses with the Nukba in the mystical meaning of tzaddik [righteous]. By contrast, tet is the ninth letter of Bina of Ze’er Anpin , and [the tet ] is the inner aspect of Yesod of Ze’er Anpin , which is called tov [good], in the mystical meaning of the verse: “Say of the righteous that it is good” (Isaiah 3:10). And as the soul of Yesod , in which there is no grasp for the kelippot , the tet claimed that the world should be created with her.

[Rav Hamnuna] then said: **“For your good is sealed within you, and concealed within you** etc.” This is the mystical meaning of the Sages’ statement ( Ḥagiga 12a): By means of the light that the Holy One, blessed be He, created on the first day, Adam could watch and look from one end of the world to the other. When the Holy One, blessed be He, looked at the generation of the flood and the generation of the dispersion, and saw that their ways were corrupt, He arose and concealed it etc. for the righteous people in the future, as it is stated: “And God saw the light, that it was good” (Genesis 1:4), and “good” is referring to none other than the righteous, as it is stated: “Say of the righteous that it is good.” The meaning [of this passage] is as follows: When the Holy One, blessed be He, saw that the wicked would corrupt their ways and would grant a purchase for the kelippot upon this light, He concealed it in the supernal tzaddik and tzedek of Abba and Imma (father and mother). From this tzaddik and tzedek of Abba and Imma this light is drawn in its concealment into the inner aspect of Yesod of Ze’er Anpin , which is the tet . In the mystical meaning of that rectification, the Holy One, blessed be He, replied to the tet : **“For your good is sealed within you, and concealed within you** etc. **Since** the good **is concealed within you, it has no share in this world that I wish to create, but only in the World to Come.”** In other words, since I have to hide you from the wicked, and you are fit only for the righteous who are worthy of receiving from the World to Come, you have no part in the rectification of this world, which is the mystical meaning of Ze’er Anpin and Nukba , since there is purchase for the external forces in you.

[Rav Hamnuna] continues: **“Furthermore, because your goodness is concealed within you, the gates of the Sanctuary will sink.”** Since this light shines only in the inner aspect of Yesod [of Ze'er Anpin ] in concealment, the Nukba will therefore be unable to receive from this light at her gates, but only through its concealment in the inner aspect [of the Nukba ]. As a result, the gates of Nukba sink into the inner aspect of her Yesod , and the [gates] are thereby preserved from the touch of the external forces. [Through this, the Nukba ] will be assured that the external forces will not control her gates. At the time of the destruction [of the Temple], the enemies did not control the gates of the Sanctuary, but rather [the gates] sank into the earth, as the Sages expounded ( Sota 9a; see Rashi there). Since you require such protection, you are unworthy for the world to be created with you.

[Rav Hamnuna] continues: **“In addition, ḥet is across from you, and when you join together you will be ḥet - tet ,”** since ḥet is Hod , which is the Malkhut that is incorporated in Ze’er Anpin , and that is the mystical meaning of the left channel in Yesod of Ze’er Anpin . There are two channels in Yesod of Ze’er Anpin : 1) For producing souls, which is the right one; 2) For discharging waste to the external forces, which is the left one, called ḥet . The concept is that [the left channel] is an aspect of the kof that is incorporated in Yesod (as stated above, in section 24, fourth paragraph), from where the very small luminescence emerges to the external forces. It is through this that the external forces acquire the strength to resemble the man of holiness, like a monkey with respect to a person, in the mystical meaning of: “God made one thing corresponding to the other” (Ecclesiastes 7:14). These two channels are close to one another, and there is only [a barrier as thick] as the husk of garlic between them. For this reason, the left channel has the strength to prevail over the right channel, and then it becomes ḥet - tet . This the mystical meaning of the fact that the numerical value of ḥet - tet is tov (good; tet-vav-bet ; 17), which is “one thing corresponding to the other.”

When the right, which is tet , prevails, then it is tov in numerical value, in the mystical meaning of the verse: “Say of the righteous that it is good” (Isaiah 3:10). But if, God forbid, the left channel, which is ḥet , prevails over the tet , then it is ḥet-tet (sin) in numerical value.

This is the meaning of the statement: **“In addition, ḥet is across from you.”** That is, the left channel, which is ḥet , has the strength to prevail over you, and then **“when you join together you will be ḥet - tet ,”** i.e., the kelippot will be able to extract the shefa of holiness for themselves, as there is control over all the sins from there. [Rav Hamnuna] adds: **“This is why those letters were not inscribed in the holy tribes.”** This is the reason why there are no letters ḥet or tet in the names of the tribes, to indicate that they are lofty and separated from this aspect of the ḥet , which is the root of the force of corresponding [evil]. This is the mystical meaning [of the teaching] that Jacob’s bed was whole and no waste emerged from it to the external forces, as was the case for Abraham and Isaac, in accordance with the statement of the Sages ( Pesaḥim 56a).

**34. “ Zayin entered etc.”** The letter ** zayin entered** [and] **said before Him: Master of the world! It is good for You to create the world with me, for through me Your children will observe Shabbat, as it is stated: “Remember** [ zakhor ] **the Sabbath day, to keep it holy”** (Exodus 20:8). **He said to her: I will not create the world with you, because war is within you,** that is, **a sharpened sword and a spear with which war is fought**, and these are called klei zayin [weapons]**.** And you are **like** the letter ** nun **, with which the world was not created because she contains nefila [falling, as stated in section 29, above]**.” She immediately departed from His presence.**

Explanation: The mystical meaning of zayin is that it is [in the form of] a yod over a vav , which indicates the brains of maturity of the Nukba , in the mystical meaning of the verse: “A woman of valor is the crown of her husband” (Proverbs 12:4). [In the state of maturity, the Nukba ] is incorporated in the male level, which is vav , and then [the Nukba ] becomes a crown upon his head. This is the mystical meaning of the yod over the vav , and her husband being crowned with her. And this is the mystical meaning of: **“Remember** [ zakhor ] **the Sabbath day, to keep it holy.”** By elevating the day of Shabbat, which is the Nukba , to the state of a crown atop the Ze’er Anpin – at which stage [the Nukba ] is incorporated in the mystical meaning of zakhor – the Nukba is called holy. The zayin is claiming: Since this light is great and holy, in the mystical meaning of the [Shabbat] rest, and there is cessation of all the kelippot in that state, I am worthy for the world to be created with my attribute.

To this, **“He said to her: I will not create** etc.**”** That is, the zayin is the Netzaḥ of Ze’er Anpin , as zayin - ḥet - tet are Netzaḥ , Hod , and Yesod of Ze’er Anpin . When the Nukba is incorporated in Zayin , which is Netzaḥ , she attains the strength to ascend with Ze’er Anpin to Abba and Imma Ila'in , where she becomes a crown for his head and her husband [which is Ze'er Anpin ] is crowned in the mystical meaning of Shabbat, as stated.

However, since this entire rectification is achieved only through incorporation [of the Nukba ] in the male and an elevation to [the place of] Abba and Imma (father and mother), and not in the place [of the Nukba ] below, where she is always positioned with the Ze’er Anpin , the rectification [of the Nukba ] is therefore not completed in the [current period of] six thousand years. During the weekdays, when she returns to her place, her incorporation in the zayin is regarded as keli zayin [weapons], to such extent that all wars with the Sitra Aḥara are considered as [coming] from her. This is in the mystical meaning of the weekdays that prepare for Shabbat, and the mystical meaning of: “The one who wins the war will be given the King’s daughter.” On the weekdays, each [person] must triumph in the battle with the Sitra Aḥara and external forces, and then he merits **“the King’s daughter,”** which is **“the Shabbat.”** Thus, the illumination of the Sabbath during the six thousand years is still not enough for the complete cessation of the kelippot , for this is why the weekdays return to surround [the Nukba ] until the completion of the rectification in the future, when it will be a day that is all Shabbat and rest for everlasting life.

This is the meaning of His statement: **“I will not create the world with you, because war is within you, a sharpened sword and a spear with which war is fought.”** This is as explained, that your illumination is still not complete, since you are incomplete in your place below, and they merit you only through wars with the Sitra Aḥara . [The term] **“war”** refers to the wars of the lower [created beings] with the Sitra Aḥara . The **“sharpened sword”** refers to the attribute of Malkhut during its incorporation in Netzaḥ on the weekdays, when [the Malkhut ] is a sharpened sword opposing the kelippot that wish to grasp hold of her. And **“a spear, with which war is fought”** refers to Ze’er Anpin himself, who is called “a spear,” for [ Ze'er Anpin ] is depicted as a letter vav , which is like a spear, [ready] to pierce the Sitra Aḥara with the attribute [of Ze'er Anpin ]. He says: “You are **like** the letter ** nun ,”** because the restraints ( gevurot ) of the male are from the aspect of Bina , which is nun , as stated.

**35. “ Vav entered etc.”** The letter ** vav entered** [and] **said before Him: Master of the world! It is good for You to create the world with me, for I am a letter from Your name** Havaya **. He said to her: Vav – you and heh , it is enough for you that you are letters from My name** Havaya **, that you are in the secret of My name and engraved and carved in My name. I will not create the world with you.**

Explanation: Although the yod had already submitted this request and been rejected, the vav thought that the yod had been turned down because her level was too high. The vav claimed that the world should be created with her attribute, at the level of vav-heh in the name, which is the brains of the Imma .

**“He said to her: Vav – you and heh , it is enough for you that you are letters from My name etc.”** He replied with the same response that He had given to the yod (see there), as He limited [the vav ] as well, with the mystical meaning of the statement: “Enough; expand only to the aspect of the shin so that the kelippot do not grasp hold of you. For this reason, you are unfit for the world to be created with you, as you too require protection from the kelippot .”

**36. “ Dalet and gimmel entered etc.”** The letters ** dalet and gimmel entered** [and] **also said the same. He also said to them: It is enough for you to be with one another, since paupers will not cease from the earth and they must be treated** [ li-gmol ] **with kindness. The dalet is poor** because she is called dalet , from the term dalut [poverty]**. The gimmel performs** [ gomelet ] **kindness** with the dalet **. Therefore, you must not separate from one another and it is enough for you to nourish one another.**

Explanation: The case of the dalet has already been clarified, in section 24 above, s.v. Ve-zeh (see there), where it was explained that although the dalet receives shefa from the gimmel , and the corner on the roof [of the dalet ] protrudes with [the bestowal of the light of giving, the Sitra Aḥara still has the strength to grasp hold of [the dalet ], to separate her [from the gimmel ], and to forge the letter resh with her, so that again she becomes poor [ resh ] and wretched. He thus said to them: **“It is enough for you to be with one another,”** i.e., you require extra protection so that you can **“be with one another,”** and the gimmel will bestow upon the dalet , **“since paupers will not cease from the earth.”** The opposite [side] has the strength to separate you and revert the Malkhut , which is called “world,” into the aspect of being poor [ resh ] and wretched. **“They must be treated with kindness,”** for then [the dalet and gimmel ] require an awakening from below, to give charity to the wretched, in order to restore the dalet so that it receives from the gimmel once again. Consequently, **“it is enough for you to nourish one another,”** as it is enough for you if you can keep yourselves in [a state of] pairing, nourishing each other, so that the kelippot will not be able to control you. Therefore, I will not create the world with you.

**37. “ Bet entered etc.”** The letter ** bet entered** [and] **said before Him: Master of the world!
