It is good for You to create the world with me, for with me they bless You above and below**, as bet stands for berakha , blessing**. The Holy One, blessed be He, said to her: I will certainly create the world with you, and you will be the start,** [in order] **to create the world** with you**.**

Explanation: The letter bet is the mystical meaning of Ḥokhma , meaning Ḥesed of Ḥokhma , in the mystical meaning of a point in its palace, since the light of giving is a palace for the light of Ḥokhma . This [combination of lights] is blessing, in the mystical meaning of the verse: “And pour you out a blessing etc.” (Malachi 3:10). This light does not diminish at all as it passes and descends through the levels [of creation]. Just as it is [in its fullness] at the highest of the levels, receiving from Ein Sof , blessed be He, so it remains in all its greatness and praise worthiness in the world of Atzilut , and similarly until the end of [the world of] Asiya . It does not attain any more opacity as a result of all the partitions through which it passes. This is the meaning of the claim of the letter bet : **“It is good for You to create the world with me, for with me they bless You above and below.”** This means to say, the light of my blessing is equivalent above and below, without any difference whatsoever, and no partition or opacity can damage my illuminations in any way. Therefore, my attribute is suitable for the creation of the world, as there will be no purchase for the kelippot in me, because the kelippot can only attach in a context where there is some deficiency. Since there are no deficiencies in me, there will be no purchase [for them] in me.

**“The Holy One, blessed be He, said to her: I will certainly create the world with you, and you will be the start,** [in order] **to create the world** with you**.”** He concurred with [the bet ] that her attribute was suitable for the creation of the world, and this is the mystical meaning of the verse: “For I said, the world is built [ yibaneh ] through kindness ( Ḥesed )” (Psalms 89:3). The word yibaneh denotes building [ binyan ] and understanding [ havana ], and He established [the bet ] as a sufficient differentiator, to distinguish between those who cleave to holiness and those who stray from the Holy One, blessed be He, to cleave to another god, in the mystical meaning of the verse: “And try Me now with this, says the Lord of hosts, if I will not open for you the windows of heaven and pour you out a blessing, that there shall be more than sufficiency” (Malachi 3:10). But when [people] turn toward another god, they are devoid of blessing, for another god is infertile and does not bear fruit. This is the meaning of the prophet’s conclusion there: “You will return and see the difference between the righteous and the wicked, between one who serves God and one who does not serve Him” (Malachi 3:18). Accordingly, “the world is built through kindness ( Ḥesed ).”

He thus says: **“You will be the start [ sheruta ],** [in order] **to create the world** with you**.”** Sheruta means start, and He thereby indicates that He did not establish the light of blessing for [an immediate] perfection of the world, but as a good and sufficient start to bring the world to a state of perfection. The reason is that this light of giving is of the aspect of six extremities without a head. [This light] is still not enough to generate new souls to be fruitful and multiply, as there is no producing of offspring for any partzuf before it attains the first three [ sefirot ], which are called head. Therefore, [the partzuf ] still lacks perfection. As for His decision to create the world with the established bet and blessing ( berakha ), this [method creates] the main aspect of each partzuf , meaning that [this main aspect] will not be absent from any partzuf of holiness. [However, ] the completion of the first three [ sefirot of the partzuf ] that is required for the brains of producing offspring is not the main aspect of the partzuf but rather is considered merely an addition. [This aspect of the head and brains] is dependent on the good deeds of the lower [beings]. By contrast, the aspect of the six extremities will never be absent.

**38. “The letter alef arose etc.” The letter alef arose but did not enter. The Holy One, blessed be He, said to her: Alef , alef , why are you not entering My presence like all the other letters? She said to Him: Master of the world! I observed that all the letters emerged from Your presence in vain; what would I do there? Furthermore, You have already given the letter bet this great gift, and it is unbecoming for the supreme King to transfer a gift that He has given to His servant and give it to another. The Holy One, blessed be He, said to her: Alef , alef , although the world was created with the letter bet , you will be the head of all the letters – there is no unification in Me other than through you. With you will all schemes will begin and all the works of the inhabitants of the world; and the entire unification is only through the letter alef .**

Explanation: As you already know, all these questions from the letters are their raising of feminine waters, while the answers are the mystical meaning of the masculine waters, as stated earlier. Now, this great wholeness found in the letter aleph could never be the result of an awakening from below, but only through an awakening from above. This is as written in the Zohar ( Vayikra , 81) on the verse “fallen, the virgin of Israel will rise no longer” (Amos 5:2), that “she will not rise by herself, but the Holy One, blessed be He, will raise her”; see there. Therefore, both at the start of the emanation of the brains of the first three [ sefirot ], i.e., while they are still in the mystical meaning of "playing in the sanctuary" of Abba and Imma (father and mother, which is the focus of the Zohar in that passage), and also at the completion of the rectification, the letter alef will not awaken by raising feminine waters from below upwards, in the manner of the emergence of the brains of the first three [ sefirot ] during the six thousand years. Rather, everything will be only in the mystical meaning of an awakening from above. This is the mystical meaning of **“she will not rise by herself, but the Holy One, blessed be He, will raise her.”** He thus says here: **“The letter alef arose but did not enter. The Holy One, blessed be He, said to her: Alef , alef , why are you not entering.”** This shows that the alef was not awakened at all to raise feminine waters like the other letters, until **“the Holy One, blessed be He, said to her,”** which is the mystical meaning of **“the Holy One, blessed be He, will raise her”**; see the Zohar there, thoroughly. He says **“ alef , alef ”** twice, in reference to those two aforementioned occasions, the first when the letters were in the mystical meaning of playing, while the second alludes to the completion of the rectification, since then too **“the Holy One, blessed be He, will raise her”** Himself.

[The Zohar continues: **“I observed that all the letters emerged from Your presence in vain.”** The reason why the alef did not dare raise the masculine waters on her own was that she saw all the letters leaving in vain, as it turned out that on all the levels there is “one thing corresponding to the other.” For this reason, she thought that she too was no better than them, and that she also had an opposite. This is why she said: **“What would I do there?”** For I have observed that I am no better than them.

[Rav Hamnuna] next says: **“Furthermore, You have already given the letter bet this great gift, and it is unbecoming for the supreme King to transfer** etc.**”** The second reason why I did not dare raise the masculine waters is because I observed that You have already established the main structure of each partzuf with the attribute of the letter bet , in the mystical meaning of the verse: “The world is built through giving” (Psalms 89:3), as stated. Therefore, I had no doubt that any change would be impossible, as it is not the manner of the King to transfer a gift that He has given to one servant and to give it to another servant.

[Rav Hamnuna] continues: **“The Holy One, blessed be He, said to her: Alef , alef , although the world was created with the letter bet , you will be the head of all the letters.”** The meaning is as follows: It is true that the world was already created with the letter bet , and it is also true that I will not transfer her gift to another. However, only the aspect of six extremities without a head was created with her attribute, and therefore the letters are still lacking a head, since they are unfit to be fruitful and multiplying without it. Therefore, **“you will be”** used for drawing forth the head to **“all the letters,”** that is, the brains of the first three, which are the brains of face-to-face and producing offspring.

[Rav Hamnuna] then says: **“The there is no unification in Me other than through you. With you will all schemes will begin and all the works of the inhabitants of the world.”** Meaning, My unification is revealed in the world only through your attribute. In addition, the whole matter of reward, punishment, and repentance, through which the completion of the rectification will be revealed, will be only **“through you.”** I established the bet only as the essence of the partzuf , so that [these lower brains] will not be at all a function of the deeds of the lower [beings], such that even if they corrupt their works, no change in these brains would thereby result, as stated. By contrast, the brains within you are entirely a function of the deeds of the lower [beings]: If they corrupt their works, the brains of the first three [ sefirot ] in you will depart; and if they repent, they will draw the brains of the first three once again.

This is the meaning of the statement: **“With you will all schemes will begin and all the works of the inhabitants of the world.”** “Schemes” means “if they corrupt their works,” in the mystical meaning of the verse: “God made man straight, but they have sought out many schemes” (Ecclesiastes 7:29), since then the brains of the first three will depart. **“And all the works of the inhabitants of the world”** refers to raising feminine waters by means of good deeds, for then the brains of the first three will be drawn once more. **“And the entire unification is only through the letter alef ”** alludes to the great unification of the completion of the rectification, which will also be **“through the letter alef .”**

**39. “And the Holy One, blessed be He, fashioned etc.” And the Holy One, blessed be He, fashioned higher, large letters,** which allude to the sefira of Bina , **and lower, small letters**, alluding to the sefira of Malkhut **. For this reason it is written bet bet ,** that is, ** Bereshit bara ** (“In the beginning [God] created,” [Genesis 1:1]), and likewise ** alef alef ,** i.e., Elohim et (“God (created the heavens etc.),” [Genesis 1:1]), as the first alef and bet are **letters from above,** from Bina , **and** the second alef and bet are **letters from below,** from Malkhut **. And they are all united, from the higher world,** which is Bina , **and from the lower world**, which is Malkhut , so that they will bestow to one another**.**

Explanation: The **“large letters”** are from the aspect of the Bina , while the **“lower, small letters”** are in Ze’er Anpin and Nukba . Now, when the higher [level] wants to give to the lower [level], it must enclothe itself in the lower one. This is the mystical meaning of the two letters bet of Bereshit bara , and the two letters alef of Elohim et : The first bet belongs to the higher [level], Bina , while the second bet belongs to the lower [level], Ze’er Anpin , in which the first bet is enclothed. Similarly, the first alef is from Bina , which enclothed itself in the second alef , [the aleph ] of Ze’er Anpin , in order to give to [ Ze'er Anpin ]. This is the meaning of the statement: **“And they are all united, from the higher world, and from the lower world.”** In other words, the two letters bet are one matter, and likewise the two letters alef are one matter, only that the first [of each of the letters] are from the higher world, Bina , whereas the second [of each of the letters] are from the lower world, Malkhut . [Each pair of letters] are one because they are enclothed in one another, in the manner of a higher [level] that wishes to give to a lower [level]. The bet of the higher world enclothed herself in the bet of the lower world, and similarly the alef of the higher world enclothed herself in the alef of the lower world.

**40. “ Bereshit , Rabbi Yudai etc.”  Bereshit ** (“In the Beginning,” Genesis 1:1) – **Rabbi Yudai said: What is** [the meaning of] ** Bereshit ?** It means **in Ḥokhma . This is Ḥokhma upon which the world**, which is the mystical meaning of Ze’er Anpin , **stands, to enter into the supernal, hidden secrets**, i.e., into the light of Bina **. Here are engraved the six great, higher extremities,** which are the six extremities of Bina , **from which everything emerges,** and **from which six origins and streams are formed,** which are the six extremities of Ze’er Anpin , **to bring them into the great sea**, Malkhut **. This is bara - shit ** [“created six”], which is alluded to in the letters of Bereshit , **as** the six extremities **were created from here. Who created them? The one who is not mentioned; that hidden one who is unknown**, Arikh Anpin **.**

Explanation: There are two [types of] Ḥokhma in Atzilut : a) The primordial Ḥokhma , which is the Ḥokhma of Arikh Anpin , and which is called the sealed Ḥokhma ; b) The Ḥokhma of the thirty-two paths, which is the Bina that ascends to the head of Arikh Anpin , where [that Bina ] becomes Ḥokhma in order to give to Ze’er Anpin . Thus, [Rav Yudai] states: “**What is Bereshit ? In Ḥokhma .”** Reishit [beginning] is the name of Ḥokhma , not the primordial Ḥokhma of Arikh Anpin , but rather the **“ Ḥokhma on which the world stands,”** i.e., the Ḥokhma of the thirty-two paths on which the world, which is Ze’er Anpin and Nukba , stands, from which [the world] receives and through which [the world] is sustained. This is not the case for the Ḥokhma of Arikh Anpin itself – Ze’er Anpin cannot receive anything from it and the world was not created through it. Therefore, Bereshit bara (“In the beginning [God] created,” [Genesis 1:1]) refers to the Ḥokhma of the thirty-two paths, which is Bina that returns to become Ḥokhma by means of her ascent to the head of Arikh Anpin .

[Rav Yudai] then says: **“To enter the supernal, hidden secrets.”** When the Ze’er Anpin and Nukba , which are called "the world, " receive from the Ḥokhma of thirty-two paths, they ascend to Abba and Imma Ila’in , and this Abba and Imma are called “the supernal, sealed secrets.” He thus states: **“This is Ḥokhma upon which the world stands, to enter the high and sealed secrets.” “Stands”** means the attainment of brains. He says, **“this Ḥokhma "** is the Ḥokhma **on which the world,”** Ze’er Anpin and Nukba , **“stands,”** as Ze’er Anpin and Nukba are sustained through the brains that they receive from [this Ḥokhma ]. [ Ze’er Anpin and Nukba ] thereby ascend to **“the high and sealed secrets,”** which are Abba and Imma , and enclothe them, i.e., [ Ze’er Anpin and Nukba ] become like Abba and Imma , since a lower [level] that ascends to a higher [level] becomes like [that higher level].

[Rav Yudai] continues: “**Here are engraved the six great, higher extremities,** etc. **this is bara - shit ,”** since Bereshit has the same letters as bara - shit , referring to shit sitrin , the six extremities. He is saying that the **“great, higher”** six extremities were engraved with this Ḥokhma and all [things] emanate and emerge from them, in the mystical meaning of the verse: “**In wisdom** [ Ḥokhma ] **You have made them all**” (Psalms 104:24). For the Ḥokhma referred to here means the Bina that was ejected from the head of Arikh Anpin , in the mystical meaning of “the father took out the mother on account of the children,” and the father himself is established as a kind of male and female. This means that Ḥokhma of Arikh Anpin , and likewise the Abba (father) of Atzilut , were themselves established as a kind of male and female as a result of the ascent of the Malkhut to the place of Bina . This caused the Bina itself to eject from the head of Arikh Anpin and from the Abba , and become of the aspect of the body of Arikh Anpin , without a head. While [the Bina ] is positioned in the body of Arikh Anpin , it cannot not receive from the first three [ sefirot ] of Arikh Anpin and becomes of the aspect of six extremities that lack the first three (see above, in the Marot HaSulam , section 2, third paragraph). Thus, the Bina was carved and became **“six extremities”** without a head. This is the meaning of his statement here: **“Here the six great, higher extremities are engraved, from which everything emerges,”** since through the Ḥokhma of the thirty-two paths, which is Bina , six extremities without the first three [ sefirot ] were carved, due to the departure [of Bina ] from the head of Arikh Anpin . Subsequently, by means of the feminine waters from the lower [beings], [ Bina ] returns to the head of Arikh Anpin and receives the first three of Ḥokhma from Arikh Anpin , and [ Bina ] transmits to Ze’er Anpin and Nukba , who transmit the shefa to all the worlds [below]. Thus, all the worlds emerge from these **“six extremities”** that were carved in Bina . The reason why [Rav Yudai] calls them **“the six great, higher extremities”** is because they are from Bina , in the manner of the letters of Bina , which are called “great letters.”

He then says: **“From which six origins and streams are formed, to bring them into the great sea.”** The engraving of **“six extremities”** while the Bina is outside of the head of Arikh Anpin , is called **“six origins,”** as they are only the origins of the brains of Ze’er Anpin . Subsequently, upon the return of [ Bina ] to the head of Arikh Anpin , they become the brains of the first three [ sefirot ], which are called **“streams”** for Ze’er Anpin . They then become **“six streams,”** in the mystical meaning of the verse: “He will drink from the stream on the way; thus will his head be raised” (Psalms 110:7), and then the Ze’er Anpin transmits them to **“the great sea,”** meaning to the Nukba [of Ze’er Anpin >>]. [Rav Yudai] thus says: **From which,”** i.e., from the six extremities, the six great, higher extremities of Bina , **“six origins,”** which are the six extremities of Ze’er Anpin of immaturity, **“and streams,”** i.e., the brains of Ze’er Anpin , **“are formed, to bring them,”** that is, to transmit, **“into the great sea,”** which is the Nukba . The reason why the six extremities of immaturity of Bina are called “origins of minds” is because the Bina emerged to become the six extremities of immaturity only in order to be a source for transmitting brains to Ze’er Anpin and Nukba . Had Bina not emerged, [ Ze’er Anpin and Nukba ] would not have been fit for any brains, as stated.

He adds: **“This is bara - shit , as they were created from here.” “Created”** refers to six extremities without a head, since the word “created” means sealing, as explained below. Accordingly, two matters are alluded to here by the word Bereshit : a) Ḥokhma , as reishit [beginning] denotes Ḥokhma ; b) Bara - shit , which teaches that **“six extremities”** without a head were created from Ḥokhma , the origins of brains for Ze’er Anpin and Nukba which are called world, and they are the seven days of creation.

He concludes: **“Who created them? The one who is not mentioned; that hidden one who is unknown.”** Since the word bara is in Bereshit itself, who created [ bara ] this? To this, [Rav Yudai] states that it is **“that hidden one who is unknown,”** the sealed Ḥokhma of Arikh Anpin , since [ Arikh Anpin ] removed Bina from his head and made [ Bina ] into six extremities, as he created these **“six great, higher extremities”** that are alluded to in Bereshit .

**41. “Rabbi Ḥiyya and Rabbi etc.” Rabbi Ḥiyya and Rabbi Yosei were walking along the way. When they reached a certain field, Rabbi Ḥiyya said to Rabbi Yosei: When you say Bara - shit ,** which is hinted to in [the word] Bereshit , **this** [implication] **is certainly the case, since the six higher days,** which are only the six extremities of Bina , **give to the Torah,** Ze’er Anpin , **and not more. The others**, the first three [ sefirot ] of Bina , **are concealed.**

Explanation: The Torah refers to Ze’er Anpin , which is called Orayta [“the Torah”]. The six higher days refers to the six extremities of Bina , which are above Ze’er Anpin . [Rabbi Ḥiyya] says that it is for this reason that ** Bara - shit ** is implied in the word Bereshit , since [the word] Bereshit is indicative of the Bina that returned to be Ḥokhma in order to give to Ze’er Anpin . Since Ze’er Anpin does not receive the first three [ sefirot ] of Ḥokhma from [ Bina ], but only the six extremities of Ḥokhma , the letters of Bara - shit are alluded to in this Ḥokhma of Bereshit , to indicate that Ze’er Anpin receives from [ Bina ] only the six extremities of Ḥokhma . This is the meaning of [Rabbi Ḥiyya's] statement: But **“the others are concealed,”** because the first three [ sefirot ] of the Ḥokhma remain concealed from Ze’er Anpin and [ Ze'er Anpin ] does not attain them.
